This was a rate-regime-and-risk-off flush, not a sector event: defensives led (-1.9%) while cyclicals fell -12.8% with VIX 18->27, and as a high-multiple, high-beta group the buildout names amplified the de-rating (SMH -38.1% vs SPY -19.5%). With no AI catalyst yet, there was nothing to offset the brutal repricing.
2021-12-27.title_zh: 避险中的利率冲击估值重置
2021-12-27.body_zh: 2022年美联储加息周期重创了长久期算力，收益率飙升(TLT -21.4%)、美元在类滞胀象限暴涨+9.4%。这是一次利率体制叠加避险(risk-off)的冲洗，而非板块事件：防御股领先(-1.9%)、周期股下跌-12.8%、VIX从18升至27；作为高估值、高贝塔群体，建设股放大了估值下修(SMH -38.1% vs SPY -19.5%)。当时尚无AI催化剂，无从对冲这场残酷的重定价。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息/收益率上行(TLT -21.4%)

2022-07-01.title: Peak-inflation bounce on a risk-on melt-up
2022-07-01.body: A summer relief rally fired on hopes inflation had peaked and the Fed would pivot, and the tape went risk-on: SMH +25.8%, growth beat value (+7.1), VIX cooled 27->20 and oil fell -17.5% in a goldilocks quad. As a high-beta corner, the buildout amplified the melt-up that pulled flows out of defensives, but it was a positioning bounce, not a fundamental turn in AI capex.
2022-07-01.title_zh: 风险偏好熔涨中的通胀见顶反弹
2022-07-01.body_zh: 夏季缓解性反弹源于通胀见顶、美联储转向的预期，行情转向风险偏好(risk-on)：半导体SMH +25.8%、成长跑赢价值(+7.1)、VIX从27降至20、油价在金发女孩象限下跌-17.5%。作为高贝塔领域，建设股放大了这场把资金从防御股抽出的熔涨，但这只是仓位反弹，并非AI资本开支的基本面转折。

2022-08-15.title: Hawkish Jackson Hole resets rates
2022-08-15.body: Powell's hard-line Jackson Hole killed the pivot trade and sent yields back up (TLT -14.2%) with the dollar +6.3% in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. VIX spiked 20->32 and the move was broad-and-rate-driven (cyclicals -13.4%, defensives -12.5%), but as the most rate-sensitive corner of tech the long-duration buildout led the laggards (SMH -29.8% vs SPY -16.3%).
2022-08-15.title_zh: 鹰派杰克逊霍尔会议重置利率
2022-08-15.body_zh: 鲍威尔在杰克逊霍尔的强硬表态终结了转向交易，收益率重新上行(TLT -14.2%)、美元在放缓/通缩恐慌象限走强+6.3%。VIX飙升20->32，这是一次广泛且由利率驱动的下跌(周期股-13.4%、防御股-12.5%)，但作为科技板块对利率最敏感的领域，长久期建设股领跌(SMH -29.8% vs SPY -16.3%)。

2022-10-14.title: ChatGPT ignites the supercycle into a narrow melt-up
2022-10-14.body: From the October 2022 low, ChatGPT's late-November launch detonated a generative-AI capex supercycle, with Nvidia and the datacenter/networking stack the prime beneficiaries. The macro could not have been more supportive: a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +230.6%, growth>value +55.3, VIX 32->13, DXY -7.3%) in a goldilocks quad, but it was a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP lagged SPY by -28.4%). Hyperscaler GPU orders plus the first Fed cuts in September 2024 powered a 261% run.
drivers: narrow risk-on melt-up (SMH +231%, RSP -28.4% vs SPY)
2022-10-14.title_zh: ChatGPT在窄幅熔涨中点燃超级周期
2022-10-14.body_zh: 从2022年10月低点起，ChatGPT于11月底发布引爆了生成式AI资本开支超级周期，英伟达(Nvidia)与数据中心/网络产业链是主要受益者。宏观环境再支持不过：金发女孩象限下科技/半导体引领的风险偏好熔涨(SMH +230.6%、成长跑赢价值+55.3、VIX 32->13、DXY -7.3%)，但这是窄幅的大盘股行情(RSP跑输SPY -28.4%)。超大规模云厂商GPU订单加上2024年9月首次降息，推动篮子上涨261%。
drivers_zh: 窄幅风险偏好熔涨(SMH +231%, RSP跑输SPY -28.4%)

2024-07-10.title: Yen-carry unwind air-pocket
2024-07-10.body: An August 2024 yen-carry unwind hit crowded AI-compute longs hardest in a sudden flight-to-safety: VIX exploded 13->28, defensives led (+2.2%) while cyclicals fell -5.5%, and breadth broadened (RSP +6.6% vs SPY) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. The fundamental buildout was untouched, but as a high-beta, over-owned leveraged long the basket took an outsized -24.8% SMH hit versus SPY's -7.6%.
2024-07-10.title_zh: 日元套息平仓的空气陷阱
2024-07-10.body_zh: 2024年8月的日元套息平仓在突然的避险中对拥挤的AI算力多头打击最重：VIX从13暴涨至28、防御股领先(+2.2%)、周期股下跌-5.5%、市场广度转宽(RSP跑赢SPY +6.6%)，处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。建设基本面未受影响，但作为高贝塔、过度持仓的杠杆多头，该篮子遭受超额下跌(SMH -24.8% vs SPY -7.6%)。

2024-08-07.title: Capex melt-up resumes in a narrow risk-on tape
2024-08-07.body: Once the carry shock cleared, hyperscaler capex guidance and relentless GPU demand drove a 50% recovery into late January 2025, riding a tech-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +26.9%, growth>value +13.9, VIX 28->15) in a goldilocks quad. It was a narrow mega-cap leadership tape (RSP -5.7% vs SPY) even as yields rose (TLT -7.2%) and the dollar firmed +4.8% — the buildout reclaimed leadership as the capex narrative re-accelerated.
2024-08-07.title_zh: 资本开支熔涨在窄幅风险偏好行情中重启
2024-08-07.body_zh: 套息冲击消退后，超大规模云厂商资本开支指引与持续的GPU需求推动篮子在2025年1月底前回升50%，乘的是科技引领的风险偏好熔涨(SMH +26.9%、成长跑赢价值+13.9、VIX 28->15)，处于金发女孩象限。这是窄幅大盘股领导行情(RSP跑输SPY -5.7%)，尽管收益率上行(TLT -7.2%)、美元走强+4.8%——随着资本开支叙事再加速，建设股夺回领导地位。
drivers_zh: 超大规模云厂商资本开支
窄幅风险偏好(SMH +26.9%, VIX 28->15, RSP -5.7%)

2025-01-22.title: DeepSeek scare flushes high-beta into a VIX spike
2025-01-22.body: DeepSeek's late-January cheap-model claim triggered a violent re-rating of the compute thesis, with Nvidia logging a record single-day market-cap loss. It hit during a flight-to-safety flush — VIX rocketed 15->45, defensives held (-2.2%) while cyclicals collapsed -16.3%, high-beta crushed (SPHB-SPLV -27.1) — that deepened into April's Liberation Day tariff crash. As the leveraged long of the AI complex the basket led the wreck (SMH -32.3% vs SPY -16.4%), bottoming around April 8.
2025-01-22.title_zh: DeepSeek恐慌在VIX飙升中冲洗高贝塔
2025-01-22.body_zh: DeepSeek在1月底声称的廉价模型引发了算力逻辑的剧烈重定价，英伟达录得史上最大单日市值损失。它在一次避险冲洗中发生——VIX从15飙至45、防御股守住(-2.2%)而周期股崩跌-16.3%、高贝塔被重创(SPHB-SPLV -27.1)——并延续至4月“解放日”关税崩盘。作为AI板块的杠杆多头，篮子领跌(SMH -32.3% vs SPY -16.4%)，在4月8日前后见底。

2025-04-04.title: 465% melt-up off the tariff low
2025-04-04.body: Off the April 2025 tariff low the buildout exploded 465% on resurgent hyperscaler capex, riding the most violent risk-on reset of the cycle: VIX collapsed 45->17 and high-beta dominated (SPHB-SPLV +124.5) in a reflation/growth-up quad with Tech +111.9% leading. As the high-beta proxy for the entire compute trade the basket maximally amplified the melt-up (SMH +271.1% vs SPY +49.0%), in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP -13.4% vs SPY).
2025-04-04.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点，建设股在重燃的超大规模云厂商资本开支推动下暴涨465%，乘的是本周期最猛烈的风险偏好重置：VIX从45崩至17、高贝塔主导(SPHB-SPLV +124.5)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限、科技+111.9%领涨。作为整个算力交易的高贝塔代理，篮子最大化放大了熔涨(SMH +271.1% vs SPY +49.0%)，处于窄幅大盘股行情(RSP跑输SPY -13.4%)。
drivers_zh: 超大规模云厂商资本开支
猛烈风险偏好重置(VIX 45->17, 高贝塔+124.5)

ai_software.now: AI software is trending but mid-pack on relative strength, having given back 22% since June 2026 as the semis-led wipeout spread up the stack. The backdrop has turned hawkish: DXY +3.4%, a reflation/growth-up quad where Tech and Energy lead but breadth is broadening (RSP +2.9% vs SPY) and growth lags value (-15.2). As a long-duration high-beta group the application layer feels every dollar-stronger, higher-rate twist, now hanging on whether enterprise AI monetization (Microsoft Copilot, Palantir) can justify multiples.
ai_software.now_zh: AI软件处于趋势中但相对强度居中，自2026年6月以来回吐22%，因半导体引领的暴跌沿产业链向上蔓延。背景已转鹰：美元DXY +3.4%，处于再通胀/增长向上象限(quad)、科技与能源领涨但市场广度转宽(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)、成长跑输价值(-15.2)。作为长久期高贝塔群体，应用层感受着每一次美元走强、利率上行的转折，如今取决于企业AI变现(微软Copilot、Palantir)能否支撑估值倍数。

2021-11-16.title: SaaS de-rating leads a flight-to-safety
2021-11-16.body: High-multiple application and platform software led the 2021-22 growth wreck as yields surged (TLT -8.7%) and the dollar firmed +3.3% in a stagflation-ish quad. It was a risk-off rotation — defensives held (+0.8%) vs cyclicals -5.1% with VIX 16->32 — and as the longest-duration corner of tech, SaaS amplified it (Tech -16.1%, SMH -21.2% vs SPY -10.8%). With AI monetization years away, the group had no earnings story to defend its multiples.
2021-11-16.title_zh: SaaS估值下修领跌避险行情
2021-11-16.body_zh: 高估值的应用与平台软件领跌2021-22年的成长股崩塌，收益率飙升(TLT -8.7%)、美元在类滞胀象限走强+3.3%。这是一次避险(risk-off)轮动——防御股守住(+0.8%) vs 周期股-5.1%、VIX从16升至32——作为科技中久期最长的领域，SaaS放大了跌幅(科技-16.1%、SMH -21.2% vs SPY -10.8%)。当时AI变现尚需数年，该板块没有盈利故事来捍卫估值倍数。

2022-03-14.title: Oversold relief in a narrow risk-on bounce
2022-03-14.body: A sharp but brief bounce off oversold levels lifted software as VIX collapsed 32->19 and growth beat value (+9.5) in a reflation/growth-up quad. It was a narrow mega-cap-led tape (RSP -3.0% vs SPY) and pure positioning — the relief faded fast as the hiking path steepened.
2022-03-14.title_zh: 窄幅风险偏好反弹中的超卖修复
2022-03-14.body_zh: 软件股从超卖水平出现短暂而剧烈的反弹，VIX从32崩至19、成长跑赢价值(+9.5)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限。这是窄幅大盘股领导行情(RSP跑输SPY -3.0%)、纯仓位驱动——随着加息路径变陡，这波修复很快消退。

2022-04-04.title: Real-yield repricing in a stagflation flush
2022-04-04.body: Software resumed its slide as the Fed signaled a faster, steeper path and real yields surged (TLT -14.7%), with the dollar +4.7% in a stagflation-ish quad. The flight-to-safety was deep (defensives -11.5% vs cyclicals -17.1%, VIX 19->33), and profitless application names with no near-term earnings were repriced hardest (Tech -23.5% vs SPY -19.7%).
2022-04-04.title_zh: 类滞胀冲洗中的实际收益率重定价
2022-04-04.body_zh: 随着美联储释放更快、更陡峭路径信号、实际收益率飙升(TLT -14.7%)、美元在类滞胀象限走强+4.7%，软件股恢复下跌。避险很深(防御股-11.5% vs 周期股-17.1%、VIX 19->33)，缺乏近期盈利的应用层个股被重定价得最重(科技-23.5% vs SPY -19.7%)。
drivers_zh: 加息加速/实际收益率上行(TLT -14.7%)

2022-06-16.title: Peak-rate-fear bounce on a risk-on melt-up
2022-06-16.body: A summer rally on hopes the worst of tightening was priced lifted software off its June low, as the tape went risk-on: SMH +20.8%, growth>value (+9.2), VIX cooled 33->20 and oil crashed -24.0% in a goldilocks quad. The move was sentiment-driven and high-beta amplified, with no earnings support, and it unwound into the autumn.
2022-06-16.title_zh: 风险偏好熔涨中的利率恐慌见顶反弹
2022-06-16.body_zh: 夏季反弹源于市场预期最糟紧缩已被消化，将软件股托离6月低点，行情转向风险偏好：SMH +20.8%、成长跑赢价值(+9.2)、VIX从33降至20、油价在金发女孩象限崩跌-24.0%。这波走势由情绪驱动、被高贝塔放大、缺乏盈利支撑，并在秋季回落。

2022-08-15.title: Final tightening leg, rate-driven low
2022-08-15.body: Hawkish Fed messaging and surging yields (TLT -9.5%) drove software to its cycle low into early January 2023 in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. It was a broad, rate-led drawdown (breadth broadened, RSP +4.9% vs SPY) rather than a panic, and the long-duration group bottomed (Tech -19.6% vs SPY -10.8%) just before the AI narrative arrived.
2022-08-15.title_zh: 紧缩末段、利率驱动的低点
2022-08-15.body_zh: 鹰派的美联储表态与飙升的收益率(TLT -9.5%)将软件股推至2023年初的周期低点，处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。这是广泛、由利率驱动的回撤(广度转宽，RSP跑赢SPY +4.9%)而非恐慌，长久期板块见底(科技-19.6% vs SPY -10.8%)恰好在AI叙事到来前。

2023-01-05.title: AI platform supercycle in a narrow goldilocks melt-up
2023-01-05.body: From the January 2023 low, generative AI turned software platforms into the prime monetization vehicle, with Microsoft Copilot and Palantir leading a 268% run. The macro was a textbook tech-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +155.3%, growth>value +67.1, VIX 22->15) in a goldilocks quad, but extremely narrow (RSP lagged SPY by -32.7%) — a mega-cap tape — even as yields rose (TLT -7.8%). Fed cuts from September 2024 and an AI land-grab compounded the move despite the SVB scare and yen-carry air-pocket.
drivers: narrow risk-on melt-up (SMH +155%, RSP -32.7% vs SPY)
2023-01-05.title_zh: 窄幅金发女孩熔涨中的AI平台超级周期
2023-01-05.body_zh: 从2023年1月低点起，生成式AI使软件平台成为首要变现载体，微软Copilot与Palantir领涨，涨幅268%。宏观是教科书式科技引领的风险偏好熔涨(SMH +155.3%、成长跑赢价值+67.1、VIX 22->15)，处于金发女孩象限，但极度窄幅(RSP跑输SPY -32.7%)——大盘股行情——尽管收益率上行(TLT -7.8%)。2024年9月起的美联储降息与AI跑马圈地放大了行情，尽管经历硅谷银行恐慌与日元套息空气陷阱。
drivers_zh: 窄幅风险偏好熔涨(SMH +155%, RSP跑输SPY -32.7%)

2025-02-18.title: DeepSeek and tariff crash flush high-beta
2025-02-18.body: DeepSeek's cheap-AI scare bled into software on fears cheaper models would commoditize the application layer, then deepened in April's Liberation Day tariff crash. It was a flight-to-safety flush — VIX rocketed 15->45, defensives held (-4.8%) vs cyclicals -16.7%, high-beta crushed (SPHB-SPLV -25.0) — and as a long-duration high-beta group software led the laggards (Tech -24.6% vs SPY -17.1%), bottoming near April 4 with the broad market.
2025-02-18.title_zh: DeepSeek与关税崩盘冲洗高贝塔
2025-02-18.body_zh: DeepSeek廉价AI恐慌蔓延至软件，市场担忧更便宜的模型会使应用层商品化，随后在4月“解放日”关税崩盘中加深。这是一次避险冲洗——VIX从15飙至45、防御股守住(-4.8%) vs 周期股-16.7%、高贝塔被重创(SPHB-SPLV -25.0)——作为长久期高贝塔群体，软件领跌(科技-24.6% vs SPY -17.1%)，在4月4日前后随大盘见底。

2025-04-04.title: Monetization-proof recovery on a risk-on reset
2025-04-04.body: The tariff pause and stronger enterprise AI bookings drove a 67% recovery as Copilot-style seat monetization proved real, riding a violent risk-on reset (VIX collapsed 45->16, high-beta dominated SPHB-SPLV +65.5, DXY -4.1%) in a goldilocks quad with Tech +64.4% leading. It was a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP -13.1% vs SPY); the rally stalled in late October into a hawkish valuation reset.
2025-04-04.title_zh: 风险偏好重置下的变现验证复苏
2025-04-04.body_zh: 关税暂停与更强劲的企业AI订单推动67%的复苏，因Copilot式席位变现被证明真实可行，乘的是猛烈的风险偏好重置(VIX从45崩至16、高贝塔主导SPHB-SPLV +65.5、DXY -4.1%)，处于金发女孩象限、科技+64.4%领涨。这是窄幅大盘股行情(RSP跑输SPY -13.1%)；反弹在10月底因鹰派估值重置而停滞。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好重置(VIX 45->16, 高贝塔+65.5)

2025-10-27.title: Hawkish valuation reset, rate-driven
2025-10-27.body: A late-2025 hawkish repricing compressed the richest software multiples, then the 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock (oil +57.5%) pushed CPI to ~4.2% and a Fed hiking bias deepened the drawdown in a reflation/growth-up quad. The pain was rate-driven and rotation-led — Energy +30.9% led while growth lagged value (-15.7) and breadth broadened (RSP +3.5% vs SPY) — and long-duration software bore the brunt of higher discount rates (Tech -4.3% even as SMH held +21.8%) into April 2026.
2025-10-27.title_zh: 利率驱动的鹰派估值重置
2025-10-27.body_zh: 2025年末的鹰派重定价压缩了估值最高的软件倍数，随后2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击(油价+57.5%)将CPI推升至约4.2%、美联储转向加息倾向，在再通胀/增长向上象限加深回撤。痛苦由利率驱动、板块轮动主导——能源+30.9%领涨、成长跑输价值(-15.7)、广度转宽(RSP跑赢SPY +3.5%)——长久期软件在更高贴现率下首当其冲(科技-4.3%，尽管SMH守住+21.8%)，延续至2026年4月。
drivers_zh: 霍尔木兹石油冲击(油价+57.5%)

2026-04-10.title: Ceasefire risk-on bounce
2026-04-10.body: Software rebounded 53% as the mid-June Hormuz ceasefire eased the oil-and-rates overhang (oil -4.6%) and risk appetite returned: SMH +39.1%, growth>value (+8.6), VIX cooled 19->16 in a reflation/growth-up quad. As a high-beta group it amplified the snapback (Tech +37.1% led, SMH +39.1% vs SPY +11.4%) in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP -5.4% vs SPY) before breadth narrowed again.
2026-04-10.title_zh: 停火后的风险偏好反弹
2026-04-10.body_zh: 随着6月中旬霍尔木兹海峡停火缓解油价与利率压制(油价-4.6%)、风险偏好回归，软件股反弹53%：SMH +39.1%、成长跑赢价值(+8.6)、VIX从19降至16，处于再通胀/增长向上象限。作为高贝塔群体，它放大了这波回升(科技+37.1%领涨、SMH +39.1% vs SPY +11.4%)，处于窄幅大盘股行情(RSP跑输SPY -5.4%)，随后市场广度再度收窄。

2026-06-01.title: Semis wipeout spreads up into a flight-to-safety
2026-06-01.body: Broadcom's early-June refusal to raise its AI outlook triggered a semis wipeout that spread up the stack into software as the tape went risk-off: defensives led (+5.3%) vs cyclicals -0.1%, VIX rose 16->19, oil crashed -22.0% and growth lagged value (-11.5) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. Breadth broadened (RSP +4.6% vs SPY) as the application layer gave back 22% (Tech -5.6%, Comm -8.4%) and the market questioned whether AI spend would keep funding software multiples.
2026-06-01.title_zh: 半导体暴跌在避险中向上蔓延
2026-06-01.body_zh: 博通在6月初拒绝上调AI展望，引发半导体暴跌，并沿产业链向上蔓延至软件，行情转向避险：防御股领先(+5.3%) vs 周期股-0.1%、VIX升至16->19、油价崩跌-22.0%、成长跑输价值(-11.5)，处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。广度转宽(RSP跑赢SPY +4.6%)，应用层回吐22%(科技-5.6%、通讯-8.4%)，市场质疑AI支出能否继续支撑软件估值。

ai_agents.now: The agentic AI layer is at prime entry after a 49% drawdown into April 2026, the deepest in the AI complex given its speculative, application-native profile — exactly what a long-duration high-beta basket does when the regime turns. The tape is now reflation/growth-up with DXY +3.4%, broadening breadth (RSP +2.9% vs SPY) and growth lagging value (-15.2), a mixed setup for the longest-duration, least-profitable AI names. Recovery hinges on whether agent platforms convert pilots into recurring revenue while higher rates punish profitless growth.
ai_agents.now_zh: AI智能体层在2026年4月前经历49%回撤后处于理想入场点，因其投机性、应用原生属性，这是整个AI板块中最深的回撤——正是长久期高贝塔篮子在体制转向时的表现。当前行情为再通胀/增长向上、美元DXY +3.4%、广度转宽(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)、成长跑输价值(-15.2)，对久期最长、盈利最差的AI个股是喜忧参半的格局。复苏取决于智能体平台能否将试点转化为经常性收入，而更高的利率正在惩罚无盈利成长。

2021-02-09.title: Growth-froth top as rates twitch
2021-02-09.body: Speculative application software topped early as the 2021 growth froth peaked and the first yield twitch began rotation out of long-duration tech (TLT -8.4%, growth lagged value -13.2). In a broadening reflation/growth-up tape (RSP +5.4% vs SPY, Financials/Energy/Materials led) the most unprofitable, highest-beta corner led the decline even as SPY rose +5.5% — high-beta cracking before the index.
2021-02-09.title_zh: 利率初动下的成长泡沫见顶
2021-02-09.body_zh: 投机性应用软件提早见顶，因2021年成长泡沫触顶、收益率首次抽动开启资金轮出长久期科技(TLT -8.4%、成长跑输价值-13.2)。在转宽的再通胀/增长向上行情中(RSP跑赢SPY +5.4%、金融/能源/材料领涨)，最不盈利、高贝塔的领域领跌，尽管SPY上涨+5.5%——高贝塔先于指数破位。
drivers_zh: 早期利率轮动(TLT -8.4%, 成长-价值-13.2)

2021-05-13.title: Liquidity-fueled final melt-up
2021-05-13.body: Abundant liquidity powered a final 45% melt-up in speculative app software into the November 2021 peak, riding a tech-led risk-on tape (SMH +30.1%, growth>value +18.3, VIX 23->15) in a reflation/growth-up quad with falling yields (TLT +9.2%). It was a narrow mega-cap melt-up (RSP -5.7% vs SPY) — the last hurrah before the rate cycle turned.
2021-05-13.title_zh: 流动性驱动的最后熔涨
2021-05-13.body_zh: 充裕流动性推动投机性应用软件在2021年11月见顶前完成最后45%熔涨，乘的是科技引领的风险偏好行情(SMH +30.1%、成长跑赢价值+18.3、VIX 23->15)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限、收益率回落(TLT +9.2%)。这是窄幅大盘股熔涨(RSP跑输SPY -5.7%)——利率周期转向前的最后狂欢。
drivers_zh: 宽松流动性/收益率回落(TLT +9.2%)

2021-11-04.title: Rate-cycle de-rating in a flight-to-safety
2021-11-04.body: The Fed's hawkish pivot crushed the highest-multiple, lowest-profit software hardest, a 49% collapse into March 2022 as yields surged (TLT -10.0%) and the dollar firmed +5.0% in a stagflation-ish quad. The flight-to-safety (defensives +1.0% vs cyclicals -4.1%, VIX 15->32) left long-duration cash-burners nowhere to hide (Tech -14.8%, Comm -21.3%), with the basket amplifying the index drop.
2021-11-04.title_zh: 避险中的利率周期估值下修
2021-11-04.body_zh: 美联储鹰派转向对估值最高、盈利最差的软件打击最重，在2022年3月前暴跌49%，收益率飙升(TLT -10.0%)、美元在类滞胀象限走强+5.0%。避险(防御股+1.0% vs 周期股-4.1%、VIX 15->32)让长久期烧钱股无处可藏(科技-14.8%、通讯-21.3%)，篮子放大了指数跌幅。

2022-03-14.title: Oversold snapback on a risk-on melt-up
2022-03-14.body: A violent 28% two-week bounce off deeply oversold levels reflected positioning, not a turn, as VIX collapsed 32->19 and the tape went risk-on (SMH +18.8%, growth>value +8.7) in a reflation/growth-up quad. It was a narrow mega-cap melt-up (RSP -2.4% vs SPY) and reversed almost immediately.
2022-03-14.title_zh: 风险偏好熔涨中的超卖反弹
2022-03-14.body_zh: 深度超卖后两周内剧烈反弹28%，反映仓位调整而非转折，VIX从32崩至19、行情转向风险偏好(SMH +18.8%、成长跑赢价值+8.7)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限。这是窄幅大盘股熔涨(RSP跑输SPY -2.4%)，几乎立即逆转。

2022-03-29.title: Resumed rate selloff, flight-to-safety
2022-03-29.body: Surging real yields (TLT -9.5%) and a stronger dollar (+5.5%) drove speculative software down another 39% into May in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. The flight-to-safety was sharp (defensives -4.2% vs cyclicals -13.1%, VIX 19->33), and profitless growth remained the most punished factor (Tech -18.7%, Discretionary -24.0% vs SPY -14.9%).
2022-03-29.title_zh: 避险中的利率抛售重启
2022-03-29.body_zh: 实际收益率飙升(TLT -9.5%)与美元走强(+5.5%)推动投机性软件在5月前再跌39%，处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。避险剧烈(防御股-4.2% vs 周期股-13.1%、VIX 19->33)，无盈利成长仍是受惩罚最重的因子(科技-18.7%、可选消费-24.0% vs SPY -14.9%)。

2022-05-11.title: Bear-market relief bounce
2022-05-11.body: A 33% bear-market rally fired on peak-inflation hopes and short-covering in the most beaten-down names, as VIX eased 33->25 in a reflation/growth-up quad (oil +10.6%, Energy led). The high-beta basket amplified the bounce (SMH +13.4% vs SPY +6.3%), but with no earnings support it faded.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 33%的熊市反弹源于通胀见顶预期与跌幅最深个股的空头回补，VIX在再通胀/增长向上象限缓和33->25(油价+10.6%、能源领涨)。高贝塔篮子放大了反弹(SMH +13.4% vs SPY +6.3%)，但缺乏盈利支撑随后消退。

2022-06-02.title: Capitulation to the cycle low
2022-06-02.body: Relentless hiking and liquidity withdrawal drove a 48% capitulation into late December 2022, the cycle bottom, as yields surged (TLT -13.0%) and oil collapsed -32.4% in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. Defensives held (+1.0%) vs cyclicals -7.2% in a broadening tape (RSP +2.8% vs SPY); the highest-beta group was left for dead (Comm -22.9%) just as generative AI was about to arrive.
2022-06-02.title_zh: 投降式下跌至周期低点
2022-06-02.body_zh: 持续加息与流动性收紧推动该板块在2022年12月底投降式下跌48%，触及周期底部，收益率飙升(TLT -13.0%)、油价在放缓/通缩恐慌象限崩跌-32.4%。防御股守住(+1.0%) vs 周期股-7.2%，处于转宽行情(RSP跑赢SPY +2.8%)；这个最高贝塔群体被弃如敝屣(通讯-22.9%)，就在生成式AI即将到来之际。
drivers_zh: 流动性收紧/收益率上行(TLT -13.0%)

2022-12-28.title: AI-application supercycle, the highest-beta winner
2022-12-28.body: From the December 2022 low the agentic/AI-application thesis drove an extraordinary 934% run as ChatGPT created a new monetization layer and Fed cuts began September 2024. The macro was a textbook tech-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +158.0%, growth>value +65.0, VIX 22->15) in a goldilocks quad, but extremely narrow (RSP lagged SPY by -32.0%) — a mega-cap tape. As the highest-beta corner of AI the basket maximally amplified every up-leg of the buildout.
drivers: narrow risk-on melt-up (SMH +158%, RSP -32.0% vs SPY)
2022-12-28.title_zh: AI应用超级周期，最高贝塔的赢家
2022-12-28.body_zh: 从2022年12月低点起，智能体/AI应用逻辑推动了惊人的934%涨幅，因ChatGPT创造全新变现层、美联储于2024年9月开启降息。宏观是教科书式科技引领的风险偏好熔涨(SMH +158.0%、成长跑赢价值+65.0、VIX 22->15)，处于金发女孩象限，但极度窄幅(RSP跑输SPY -32.0%)——大盘股行情。作为AI中贝塔最高的领域，篮子最大化放大了建设主题的每一段上涨。
drivers_zh: 窄幅风险偏好熔涨(SMH +158%, RSP跑输SPY -32.0%)

2025-02-13.title: DeepSeek hits app layer in a VIX panic
2025-02-13.body: DeepSeek's cheap-model scare hit the agent layer hardest on fears commoditized models would gut application economics, then deepened in the Liberation Day tariff crash. It was a flight-to-safety panic — VIX exploded 15->52, defensives held (-7.3%) vs cyclicals -18.0%, high-beta crushed (SPHB-SPLV -20.9) — and as the highest-beta basket it led the wreck (Tech -24.7% vs SPY -18.3%), falling 38% to its April 8 bottom.
2025-02-13.body_zh: DeepSeek廉价模型恐慌对智能体层打击最重，市场担忧商品化模型会侵蚀应用经济效益，随后在“解放日”关税崩盘中加深。这是一次避险恐慌——VIX从15暴涨至52、防御股守住(-7.3%) vs 周期股-18.0%、高贝塔被重创(SPHB-SPLV -20.9)——作为贝塔最高的篮子，它领跌(科技-24.7% vs SPY -18.3%)，下跌38%至4月8日底部。

2025-04-08.title: Agent-hype recovery on a violent risk-on reset
2025-04-08.body: The tariff pause and surging interest in agentic platforms drove a 93% snapback as enterprises piloted AI agents at scale, riding a violent risk-on reset (VIX collapsed 52->16, high-beta dominated SPHB-SPLV +61.1, DXY -3.3%) in a goldilocks quad with Tech +61.9% leading. As the highest-beta AI corner in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP -11.1% vs SPY), it led the rebound before topping in October 2025.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 猛烈风险偏好重置中的智能体热潮复苏
2025-04-08.body_zh: 关税暂停与对智能体平台的兴趣激增推动93%的回升，因企业大规模试点AI智能体，乘的是猛烈风险偏好重置(VIX从52崩至16、高贝塔主导SPHB-SPLV +61.1、DXY -3.3%)，处于金发女孩象限、科技+61.9%领涨。作为贝塔最高的AI领域，在窄幅大盘股行情中(RSP跑输SPY -11.1%)领涨这波反弹，随后在2025年10月见顶。
drivers_zh: 猛烈风险偏好重置(VIX 52->16, 高贝塔+61.1)

2025-10-09.title: Deepest AI drawdown, rate-and-rotation driven
2025-10-09.body: A hawkish valuation reset plus the 2026 Hormuz oil shock (oil +57.0%) and Fed hiking bias drove a 49% collapse, the deepest in the AI complex given the basket's speculative profile. In a reflation/growth-up quad the rotation was punishing — Energy +31.7% led, growth lagged value (-15.6), breadth broadened (RSP +2.9% vs SPY) — and higher discount rates fell hardest on the longest-duration, least-profitable agent names (Tech -1.4% even as SMH held +26.9%).
2025-10-09.title_zh: 利率与轮动驱动的AI最深回撤
2025-10-09.body_zh: 鹰派估值重置叠加2026年霍尔木兹石油冲击(油价+57.0%)与美联储加息倾向，推动篮子暴跌49%，鉴于其投机属性，这是整个AI板块最深的回撤。在再通胀/增长向上象限，轮动颇为残酷——能源+31.7%领涨、成长跑输价值(-15.6)、广度转宽(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)——更高贴现率对久期最长、盈利最差的智能体个股打击最重(科技-1.4%，尽管SMH守住+26.9%)。
drivers_zh: 霍尔木兹石油冲击(油价+57.0%)
美联储加息倾向/成长跑输价值(-15.6)

2026-04-10.title: Ceasefire high-beta snapback
2026-04-10.body: The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire and easing oil-and-rates pressure (oil -4.6%) drove a 40% high-beta bounce off the April low, with VIX cooling 19->16 and growth beating value (+8.6) in a reflation/growth-up quad. As the highest-beta AI corner it amplified the snapback (Tech +37.1% led, SMH +39.1% vs SPY +11.4%) in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP -5.4% vs SPY); whether it holds depends on agent platforms converting pilots into durable recurring revenue.
2026-04-10.body_zh: 6月中旬霍尔木兹海峡停火与油价、利率压力缓解(油价-4.6%)，推动这个高贝塔篮子自4月低点反弹40%，VIX降至19->16、成长跑赢价值(+8.6)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限。作为贝塔最高的AI领域，它放大了回升(科技+37.1%领涨、SMH +39.1% vs SPY +11.4%)，处于窄幅大盘股行情(RSP跑输SPY -5.4%)；能否持续取决于智能体平台能否将试点转化为持久的经常性收入。
drivers_zh: 高贝塔风险偏好反弹(SMH +39.1%, VIX 19->16)

ai_neoclouds.now: GPU-cloud hosting is trending and ranks #2 on relative strength after a 570% run off the April 2025 low that rode a violent risk-on melt-up (SMH +268%, VIX 52->16, high-beta dominant). Its high-beta, capital-intensive profile makes it the sharpest amplifier of the regime — it now meets a hawkish turn (DXY +3.4%, reflation/growth-up quad, broadening breadth RSP +2.9% vs SPY) where the early-June Broadcom outlook miss is the first real test of whether GPU-leasing economics hold as the buildout matures.
ai_neoclouds.now_zh: GPU云托管处于趋势中，在自2025年4月低点上涨570%后相对强度排名第2，这轮上涨乘的是猛烈的风险偏好(risk-on)熔涨(半导体SMH +268%、VIX 52->16、高贝塔主导)。其高贝塔、重资本属性使其成为体制最锋利的放大器——如今遭遇转鹰(美元DXY +3.4%、再通胀/增长向上象限、广度转宽RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)，6月初博通未上调展望是对GPU租赁经济效益能否在建设成熟期保持稳健的首次真正考验。

2021-11-12.title: Pre-pivot leverage wipeout in a dollar surge
2021-11-12.body: These capital-intensive, high-beta names (many ex-bitcoin miners) collapsed 84% as the rate cycle turned, yields surged (TLT -21.2%) and the dollar exploded +10.0% in a stagflation-ish quad. It was a flight-to-safety (defensives +1.8% vs cyclicals -13.7%, VIX 16->29) and crypto/leverage unwind, and as the highest-beta corner with no AI-compute story the group massively amplified the index drop (SMH -32.0% vs SPY -18.4%).
2021-11-12.title_zh: 美元飙升中转向前的杠杆崩塌
2021-11-12.body_zh: 这些重资本、高贝塔个股(许多是前比特币矿企)暴跌84%，因利率周期转向、收益率飙升(TLT -21.2%)、美元在类滞胀象限暴涨+10.0%。这是避险(防御股+1.8% vs 周期股-13.7%、VIX 16->29)与加密/杠杆平仓，作为没有AI算力故事的最高贝塔领域，该板块巨幅放大了指数跌幅(SMH -32.0% vs SPY -18.4%)。

2022-06-30.title: Violent oversold bounce on a risk-on melt-up
2022-06-30.body: A 103% rip off washed-out levels reflected the basket's extreme high-beta character, firing on peak-inflation hopes as the tape went risk-on (SMH +21.0%, growth>value +7.0, VIX 29->20) in a goldilocks quad with oil falling -15.5%. The bounce was pure positioning — the highest-beta group ripped hardest off the low — and reversed sharply.
2022-06-30.title_zh: 风险偏好熔涨中的剧烈超卖反弹
2022-06-30.body_zh: 从超卖水平暴涨103%，反映该篮子极高的贝塔属性，由通胀见顶预期点燃，行情转向风险偏好(SMH +21.0%、成长跑赢价值+7.0、VIX 29->20)，处于金发女孩象限、油价下跌-15.5%。这波反弹纯属仓位驱动——最高贝塔群体在低点暴涨最猛——随后急剧逆转。

2022-08-15.title: Hawkish reset and crypto-winter new lows
2022-08-15.body: Powell's Jackson Hole hawkishness and crypto-winter contagion drove a 64% collapse to new lows into late December as yields surged (TLT -12.8%) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. Defensives held (-2.3%) vs cyclicals -6.7% in a broadening tape (RSP +3.9% vs SPY); the pre-AI cohort was among the most distressed in the market (SMH -19.0% vs SPY -11.4%).
2022-08-15.title_zh: 鹰派重置与加密寒冬再创新低
2022-08-15.body_zh: 鲍威尔在杰克逊霍尔的鹰派表态与加密寒冬传染推动篮子暴跌64%，在12月底创新低，收益率飙升(TLT -12.8%)，处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。防御股守住(-2.3%) vs 周期股-6.7%，处于转宽行情(RSP跑赢SPY +3.9%)；AI前时代的这批个股是市场中最困顿的群体之一(SMH -19.0% vs SPY -11.4%)。
drivers_zh: 鲍威尔鹰派/收益率上行(TLT -12.8%)

2022-12-28.title: GPU-cloud thesis born in a risk-on melt-up
2022-12-28.body: From the December 2022 low, generative AI created the GPU-cloud leasing thesis, and these high-beta hosts exploded 560% as compute scarcity made leased capacity precious. The macro was a tech-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +60.4%, growth>value +25.8, VIX 22->14, DXY -4.5%) in a goldilocks quad, narrow at the top (RSP -9.5% vs SPY). The ChatGPT catalyst turned distressed miners into AI-infrastructure plays.
2022-12-28.title_zh: 风险偏好熔涨中GPU云逻辑诞生
2022-12-28.body_zh: 从2022年12月低点起，生成式AI催生了GPU云租赁逻辑，这些高贝塔托管商暴涨560%，因算力稀缺使租赁产能变得珍贵。宏观是科技引领的风险偏好熔涨(SMH +60.4%、成长跑赢价值+25.8、VIX 22->14、DXY -4.5%)，处于金发女孩象限、顶部窄幅(RSP跑输SPY -9.5%)。ChatGPT催化剂将困顿矿企转变为AI基础设施标的。

2023-07-13.title: Rate-driven summer pullback
2023-07-13.body: A 57% pullback hit as long yields surged through autumn 2023 (TLT -17.6%) and the dollar firmed +6.4% in a reflation/growth-up quad, with the AI rally pausing. VIX rose 14->22 and breadth narrowed (RSP -4.1% vs SPY); the basket's high-beta, capital-intensive profile amplified the rate-driven drawdown (SMH -10.2% vs SPY -6.0%).
2023-07-13.body_zh: 随着长端收益率在2023年秋季飙升(TLT -17.6%)、美元在再通胀/增长向上象限走强+6.4%、AI上涨暂歇，篮子回调57%。VIX升至14->22、广度收窄(RSP跑输SPY -4.1%)；其高贝塔、重资本属性放大了利率驱动的回撤(SMH -10.2% vs SPY -6.0%)。

2023-10-20.title: Yield-peak GPU rip on a risk-on turn
2023-10-20.body: As long yields peaked in late October 2023 and reversed hard (TLT +21.9%), these GPU hosts ripped 180% into year-end on insatiable AI-compute demand, riding a risk-on turn (SMH +24.5%, VIX 22->12, DXY -4.9%) in a reflation/growth-up quad with breadth broadening (RSP +2.2% vs SPY). Falling rates plus scarcity supercharged the high-beta move.
2023-10-20.title_zh: 风险偏好转向中收益率见顶后的GPU暴涨
2023-10-20.body_zh: 随着长端收益率在2023年10月底见顶并急剧反转(TLT +21.9%)，这些GPU托管商在年底前暴涨180%，受益于难以满足的AI算力需求，乘的是风险偏好转向(SMH +24.5%、VIX 22->12、DXY -4.9%)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限、广度转宽(RSP跑赢SPY +2.2%)。利率回落叠加稀缺性极大强化了这波高贝塔走势。

2023-12-27.title: Overbought high-beta flush
2023-12-27.body: A 51% flush in January 2024 unwound an overbought, over-owned position in the highest-beta AI corner, with yields ticking up (TLT -7.1%) in a calm-VIX slowdown quad and breadth narrow (RSP -3.2% vs SPY). It was a positioning reset, not a demand change — the high-beta basket simply gave back the overshoot.
2023-12-27.body_zh: 2024年1月的51%回吐平掉了AI最高贝塔领域中超买、过度持仓的头寸，收益率小幅上行(TLT -7.1%)，处于VIX平静的放缓象限、广度窄幅(RSP跑输SPY -3.2%)。这是仓位重置而非需求变化——高贝塔篮子只是回吐了超涨。

2024-01-24.title: CoreWeave-era buildout in a narrow goldilocks tape
2024-01-24.body: A 272% run powered by massive GPU-cloud capacity deals and AI-compute demand carried the basket into December 2024, with Fed cuts from September adding fuel. The tape was a tech-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +29.2%, growth>value +10.4, ultra-calm VIX 13->13) in a goldilocks quad, narrow at the top (RSP -6.2% vs SPY) even as the dollar firmed +2.6%. Leased GPU economics looked structurally scarce and richly priced.
2024-01-24.title_zh: 窄幅金发女孩行情中CoreWeave时代的建设
2024-01-24.body_zh: 由大规模GPU云产能交易与AI算力需求驱动的272%上涨将篮子带入2024年12月，9月起的美联储降息添了一把火。行情是科技引领的风险偏好熔涨(SMH +29.2%、成长跑赢价值+10.4、VIX超低13->13)，处于金发女孩象限、顶部窄幅(RSP跑输SPY -6.2%)，尽管美元走强+2.6%。租赁GPU经济效益看上去结构性稀缺且估值丰厚。
drivers_zh: 窄幅风险偏好熔涨(SMH +29.2%, RSP -6.2%)

2024-12-06.title: DeepSeek and tariff plunge in a VIX panic
2024-12-06.body: DeepSeek's cheap-AI scare hit the capital-intensive hosts hard on fears efficient models would slash GPU demand, then deepened in the Liberation Day tariff crash. It was a flight-to-safety panic — VIX exploded 13->52, defensives held (-6.7%) vs cyclicals -18.5%, high-beta crushed (SPHB-SPLV -22.7) — and the high-beta basket led the wreck (SMH -27.3% vs SPY -17.8%), falling 57% to its April 8 bottom.
2024-12-06.body_zh: DeepSeek廉价AI恐慌对重资本托管商打击沉重，市场担忧高效模型会大幅削减GPU需求，随后在“解放日”关税崩盘中加深。这是一次避险恐慌——VIX从13暴涨至52、防御股守住(-6.7%) vs 周期股-18.5%、高贝塔被重创(SPHB-SPLV -22.7)——高贝塔篮子领跌(SMH -27.3% vs SPY -17.8%)，下跌57%至4月8日底部。

2025-04-08.title: Compute-scarcity melt-up, strongest in the complex
2025-04-08.body: The tariff pause and proof that AI-compute demand only accelerated drove a 570% melt-up, the strongest in the AI complex, as GPU-leasing backlogs swelled. It rode the most violent risk-on reset of the cycle (VIX collapsed 52->16, high-beta dominated SPHB-SPLV +122.0) in a reflation/growth-up quad with Tech +114.0% leading, narrow at the top (RSP -13.1% vs SPY). The run survived the late-2025 valuation reset and the Hormuz shock, with the early-June Broadcom miss its first real test.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 算力稀缺熔涨，板块最强
2025-04-08.body_zh: 关税暂停加上AI算力需求只增不减的验证，推动篮子熔涨570%，为AI板块最强，因GPU租赁订单积压膨胀。它乘的是本周期最猛烈的风险偏好重置(VIX从52崩至16、高贝塔主导SPHB-SPLV +122.0)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限、科技+114.0%领涨、顶部窄幅(RSP跑输SPY -13.1%)。这轮上涨挺过了2025年末估值重置与霍尔木兹冲击，6月初博通不及预期是其首次真正考验。
drivers_zh: 猛烈风险偏好重置(VIX 52->16, 高贝塔+122.0)

mag7.now: The Magnificent Seven are rolling over, lagging on relative strength as the early-June Broadcom-led semis wipeout and a regime turn eroded mega-cap leadership. The tape is reflation/growth-up but hawkish underneath — DXY +3.4%, growth lagging value (-15.2), and crucially breadth is broadening (RSP +2.9% vs SPY), the opposite of the narrow mega-cap melt-ups that carried the seven. With NVDA and the AI-capex names under pressure and rates biased higher, the cohort that led the market is now the source of its drag.
mag7.now_zh: 七巨头(Magnificent Seven)正在见顶回落，相对强度落后，因6月初博通引领的半导体暴跌与体制转向侵蚀了大盘股领导地位。行情为再通胀/增长向上但底层偏鹰——美元DXY +3.4%、成长跑输价值(-15.2)，关键是市场广度正在转宽(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)，与曾扛起七巨头的窄幅大盘股熔涨相反。在英伟达(NVDA)及AI资本开支个股承压、利率偏向上行之际，曾领涨大盘的这一群体如今成了拖累来源。

2021-11-19.title: Mega-cap rate de-rating, quality cushions
2021-11-19.body: The 2022 Fed-hiking cycle de-rated even the mega-cap leaders as yields surged (TLT -10.7%) and the dollar firmed +3.1% in a stagflation-ish quad, with the Russia-Ukraine shock hitting sentiment. It was a flight-to-safety (defensives +1.2% vs cyclicals -3.4%, VIX 18->32) in a broadening tape (RSP +4.3% vs SPY); the quality of the seven cushioned the fall relative to speculative tech (SMH -23.1% vs the cohort's -25.3%).
2021-11-19.title_zh: 大盘股利率估值下修，质地缓冲
2021-11-19.body_zh: 2022年美联储加息周期甚至下修了大盘龙头估值，收益率飙升(TLT -10.7%)、美元在类滞胀象限走强+3.1%，俄乌冲击打击情绪。这是避险(防御股+1.2% vs 周期股-3.4%、VIX 18->32)，处于转宽行情(RSP跑赢SPY +4.3%)；七巨头的质地相对投机性科技股缓冲了跌幅(SMH -23.1%，篮子-25.3%)。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息/收益率上行(TLT -10.7%)

2022-03-14.title: Quality-led relief on a risk-on bounce
2022-03-14.body: A 24% bounce off oversold levels saw the highest-quality mega-caps lead as VIX collapsed 32->19 and growth beat value (+9.5) in a reflation/growth-up quad. It was a narrow mega-cap-led tape (RSP -3.0% vs SPY) — exactly where the seven shine — and the relief faded as the hiking path steepened.
2022-03-14.title_zh: 风险偏好反弹中质地驱动的修复
2022-03-14.body_zh: 从超卖水平反弹24%，最高质地的大盘股领涨，VIX从32崩至19、成长跑赢价值(+9.5)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限。这是窄幅大盘股领导行情(RSP跑输SPY -3.0%)——正是七巨头闪光之处——随着加息路径变陡，这波修复消退。

2022-04-04.title: Real-yield repricing in a stagflation flush
2022-04-04.body: Surging real yields (TLT -14.7%), a faster hiking path and a stronger dollar (+4.7%) drove the seven down 33% into June in a stagflation-ish quad. The flight-to-safety was deep (defensives -11.5% vs cyclicals -17.1%, VIX 19->33); even high-quality mega-cap multiples could not escape the rate repricing (Tech -23.5% vs SPY -19.7%).
2022-04-04.title_zh: 类滞胀冲洗中的实际收益率重定价
2022-04-04.body_zh: 实际收益率飙升(TLT -14.7%)、更快加息路径与美元走强(+4.7%)推动七巨头在6月前下跌33%，处于类滞胀象限。避险很深(防御股-11.5% vs 周期股-17.1%、VIX 19->33)；即便高质地大盘股估值也无法逃脱利率重定价(科技-23.5% vs SPY -19.7%)。

2022-06-16.title: Peak-rate-hope rally on a risk-on melt-up
2022-06-16.body: A 27% summer rally fired on hopes the worst of tightening was priced, with mega-caps leading as the tape went risk-on (SMH +20.8%, growth>value +9.2, VIX 33->20) in a goldilocks quad with oil crashing -24.0%. The move was sentiment-driven and unwound into autumn.
2022-06-16.title_zh: 风险偏好熔涨中的利率见顶预期反弹
2022-06-16.body_zh: 27%的夏季反弹源于市场预期最糟紧缩已被消化，大盘股领涨，行情转向风险偏好(SMH +20.8%、成长跑赢价值+9.2、VIX 33->20)，处于金发女孩象限、油价崩跌-24.0%。这波由情绪驱动的走势在秋季回落。

2022-08-15.title: Final tightening leg, rate-driven low
2022-08-15.body: Hawkish Fed messaging and surging yields (TLT -12.8%) drove a 36% slide to the late-December 2022 cycle low in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. It was a broad, rate-led drawdown (defensives -2.3% vs cyclicals -6.7%, breadth broadened RSP +3.9% vs SPY); the seven bottomed (Tech -19.5% vs SPY -11.4%) just before the AI narrative reignited mega-cap leadership.
2022-08-15.title_zh: 紧缩末段、利率驱动的低点
2022-08-15.body_zh: 鹰派的美联储表态与飙升的收益率(TLT -12.8%)推动七巨头下跌36%，至2022年12月底的周期低点，处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。这是广泛、由利率驱动的回撤(防御股-2.3% vs 周期股-6.7%、广度转宽RSP跑赢SPY +3.9%)；七巨头见底(科技-19.5% vs SPY -11.4%)恰好在AI叙事重燃大盘股领导地位前。
drivers_zh: 美联储鹰派/收益率上行(TLT -12.8%)

2022-12-28.title: AI mega-cap supremacy in a narrow melt-up
2022-12-28.body: From the December 2022 low, the generative-AI boom concentrated gains in the seven, a 270% run as NVDA, MSFT and the cohort captured the AI capex and monetization wave. The macro was a tech-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +157.5%, growth>value +70.5, VIX 22->14) in a goldilocks quad, and crucially extremely narrow — equal-weight lagged cap-weight by -32.4% — the mega-cap-led tape the seven define. Fed cuts from September 2024 extended the dominance despite the yen-carry air-pocket.
drivers: narrow mega-cap melt-up (SMH +157%, RSP -32.4% vs SPY)
2022-12-28.title_zh: 窄幅熔涨中的AI大盘股霸权
2022-12-28.body_zh: 从2022年12月低点起，生成式AI热潮将涨幅集中于七巨头，上涨270%，因英伟达、微软等捕获了AI资本开支与变现浪潮。宏观是科技引领的风险偏好熔涨(SMH +157.5%、成长跑赢价值+70.5、VIX 22->14)，处于金发女孩象限，且关键是极度窄幅——等权跑输市值权重-32.4%——正是七巨头定义的大盘股行情。2024年9月起的美联储降息延续了主导地位，尽管经历日元套息空气陷阱。
drivers_zh: 生成式AI热潮/英伟达/微软
窄幅大盘股熔涨(SMH +157%, RSP跑输SPY -32.4%)

2024-12-24.title: DeepSeek and tariff drawdown in a VIX panic
2024-12-24.body: The DeepSeek cheap-AI scare and April's Liberation Day tariff crash drove a 29% drawdown, with NVDA and the AI-levered names leading the decline. It was a flight-to-safety panic — VIX exploded 14->52, defensives held (-3.8%) vs cyclicals -15.7%, high-beta crushed (SPHB-SPLV -23.2) — in a broadening tape (RSP +3.7% vs SPY); the cohort bottomed (Tech -25.1% vs SPY -17.2%) around April 8 with the broad market.
2024-12-24.body_zh: DeepSeek廉价AI恐慌与4月“解放日”关税崩盘推动七巨头回撤29%，英伟达及AI高敞口个股领跌。这是一次避险恐慌——VIX从14暴涨至52、防御股守住(-3.8%) vs 周期股-15.7%、高贝塔被重创(SPHB-SPLV -23.2)——处于转宽行情(RSP跑赢SPY +3.7%)；该群体在4月8日前后随大盘见底(科技-25.1% vs SPY -17.2%)。

2025-04-08.title: AI-capex leadership returns on a risk-on reset
2025-04-08.body: The tariff pause and a resurgent AI-capex melt-up drove a 73% recovery as mega-cap earnings power reasserted itself, riding a violent risk-on reset (VIX collapsed 52->17, high-beta dominated SPHB-SPLV +68.1, DXY -3.6%) in a goldilocks quad with Tech +69.7% leading. It was a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP -15.1% vs SPY) — the seven reclaimed leadership before topping in late October 2025.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 风险偏好重置中AI资本开支领导地位回归
2025-04-08.body_zh: 关税暂停与重燃的AI资本开支熔涨推动七巨头复苏73%，大盘股盈利能力重新确立，乘的是猛烈风险偏好重置(VIX从52崩至17、高贝塔主导SPHB-SPLV +68.1、DXY -3.6%)，处于金发女孩象限、科技+69.7%领涨。这是窄幅大盘股行情(RSP跑输SPY -15.1%)——七巨头夺回领导地位，随后在2025年10月底见顶。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好重置(VIX 52->17, 高贝塔+68.1)

2025-10-29.title: Valuation reset and oil shock, broadening tape
2025-10-29.body: A late-2025 hawkish valuation reset, then the 2026 Hormuz oil shock (oil +70.1%) lifting CPI to ~4.2% and a Fed hiking bias drove an 18% pullback in a stagflation-ish quad. Crucially the tape broadened hard against the seven — equal-weight beat cap-weight by +8.2% as Energy +42.9% led and growth lagged value (-19.5) — though the cohort's quality limited the damage (SMH only -1.3% vs Tech -15.9%).
2025-10-29.title_zh: 估值重置与石油冲击，行情转宽
2025-10-29.body_zh: 2025年末的鹰派估值重置，随后2026年霍尔木兹石油冲击(油价+70.1%)将CPI推升至约4.2%、美联储转向加息倾向，推动七巨头在类滞胀象限回撤18%。关键是行情对七巨头大幅转宽——等权跑赢市值权重+8.2%，能源+42.9%领涨、成长跑输价值(-19.5)——尽管其质地限制了损失(SMH仅-1.3% vs 科技-15.9%)。
drivers_zh: 霍尔木兹石油冲击(油价+70.1%)
美联储加息倾向/广度转宽(RSP +8.2%)

2026-03-30.title: Ceasefire bounce, then roll-over as breadth broadens
2026-03-30.body: The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire fueled a 29% bounce, riding a tech-led risk-on snapback (SMH +65.5%, growth>value +10.3, VIX 31->16) in a reflation/growth-up quad, narrow at the top (RSP -8.8% vs SPY). But the rally stalled as the early-June Broadcom-led semis wipeout and broadening breadth (RSP now +2.9% vs SPY) eroded mega-cap leadership — the cohort is rolling over with NVDA and AI-capex names leading the market lower.
2026-03-30.title_zh: 停火反弹，随后随广度转宽见顶回落
2026-03-30.body_zh: 6月中旬霍尔木兹海峡停火推动29%反弹，乘的是科技引领的风险偏好回升(SMH +65.5%、成长跑赢价值+10.3、VIX 31->16)，处于再通胀/增长向上象限、顶部窄幅(RSP跑输SPY -8.8%)。但随着6月初博通引领的半导体暴跌与市场广度转宽(RSP现跑赢SPY +2.9%)侵蚀大盘股领导地位，反弹停滞——该群体正在见顶回落，英伟达与AI资本开支个股领跌大盘。

ai_semiconductors.now: Rolling over from an 87th-percentile high. After a +119% spring-2026 melt-up the AI-chip leaders (Nvidia/AMD/Broadcom/TSMC) are fading as breadth broadens away from mega-cap (RSP beat SPY +2.9%) and a post-Hormuz hawkish Fed with a stronger dollar (+3.4% DXY) caps long-duration multiples. SMH is still up 67.9% but this high-beta basket (SPHB-SPLV +20.7) had amplified the risk-on tape on the way up and is now first to give back leadership.
ai_semiconductors.now_zh: 从87百分位高位回落。在2026年春季+119%飙升之后,AI芯片龙头(英伟达/AMD/博通/台积电)动能减弱,市场广度从大盘股扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%),霍尔木兹冲击后偏鹰的美联储叠加走强的美元(DXY +3.4%)压制长久期估值。SMH仍上涨67.9%,但这只高贝塔篮子(SPHB-SPLV +20.7)上行时放大了风险偏好行情,如今率先交出领导力。

2021-12-27.title: Fed-hiking bear crushes high-beta chips
2021-12-27.body: AI-chip names fell 35% as the Fed pivoted to aggressive hikes — yields surged (TLT -21.4%) and the dollar ripped +9.4%, a textbook rate shock for long-duration tech. The regime was a risk-off flight-to-safety (VIX 18->27, high-beta lagged low-vol by -19.5%) into a stagflation-ish quad, and this high-beta basket amplified it: SMH -38.1% versus SPY -19.5%. Real-yield compression plus digestion of the pandemic semis over-order hit the richest GPU/accelerator multiples hardest.
2021-12-27.title_zh: 美联储加息熊市重创高贝塔芯片
2021-12-27.body_zh: AI芯片股下跌35%,因美联储转向激进加息——收益率飙升(TLT -21.4%)、美元大涨+9.4%,是典型的长久期科技股利率冲击。当时处于避险的资金奔向安全资产(VIX 18->27,高贝塔跑输低波-19.5%)的类滞胀象限,这只高贝塔篮子放大了行情:SMH -38.1% 对 SPY -19.5%。实际收益率压缩叠加疫情期间芯片超额订单消化,对估值最高的GPU/加速器名字打击最重。

2022-07-01.title: Semis-led bear bounce on peak-inflation hope
2022-07-01.body: A sharp +38% bear-market rally as peak-inflation hopes eased VIX 27->20 (bonds roughly flat, TLT -0.6%) — a tech/semis-led risk-on burst (semis +23.4% vs SPY +12.2%, growth>value +6.7) in a goldilocks-flavored quad. As a high-beta basket it led the squeeze higher, but the move was positioning, not a fundamental turn, with semis still facing demand cuts.
2022-07-01.title_zh: 半导体领涨的熊市反弹,押注通胀见顶
2022-07-01.body_zh: 通胀见顶预期令VIX回落27->20(债券基本持平,TLT -0.6%),带来+38%急剧熊市反弹——这是一轮科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好爆发(半导体+23.4% 对 SPY +12.2%,成长跑赢价值+6.7)的类金发姑娘象限。作为高贝塔篮子,它领涨这波挤压,但此乃仓位驱动而非基本面转向,芯片需求仍面临下修。

2022-08-18.title: Jackson Hole hawkish leg down
2022-08-18.body: Chips fell another 32% into the October low as Powell's Jackson Hole speech killed the pivot trade — yields surged again (TLT -13.8%) and the dollar pushed +5.4% in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad (VIX 20->32). The macro de-rating compounded a theme-specific blow: the first US export-control rules on advanced Nvidia/AMD data-center GPUs to China amplified the high-beta drawdown (SMH -28.4% vs SPY -16.1%).
2022-08-18.body_zh: 鲍威尔在杰克逊霍尔的讲话击碎转向交易,芯片再跌32%至10月低点——收益率再度飙升(TLT -13.8%)、美元推升+5.4%,处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限(VIX 20->32)。宏观估值下杀叠加主题利空:美国首次对华先进英伟达/AMD数据中心GPU出口管制,放大了高贝塔回撤(SMH -28.4% 对 SPY -16.1%)。

2022-10-14.title: The genAI supercycle melt-up
2022-10-14.body: A monster +381% run off the October-2022 low, ignited by ChatGPT and Nvidia's blowout 2023 data-center guidance and supercharged by a goldilocks risk-on regime: VIX collapsed 32->13, growth crushed value by +55.3, the dollar fell -7.3% and breadth narrowed hard (RSP lagged SPY -28.4%) — a mega-cap-led tape this high-beta basket led from the front (SMH +230.6% vs SPY +61.1%). AI accelerator demand became the dominant market narrative through the 2024 Fed-cut tape.
2022-10-14.body_zh: 从2022年10月低点起涨+381%,由ChatGPT和英伟达2023年爆表的数据中心指引点燃,并被金发姑娘式风险偏好行情助燃:VIX崩落32->13,成长大幅跑赢价值+55.3,美元下跌-7.3%,市场广度急剧收窄(RSP跑输SPY -28.4%)——这只高贝塔篮子在大盘股主导的行情中一马当先(SMH +230.6% 对 SPY +61.1%)。AI加速器需求成为市场主导叙事,贯穿2024年美联储降息行情。

2024-07-10.title: Yen-carry unwind shakeout
2024-07-10.body: A swift -27% drop as the August yen-carry unwind forced deleveraging across crowded AI longs — VIX spiked 13->28 in a flight-to-safety where defensives (+2.2%) beat cyclicals (-5.5%) and breadth broadened (RSP beat SPY +6.6%). The slowdown-scare risk-off hit this leveraged high-beta basket disproportionately (SMH -24.8% vs SPY -7.6%) before chips quickly stabilized.
2024-07-10.body_zh: 8月日元套息平仓迫使拥挤的AI多头去杠杆,快速下跌27%——VIX飙升13->28,避险行情中防御板块(+2.2%)跑赢周期股(-5.5%),市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +6.6%)。放缓恐慌的避险对这只带杠杆的高贝塔篮子打击格外严重(SMH -24.8% 对 SPY -7.6%),芯片随后迅速企稳。

2024-08-07.title: Cut-cycle relief rally, mega-cap-led
2024-08-07.body: A +66% recovery into January 2025 as the Fed's September cut and election-driven risk appetite revived AI-capex enthusiasm — a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up (VIX 28->15, growth>value +13.9) even as yields rose (TLT -7.2%) and the dollar firmed +4.8%. Breadth stayed narrow (RSP lagged SPY -5.7%), and Blackwell anticipation plus hyperscaler orders carried this high-beta basket (SMH +26.9%) to new highs.
2024-08-07.title_zh: 降息周期反弹,大盘股主导
2024-08-07.body_zh: 美联储9月降息和大选后风险偏好重燃AI资本开支热情,回升+66%至2025年1月——这是一轮科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好飙升(VIX 28->15,成长跑赢价值+13.9),尽管收益率上行(TLT -7.2%)、美元走强+4.8%。市场广度保持狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -5.7%),对Blackwell的预期和云厂订单推动这只高贝塔篮子(SMH +26.9%)创新高。

2025-01-22.title: DeepSeek scare into the tariff crash
2025-01-22.body: Chips fell 42% as the late-January DeepSeek shock questioned whether AI could be trained far cheaper, then April's reciprocal-tariff crash deepened the rout — a violent risk-off flush with VIX exploding 15->45 and high-beta cratering vs low-vol by -27.1%. Defensives (-2.2%) beat cyclicals (-16.3%) in a slowdown-scare quad, and this leveraged basket amplified the move (SMH -32.3% vs SPY -16.4%); notably yields fell (TLT +7.2%) and the dollar weakened, so it was a growth-scare, not a rate, selloff.
2025-01-22.body_zh: 1月底DeepSeek冲击引发对AI训练可大幅降本的质疑,芯片下跌42%,随后4月对等关税崩盘加深跌势——这是一场剧烈的避险抛售,VIX暴涨15->45,高贝塔相对低波重挫-27.1%。在放缓恐慌象限中防御板块(-2.2%)跑赢周期股(-16.3%),这只带杠杆篮子放大了跌幅(SMH -32.3% 对 SPY -16.4%);值得注意的是收益率下行(TLT +7.2%)、美元走弱,所以这是成长恐慌而非利率主导的抛售。

2025-04-04.title: Post-tariff AI melt-up, V-shaped
2025-04-04.body: A +153% surge off the April low as tariff fears faded and a goldilocks risk-on regime roared back — VIX collapsed 45->17, high-beta beat low-vol by a massive +67.5, growth>value +28.3, and a weaker dollar (-3.1%) added fuel. Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -15.2%), a mega-cap melt-up this high-beta basket led (SMH +100.8% vs SPY +35.8%); Nvidia, Broadcom's custom-ASIC wins and TSMC pricing power drove the leaders to fresh records.
2025-04-04.body_zh: 关税担忧消退、金发姑娘式风险偏好行情卷土重来,从4月低点飙升+153%——VIX崩落45->17,高贝塔大幅跑赢低波+67.5,成长跑赢价值+28.3,走弱的美元(-3.1%)添柴。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -15.2%),这是一轮由这只高贝塔篮子领涨的大盘股飙升(SMH +100.8% 对 SPY +35.8%);英伟达、博通的定制ASIC订单和台积电定价权推动龙头创新高。

2025-10-31.title: Late-2025 hawkish reset, leadership broadens out
2025-10-31.body: A -27% pullback as a hawkish Fed reset and circular AI-financing worries pressured the richest multiples. Tellingly, this was a leadership rotation rather than a market crash: SPY only fell -6.8% and breadth broadened sharply (RSP beat SPY +7.7%) in a stagflation-ish quad, so capital left over-owned high-beta AI chips (SMH flat at +0.2%) for the rest of the tape. Vendor-financing-loop and concentration fears took the froth out of the leaders.
2025-10-31.body_zh: 鹰派的美联储重置和对AI循环融资的担忧压制最高估值,回调27%。值得注意的是,这是领导力轮动而非市场崩盘:SPY仅下跌-6.8%,市场广度急剧扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +7.7%),处于类滞胀象限,资金从被过度持有的高贝塔AI芯片(SMH持平+0.2%)流向其余板块。对供应商融资闭环和集中度风险的担忧挤出了龙头泡沫。

2026-03-30.title: Hormuz-shock rebound, then top
2026-03-30.body: A +119% rebound from the spring low survived the Iran/Hormuz oil shock and CPI spike, riding a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up (VIX 31->16, growth>value +10.9) into the mid-June ceasefire. The advance stayed narrow (RSP lagged SPY -8.6%), a mega-cap-led tape this high-beta basket amplified (SMH +74.4% vs SPY +19.9%). By early June Broadcom's results flagged narrowing breadth, leaving the group rolling over from extreme highs.
2026-03-30.title_zh: 霍尔木兹冲击后反弹再见顶
2026-03-30.body_zh: 从春季低点反弹+119%,熬过伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击和CPI跳升,搭乘科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好飙升(VIX 31->16,成长跑赢价值+10.9),在6月中旬停火前后见顶。这波上涨广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -8.6%),是被这只高贝塔篮子放大的大盘股行情(SMH +74.4% 对 SPY +19.9%)。6月初博通业绩暴露市场广度收窄,该板块从极端高位开始回落。

memory_storage.now: Topping at the 95th percentile and the No.1 relative-strength basket. A 2025-26 DRAM/HBM/NAND undersupply super-cycle drove an extraordinary run in Micron/SK Hynix, but with SMH +67.9%, breadth now broadening (RSP beat SPY +2.9%) and a stronger dollar (+3.4% DXY) in a reflation/growth-up quad, the parabola looks exhausted. As the highest-beta semis sub-theme (it amplified the SPHB-SPLV +20.7 risk-on tape on the way up) it is the most exposed if the regime cools.
memory_storage.now_zh: 在95百分位见顶,是相对强度第一的篮子。2025-26年DRAM/HBM/NAND供不应求的超级周期推动美光/SK海力士飙升,但SMH +67.9%、市场广度开始扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)、美元走强(DXY +3.4%)处于再通胀/增长向上象限,抛物线显疲态。作为贝塔最高的半导体子主题(上行时放大了SPHB-SPLV +20.7的风险偏好行情),若行情降温它最为脆弱。

2022-01-04.title: Memory glut meets the rate-shock bear
2022-01-04.body: Memory fell 48% through 2022 as a brutal DRAM/NAND oversupply collided with a rate-shock bear: yields surged (TLT -29.1%, one of the worst bond years on record) and the dollar ripped +8.5% in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad with risk-off rotation into defensives (+0.4% vs cyclicals -8.6%). The high-beta drawdown (SMH -36.4% vs SPY -19.8%) compounded falling bit prices and bloated PC/handset inventories in a classic memory down-cycle.
2022-01-04.title_zh: 内存供过于求遭遇利率冲击熊市
2022-01-04.body_zh: 2022年内存下跌48%,严重的DRAM/NAND供过于求叠加利率冲击熊市:收益率飙升(TLT -29.1%,创纪录最差债券年之一),美元大涨+8.5%,处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限,资金避险转向防御板块(+0.4% 对 周期股-8.6%)。高贝塔回撤(SMH -36.4% 对 SPY -19.8%)叠加位价下跌、PC/手机库存高企,构成典型内存下行周期。

2022-12-28.title: Cycle trough to HBM dawn, on a narrow melt-up
2022-12-28.body: A +163% rally as memory makers slashed capex and capacity, tightening the cycle into 2024 — and the backdrop was a textbook tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up: VIX fell 22->12, growth crushed value by +56.6, but breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -27.1%), a mega-cap-led tape this high-beta basket led (SMH +182.2% vs SPY +48.3%). The genAI boom seeded the HBM story, making high-bandwidth memory the key bottleneck for AI accelerators.
2022-12-28.title_zh: 周期触底到HBM黎明,搭乘窄幅飙升
2022-12-28.body_zh: 内存厂商大砍资本开支和产能,周期收紧至2024年,反弹+163%——背景是教科书式的科技/半导体领涨风险偏好飙升:VIX回落22->12,成长大幅跑赢价值+56.6,但市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -27.1%),是被这只高贝塔篮子领涨的大盘股行情(SMH +182.2% 对 SPY +48.3%)。生成式AI热潮孕育HBM故事,使高带宽内存成为AI加速器的关键瓶颈。

2024-06-18.title: Carry-unwind correction
2024-06-18.body: A -25% pullback as the August yen-carry unwind and profit-taking hit the year's biggest winners — a flight-to-safety where VIX spiked 12->28 and defensives (+2.9%) beat cyclicals (-3.8%) in a slowdown-scare quad. This high-beta basket amplified the deleveraging (SMH -23.6% vs SPY -5.1%), but the dip was positioning-driven with the underlying HBM demand thesis intact.
2024-06-18.body_zh: 8月日元套息平仓和获利了结冲击全年最大赢家,回调25%——避险行情中VIX飙升12->28,防御板块(+2.9%)跑赢周期股(-3.8%),处于放缓恐慌象限。这只高贝塔篮子放大了去杠杆(SMH -23.6% 对 SPY -5.1%),但此跌由仓位驱动,底层HBM需求逻辑未变。

2024-08-07.title: HBM-led recovery on a risk-on tape
2024-08-07.body: A +25% recovery into February 2025 as Fed cuts and AI-server demand re-firmed HBM pricing — a tech/semis-led risk-on rebound (VIX 28->16, growth>value +11.9) even as the dollar firmed +3.0% and yields rose (TLT -5.7%). Breadth stayed narrow (RSP lagged SPY -6.0%) as SK Hynix and Micron qualified next-gen HBM for the leading accelerators, supporting the bid.
2024-08-07.title_zh: HBM主导复苏,搭乘风险偏好行情
2024-08-07.body_zh: 美联储降息和AI服务器需求重新巩固HBM价格,回升+25%至2025年2月——这是科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好反弹(VIX 28->16,成长跑赢价值+11.9),尽管美元走强+3.0%、收益率上行(TLT -5.7%)。市场广度保持狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -6.0%),SK海力士和美光为领先加速器认证次世代HBM,支撑买盘。

2025-02-20.title: DeepSeek & tariff risk-off drawdown
2025-02-20.body: Memory fell 37% as the DeepSeek scare and April's reciprocal-tariff crash hit AI hardware in a violent risk-off flush — VIX exploded 16->45, high-beta cratered vs low-vol by -23.6%, and defensives (-5.7%) beat cyclicals (-16.3%) in a slowdown-scare quad. This leveraged basket amplified the move (SMH -29.9% vs SPY -17.0%); a weaker dollar and falling yields confirm it was a growth-scare, not a rate, selloff that briefly clouded the memory super-cycle thesis.
2025-02-20.body_zh: DeepSeek恐慌和4月对等关税崩盘在剧烈避险抛售中冲击AI硬件,内存下跌37%——VIX暴涨16->45,高贝塔相对低波重挫-23.6%,放缓恐慌象限中防御板块(-5.7%)跑赢周期股(-16.3%)。这只带杠杆篮子放大了跌幅(SMH -29.9% 对 SPY -17.0%);美元走弱、收益率下行印证这是成长恐慌而非利率主导的抛售,一度遮蔽内存超级周期逻辑。

2025-04-04.title: Memory super-cycle melt-up to the top
2025-04-04.body: An extraordinary +1,754% run as a genuine 2025-26 undersupply super-cycle took hold across DRAM, HBM and NAND, riding a roaring risk-on regime: VIX collapsed 45->17 and high-beta beat low-vol by an enormous +124.5 in a reflation/growth-up quad. Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -13.4%), a mega-cap-led melt-up this highest-beta semis basket led from the front (SMH +271.1% vs SPY +49.0%). Spot and contract prices spiked as AI memory content per server soared while makers stayed capacity-disciplined into the mid-2026 top.
2025-04-04.title_zh: 内存超级周期飙升至顶
2025-04-04.body_zh: 2025-26年真实的供不应求超级周期席卷DRAM、HBM和NAND,惊人上涨+1,754%,搭乘狂热的风险偏好行情:VIX崩落45->17,高贝塔大幅跑赢低波+124.5,处于再通胀/增长向上象限。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -13.4%),这只贝塔最高的半导体篮子在大盘股飙升中一马当先(SMH +271.1% 对 SPY +49.0%)。AI服务器单机内存用量激增、厂商保持产能纪律,现货与合约价格飙升,直至2026年中见顶。

semicap_equipment.now: Topping at the 97th percentile. Wafer-fab equipment (ASML/AMAT/LRCX/KLAC) rode the AI-capex pick-and-shovel trade to extreme highs, but with SMH +67.9%, breadth broadening (RSP beat SPY +2.9%) and a stronger dollar (+3.4% DXY, a headwind for these export-heavy multinationals) in a reflation/growth-up quad, the China export-control overhang and a stretched high-beta leg (SPHB-SPLV +20.7) now argue for digestion.
semicap_equipment.now_zh: 在97百分位见顶。晶圆厂设备(ASML/AMAT/LRCX/KLAC)搭乘AI资本开支的卖铲逻辑冲至极端高位,但SMH +67.9%、市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)、美元走强(DXY +3.4%,对这些以出口为主的跨国公司构成逆风)处于再通胀/增长向上象限,中国出口管制阴影和过度拉伸的高贝塔涨势(SPHB-SPLV +20.7)如今指向消化。

2022-01-03.title: WFE down-cycle meets the rate-shock bear
2022-01-03.body: Equipment fell 41% as a memory/logic capex pause met a rate-shock bear: yields surged (TLT -19.0%) and the dollar ripped +9.2% in a stagflation-ish quad, with risk-off rotation into defensives (-2.4% vs cyclicals -13.5%, VIX 17->27). The high-beta drawdown (SMH -37.9% vs SPY -19.6%) was amplified by recession fears that compressed the cyclical WFE names as fab spend slowed.
2022-01-03.title_zh: 晶圆厂设备下行周期遭遇利率冲击熊市
2022-01-03.body_zh: 内存/逻辑资本开支暂停叠加利率冲击熊市,设备下跌41%:收益率飙升(TLT -19.0%),美元大涨+9.2%,处于类滞胀象限,资金避险转向防御板块(-2.4% 对 周期股-13.5%,VIX 17->27)。高贝塔回撤(SMH -37.9% 对 SPY -19.6%)被衰退担忧放大,晶圆厂支出放缓压缩了周期性的WFE名字。

2022-07-01.title: Bear-rally bounce on peak-inflation hope
2022-07-01.body: A +32% bounce on peak-inflation hopes and a brief yield reprieve (TLT +3.2%) as VIX eased 27->21 in a goldilocks-flavored quad (cyclicals +8.6% vs defensives +2.4%). This high-beta basket led the relief (SMH +25.2% vs SPY +8.6%), but the rally was short-lived as the broader semis capex outlook stayed cautious.
2022-07-01.title_zh: 熊市反弹,押注通胀见顶
2022-07-01.body_zh: 受通胀见顶预期和收益率短暂回落(TLT +3.2%)提振,反弹+32%,VIX回落27->21,处于类金发姑娘象限(周期股+8.6% 对 防御板块+2.4%)。这只高贝塔篮子领涨这波缓解(SMH +25.2% 对 SPY +8.6%),但由于半导体资本开支前景仍谨慎,反弹未能持续。

2022-08-04.title: October export-control shock, rate-driven
2022-08-04.body: WFE fell 31% into October as Jackson Hole hawkishness re-ignited the rate regime — yields surged again (TLT -17.0%) and the dollar pushed +7.2% (VIX 21->32). On top of the macro de-rating, sweeping US export controls on advanced chipmaking tools to China landed: the October 2022 rules directly threatened AMAT/LRCX/KLAC China revenue, deepening the high-beta drawdown (SMH -29.4% vs SPY -13.3%).
2022-08-04.body_zh: 杰克逊霍尔鹰派重新点燃利率行情,WFE跌至10月,下挫31%——收益率再度飙升(TLT -17.0%),美元推升+7.2%(VIX 21->32)。在宏观估值下杀之上,美国对华先进芯片制造工具的全面出口管制落地:2022年10月的规则直接威胁AMAT/LRCX/KLAC的中国收入,加深高贝塔回撤(SMH -29.4% 对 SPY -13.3%)。

2022-10-14.title: AI-capex pick-and-shovel melt-up
2022-10-14.body: A +170% run as the genAI buildout drove leading-edge and advanced-packaging tool orders, supercharged by a goldilocks risk-on regime: VIX collapsed 32->13, growth crushed value +47.6 and the dollar fell -8.0% (a tailwind for these multinationals). Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -24.1%), a mega-cap-led tape this high-beta basket led (SMH +221.7% vs SPY +62.1%). ASML's EUV backlog and TSMC's capacity expansion made WFE a core way to play the AI-capex wave through 2024.
2022-10-14.body_zh: 生成式AI建设潮推动先进制程和先进封装设备订单,上涨+170%,并被金发姑娘式风险偏好行情助燃:VIX崩落32->13,成长大幅跑赢价值+47.6,美元下跌-8.0%(对这些跨国公司构成顺风)。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -24.1%),是被这只高贝塔篮子领涨的大盘股行情(SMH +221.7% 对 SPY +62.1%)。ASML的EUV订单积压和台积电产能扩张,使WFE成为2024年间布局AI资本开支浪潮的核心方式。

2024-07-16.title: Tightened-curbs risk-off drawdown
2024-07-16.body: A deep -53% slide as the yen-carry unwind, DeepSeek scare and tightened China-tool export rules compounded across two flushes — VIX exploded 13->52 in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad where defensives (-1.2%) beat cyclicals (-11.8%). This high-beta basket was hit hardest (SMH -34.0% vs SPY -11.3%) as threats of broader equipment restrictions and a softer mainstream-node outlook layered onto the risk-off into the April-2025 low.
2024-07-16.body_zh: 日元套息平仓、DeepSeek恐慌和对华设备出口规则收紧在两轮抛售中叠加,深跌53%——VIX暴涨13->52,处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限,防御板块(-1.2%)跑赢周期股(-11.8%)。这只高贝塔篮子受创最重(SMH -34.0% 对 SPY -11.3%),更广泛设备限制的威胁和主流制程前景转弱叠加于避险之上,直至2025年4月低点。

2025-04-08.title: AI-capex super-rally to the top
2025-04-08.body: A +424% surge off the April low as record fab investment and HBM/leading-edge capacity additions drove tool demand, riding a roaring risk-on regime: VIX collapsed 52->17 and high-beta beat low-vol by a huge +124.5 in a reflation/growth-up quad. Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -12.3%), a mega-cap-led melt-up this high-beta basket amplified (SMH +272.9% vs SPY +51.7%). ASML, AMAT, LRCX and KLAC printed all-time highs into mid-2026, with the memory super-cycle adding a second leg of equipment orders before the top.
2025-04-08.title_zh: AI资本开支超级反弹至顶
2025-04-08.body_zh: 创纪录的晶圆厂投资和HBM/先进制程产能扩张推动设备需求,从4月低点飙升+424%,搭乘狂热的风险偏好行情:VIX崩落52->17,高贝塔大幅跑赢低波+124.5,处于再通胀/增长向上象限。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -12.3%),这是被这只高贝塔篮子放大的大盘股飙升(SMH +272.9% 对 SPY +51.7%)。ASML、AMAT、LRCX和KLAC在2026年中前创历史新高,内存超级周期为设备订单增添第二条腿,随后见顶。
drivers_zh: 创纪录晶圆厂资本开支

non_ai_tech.now: Topping at the 89th percentile. Legacy and diversified tech hardware, networking and non-AI analog/MCU semis got swept up in the broad 2025-26 tech melt-up (SMH +67.9%), but with breadth now broadening away from mega-cap (RSP beat SPY +2.9%), a stronger dollar (+3.4% DXY, a headwind for these multinational hardware names) and a still-stretched high-beta tape (SPHB-SPLV +20.7), the move looks extended versus its non-AI fundamentals.
non_ai_tech.now_zh: 在89百分位见顶。传统及多元化科技硬件、网络设备和非AI模拟/MCU芯片被2025-26年广泛的科技飙升裹挟(SMH +67.9%),但市场广度开始从大盘股扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)、美元走强(DXY +3.4%,对这些跨国硬件名字构成逆风),高贝塔行情仍过度拉伸(SPHB-SPLV +20.7),相对其非AI基本面,涨势显得过度拉伸。

2022-01-04.title: Rate-shock hardware reset
2022-01-04.body: Non-AI tech fell 25% as a rate-shock bear hit hardware multiples and demand: yields surged (TLT -18.0%) and the dollar ripped +10.6% in a stagflation-ish quad, with risk-off rotation into defensives (-3.7% vs cyclicals -15.8%, VIX 17->28). Cooling PC, handset and analog/MCU end-markets met a sharp valuation reset, and the basket's high beta amplified the drawdown (SMH -37.2% vs SPY -19.4%).
2022-01-04.body_zh: 利率冲击熊市冲击硬件估值和需求,非AI科技下跌25%:收益率飙升(TLT -18.0%)、美元大涨+10.6%,处于类滞胀象限,资金避险转向防御板块(-3.7% 对 周期股-15.8%,VIX 17->28)。降温的PC、手机和模拟/MCU终端市场遭遇急剧估值重置,篮子的高贝塔放大了回撤(SMH -37.2% 对 SPY -19.4%)。

2022-07-05.title: Summer semis-led bear bounce
2022-07-05.body: A +22% rebound on a brief peak-inflation narrative — a tech/semis-led risk-on burst (semis +22.7%, growth>value +4.6, VIX 28->20) in a reflation/growth-up quad. The bounce faded as recession and inventory worries persisted across legacy hardware, with the move tracking the broader high-beta squeeze rather than any non-AI fundamental turn.
2022-07-05.title_zh: 夏季半导体领涨熊市反弹
2022-07-05.body_zh: 受通胀见顶叙事短暂提振,反弹+22%——这是科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好爆发(半导体+22.7%,成长跑赢价值+4.6,VIX 28->20)的再通胀/增长向上象限。由于传统硬件的衰退和库存担忧持续,反弹逐渐消退,此波跟随更广泛的高贝塔挤压而非任何非AI基本面转向。

2022-08-18.title: Hawkish, rate-driven leg into the low
2022-08-18.body: A 20% drop into October as Jackson Hole reset rate expectations higher — yields surged (TLT -12.3%) and the dollar pushed +5.4% in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad (VIX 20->34). Soft consumer-electronics demand and inventory corrections compounded the rate-driven de-rating (SMH -27.4% vs SPY -16.3%).
2022-08-18.title_zh: 鹰派利率驱动下探至低点
2022-08-18.body_zh: 杰克逊霍尔将利率预期上调,跌至10月,下挫20%——收益率飙升(TLT -12.3%)、美元推升+5.4%,处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限(VIX 20->34)。疲软的消费电子需求和库存调整叠加于利率驱动的估值下杀之上(SMH -27.4% 对 SPY -16.3%)。

2022-10-12.title: Steady recovery on a narrow tech melt-up
2022-10-12.body: A +83% recovery as the Fed-cut path and stabilizing hardware demand lifted the group, carried by a goldilocks risk-on melt-up: VIX collapsed 34->13, growth crushed value +45.2, the dollar fell -8.0% and breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -24.4%), a mega-cap-led tape (SMH +217.4%). The rally was milder than AI-levered peers, reflecting maturer end-markets and the 2024 inventory normalization.
2022-10-12.title_zh: 搭乘窄幅科技飙升稳步复苏
2022-10-12.body_zh: 美联储降息路径和企稳的硬件需求提振该板块,回升+83%,被金发姑娘式风险偏好飙升带动:VIX崩落34->13,成长大幅跑赢价值+45.2,美元下跌-8.0%,市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -24.4%),是大盘股主导的行情(SMH +217.4%)。涨幅较AI杠杆较高的同业温和,反映更成熟的终端市场和2024年的库存正常化。

2024-07-16.title: Carry-unwind air pocket
2024-07-16.body: A -18% dip during the August yen-carry unwind — a flight-to-safety where VIX spiked 13->28, defensives (+0.9%) beat cyclicals (-8.1%) and breadth broadened (RSP beat SPY +3.3%) in a slowdown-scare quad. Lower-beta non-AI tech held up better than the crowded AI trade, though it still amplified the broad risk-off (SMH -22.7% vs SPY -8.2%).
2024-07-16.body_zh: 8月日元套息平仓期间下跌18%——避险行情中VIX飙升13->28,防御板块(+0.9%)跑赢周期股(-8.1%),市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +3.3%),处于放缓恐慌象限。低贝塔的非AI科技比拥挤的AI交易更抗跌,但仍放大了广泛避险(SMH -22.7% 对 SPY -8.2%)。

2024-08-07.title: Modest cut-driven lift, mega-cap-led
2024-08-07.body: A +19% rise into February 2025 on the Fed's September cut and a firmer hardware cycle — a tech/semis-led risk-on tape (VIX 28->16, growth>value +11.9) though the dollar firmed +3.0% and yields rose (TLT -5.7%). Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -6.0%) and gains were restrained as the AI narrative siphoned leadership away from non-AI tech.
2024-08-07.title_zh: 降息温和提振,大盘股主导
2024-08-07.body_zh: 美联储9月降息和更稳固的硬件周期推动,回升+19%至2025年2月——这是科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好行情(VIX 28->16,成长跑赢价值+11.9),尽管美元走强+3.0%、收益率上行(TLT -5.7%)。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -6.0%),由于AI叙事将领导力从非AI科技吸走,涨幅受限。

2025-02-20.title: DeepSeek & tariff risk-off slide
2025-02-20.body: A 31% drop through the DeepSeek scare and April's reciprocal-tariff crash, in a violent risk-off flush: VIX exploded 16->52, high-beta cratered vs low-vol by -22.0%, and defensives (-7.7%) beat cyclicals (-18.3%) in a slowdown-scare quad. Hardware names with China exposure and consumer cyclicality were hit by tariff and demand fears, with the basket amplifying the de-risking (SMH -30.2% vs SPY -18.4%).
2025-02-20.body_zh: 经历DeepSeek恐慌和4月对等关税崩盘,在剧烈避险抛售中下跌31%:VIX暴涨16->52,高贝塔相对低波重挫-22.0%,放缓恐慌象限中防御板块(-7.7%)跑赢周期股(-18.3%)。具中国敞口和消费周期性的硬件名字受关税和需求担忧打击,篮子放大了去风险(SMH -30.2% 对 SPY -18.4%)。

2025-04-08.title: Broad tech melt-up sweep
2025-04-08.body: A +203% surge off the April low as a roaring risk-on regime lifted the entire tech complex: VIX collapsed 52->16, high-beta beat low-vol by a huge +121.4, the dollar fell -3.6% and growth>value +15.1 in a reflation/growth-up quad. Breadth stayed narrow (RSP lagged SPY -15.2%); the AI-capex melt-up and memory super-cycle spilled into networking silicon, analog/MCU and legacy hardware (SMH +252.4%), re-rating the whole group into the mid-2026 top.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 广泛科技飙升裹挟
2025-04-08.body_zh: 狂热的风险偏好行情提振整个科技板块,从4月低点飙升+203%:VIX崩落52->16,高贝塔大幅跑赢低波+121.4,美元下跌-3.6%,成长跑赢价值+15.1,处于再通胀/增长向上象限。市场广度保持狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -15.2%);AI资本开支飙升和内存超级周期外溢至网络芯片、模拟/MCU和传统硬件(SMH +252.4%),令整个板块估值重估,直至2026年中见顶。

non_ai_software.now: Trending but mid-pack on relative strength. As long-duration, rate-sensitive enterprise SaaS this basket is the most exposed to the rate leg of any regime: it lagged the AI leaders and just pulled back ~27% into late June as the post-Hormuz hawkish Fed bias and a firming dollar (+3.4% DXY) re-pressured software multiples, even as breadth broadened (RSP beat SPY +2.9%) in a reflation/growth-up quad.
non_ai_software.now_zh: 处于上升趋势但相对强度居中。作为长久期、利率敏感的企业SaaS,这只篮子对任何行情的利率部分最为敏感:它落后于AI龙头,6月底刚回调约27%,因霍尔木兹冲击后偏鹰的美联储倾向和走强的美元(DXY +3.4%)再度压制软件估值,尽管市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%),处于再通胀/增长向上象限。

2021-11-09.title: Duration-software de-rating in a rate-shock bear
2021-11-09.body: Non-AI software fell 47% as the Fed pivot hammered the longest-duration, profitless-growth SaaS names: yields surged (TLT -12.3%) and the dollar firmed +5.4% in a stagflation-ish, risk-off regime (VIX 18->32, defensives +1.3% vs cyclicals -5.1%). Rising discount rates and a hard valuation reset hit the high-multiple software complex hardest, with the basket's long duration amplifying the rate move (SMH -20.6% vs SPY -10.5%).
2021-11-09.title_zh: 久期软件估值下杀,处于利率冲击熊市
2021-11-09.body_zh: 美联储转向重击久期最长、尚未盈利的成长型SaaS名字,非AI软件下跌47%:收益率飙升(TLT -12.3%)、美元走强+5.4%,处于类滞胀、避险行情(VIX 18->32,防御板块+1.3% 对 周期股-5.1%)。贴现率上升和硬性估值重置对高估值软件板块打击最重,篮子的长久期放大了利率冲击(SMH -20.6% 对 SPY -10.5%)。

2022-03-14.title: Brief oversold bounce
2022-03-14.body: A +32% bounce off oversold conditions as rate volatility briefly eased (VIX 32->19) in a reflation/growth-up quad, with breadth narrow (RSP lagged SPY -3.0%). The relief faded fast with the hiking cycle still accelerating, a duration-sensitivity reflex rather than a regime turn.
2022-03-14.body_zh: 利率波动短暂缓和(VIX 32->19),从超卖状态反弹+32%,处于再通胀/增长向上象限,市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -3.0%)。加息周期仍在加速,缓解迅速消退,此乃久期敏感性的反射而非行情转向。

2022-04-04.title: Rate-driven new lows
2022-04-04.body: A 38% slide to mid-June lows as real yields surged (TLT -14.7%) and the dollar rose +4.7% in a stagflation-ish flight-to-safety (VIX 19->33, defensives -11.5% vs cyclicals -17.1%). Software multiples kept compressing and slowing software-spend guidance compounded the macro pressure; the long-duration basket undercut the index (SMH -24.4% vs SPY -19.7%).
2022-04-04.body_zh: 实际收益率飙升(TLT -14.7%)、美元上涨+4.7%,处于类滞胀的避险行情(VIX 19->33,防御板块-11.5% 对 周期股-17.1%),下滑38%至6月中旬低点。软件估值持续压缩,软件支出指引放缓加剧宏观压力;长久期篮子跑输指数(SMH -24.4% 对 SPY -19.7%)。

2022-06-16.title: Peak-inflation relief rally
2022-06-16.body: A +41% rally on peak-inflation hopes and a yield pullback (TLT +5.2%) as VIX eased 33->20 in a goldilocks-flavored quad (cyclicals +12.7% vs defensives +12.3%). The bounce was a duration-sensitivity reflex tracking the broad risk-on squeeze, not a fundamental inflection.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 受通胀见顶预期和收益率回落(TLT +5.2%)提振,VIX回落33->20,处于类金发姑娘象限(周期股+12.7% 对 防御板块+12.3%),反弹+41%。此弹升是久期敏感性的反射,跟随广泛的风险偏好挤压,而非基本面拐点。

2022-08-10.title: Hawkish, rate-driven reset leg down
2022-08-10.body: A 37% drop into November as Jackson Hole and persistent inflation pushed yields sharply higher (TLT -18.7%) and the dollar +5.1%, with breadth broadening (RSP beat SPY +3.4%). The renewed rate-driven de-rating fell hardest on profitless software (SMH -18.7% vs SPY -10.6%).
2022-08-10.title_zh: 鹰派利率驱动重置下跌
2022-08-10.body_zh: 杰克逊霍尔和顽固通胀大幅推高收益率(TLT -18.7%)、美元+5.1%,市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +3.4%),跌至11月,下挫37%。新一轮利率驱动的估值下杀对未盈利软件打击最重(SMH -18.7% 对 SPY -10.6%)。

2022-11-09.title: Disinflation re-rating on a narrow melt-up
2022-11-09.body: A +114% recovery as cooling CPI and the eventual 2024 Fed cuts revived risk appetite — a goldilocks risk-on melt-up where the dollar fell -5.9%, growth crushed value +42.2 and breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -18.4%), a mega-cap-led tape. Falling discount rates re-rated this long-duration basket (SMH +113.9% vs SPY +36.6%), with margin-improvement stories and durable subscription revenue rebuilding the bid through early 2024.
2022-11-09.title_zh: 去通胀估值重估,搭乘窄幅飙升
2022-11-09.body_zh: CPI降温和最终2024年的美联储降息重燃风险偏好——金发姑娘式风险偏好飙升,美元下跌-5.9%,成长大幅跑赢价值+42.2,市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -18.4%),是大盘股主导的行情,回升+114%。贴现率下行令这只长久期篮子估值重估(SMH +113.9% 对 SPY +36.6%),利润率改善故事和稳健的订阅收入在2024年初前重建买盘。

2024-02-09.title: Capex-anxiety risk-off pullback
2024-02-09.body: A -27% pullback as AI-capex fears questioned whether software budgets would be diverted to compute, with the yen-carry unwind adding pressure. The regime was a flight-to-safety: VIX spiked 13->39, yields fell (TLT +7.4%) and defensives (+10.8%) crushed cyclicals (+2.1%) in a slowdown-scare quad, so capital rotated out of high-beta software (SMH +4.6% only) into safety despite soft net-retention prints.
2024-02-09.title_zh: 资本开支焦虑避险回调
2024-02-09.body_zh: AI资本开支担忧引发软件预算是否被算力挤占的质疑,日元套息平仓增添压力,回调27%。当时是避险行情:VIX飙升13->39,收益率下行(TLT +7.4%),防御板块(+10.8%)大幅跑赢周期股(+2.1%),处于放缓恐慌象限,资金从高贝塔软件(SMH仅+4.6%)轮动至安全资产,叠加疲软的净留存数据。

2024-08-05.title: Cut-cycle software rebound
2024-08-05.body: A +56% recovery as the Fed's September cut lifted rate-sensitive software — a tech/semis-led risk-on tape (VIX 39->13, growth>value +11.3) even as the dollar firmed +3.2% and yields rose (TLT -3.2%). Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -3.7%); improving budgets and a soft-landing narrative carried the group into December 2024.
2024-08-05.body_zh: 美联储9月降息提振利率敏感的软件,回升+56%——这是科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好行情(VIX 39->13,成长跑赢价值+11.3),尽管美元走强+3.2%、收益率上行(TLT -3.2%)。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -3.7%);改善的预算和软着陆叙事推动该板块至2024年12月。

2024-12-06.title: DeepSeek & tariff risk-off drawdown
2024-12-06.body: A 34% drop through the DeepSeek scare and April's reciprocal-tariff crash, in a violent flight-to-safety: VIX exploded 13->52, high-beta cratered vs low-vol by -22.7%, and defensives (-6.7%) beat cyclicals (-18.5%) in a slowdown-scare quad. Macro de-risking plus AI-disruption fears for legacy SaaS drove the de-rating (SMH -27.3% vs SPY -17.8%).
2024-12-06.body_zh: 经历DeepSeek恐慌和4月对等关税崩盘,在剧烈避险中下跌34%:VIX暴涨13->52,高贝塔相对低波重挫-22.7%,放缓恐慌象限中防御板块(-6.7%)跑赢周期股(-18.5%)。宏观去风险叠加传统SaaS被AI颠覆的担忧驱动估值下杀(SMH -27.3% 对 SPY -17.8%)。

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff relief rally, lagging the leaders
2025-04-08.body: A +32% bounce off the April low as tariff fears eased and a risk-on regime returned: VIX collapsed 52->15, high-beta beat low-vol by +47.8, the dollar fell -4.2% and growth>value +18.6 in a reflation/growth-up quad. Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -6.1%); gains lagged the AI leaders (SMH +61.9% vs the basket's softer SPY +28.7% tape) as software still faced an AI-disruption overhang.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税后缓解反弹,落后龙头
2025-04-08.body_zh: 关税担忧消退、风险偏好行情卷土重来,从4月低点反弹+32%:VIX崩落52->15,高贝塔跑赢低波+47.8,美元下跌-4.2%,成长跑赢价值+18.6,处于再通胀/增长向上象限。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -6.1%);由于软件仍面临AI颠覆阴影,涨幅落后于AI龙头(SMH +61.9% 对 篮子较温和的SPY +28.7%行情)。

2025-07-28.title: Reflation-rotation drag out of growth
2025-07-28.body: A 47% slide as the early-2026 Hormuz oil shock (oil +44.8%, CPI 4.2%) drove a reflation/growth-up quad that punished long-duration software. Tellingly this was rotation, not a rate squeeze: bonds actually rallied (TLT +4.1%, yields fell), yet growth lagged value hard (-12.0) as capital fled high-multiple SaaS for energy and value while the index barely moved (SPY +7.6%) — a drag deepened by persistent AI-cannibalization fears into April 2026.
2025-07-28.title_zh: 再通胀轮动拖累,资金撤离成长
2025-07-28.body_zh: 2026年初霍尔木兹石油冲击(油价+44.8%,CPI 4.2%)催生再通胀/增长向上象限,重创长久期软件,下滑47%。值得注意的是这是轮动而非利率挤压:债券实际上上涨(TLT +4.1%,收益率下行),但成长大幅跑输价值(-12.0),资金从高估值SaaS撤向能源与价值股,而指数几乎未动(SPY +7.6%)——这一拖累被持续的AI蚕食担忧加深,直至2026年4月。

2026-04-10.title: Ceasefire-relief recovery
2026-04-10.body: A +54% recovery as the mid-June Hormuz ceasefire eased the oil/inflation shock and a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up resumed: VIX fell 19->16, high-beta beat low-vol by +26.7 and growth>value +8.6 in a reflation/growth-up quad. Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -5.4%); oversold long-duration software re-rated (SMH +39.1%) as macro fear faded and budgets stabilized.
2026-04-10.body_zh: 6月中旬霍尔木兹停火缓和石油/通胀冲击、科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好飙升重启,回升+54%:VIX回落19->16,高贝塔跑赢低波+26.7,成长跑赢价值+8.6,处于再通胀/增长向上象限。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -5.4%);宏观恐慌消退、预算企稳,超卖的长久期软件估值重估(SMH +39.1%)。

2026-06-01.title: Hawkish-bias June pullback as breadth broadens
2026-06-01.body: A -27% pullback as the post-ceasefire Fed retained a hiking bias and tech leadership narrowed. The regime was a defensive rotation: VIX firmed 16->19, defensives (+5.3%) beat cyclicals (-0.1%), growth lagged value hard (-11.5) and breadth broadened (RSP beat SPY +4.6%) in a slowdown-scare quad, so rate-sensitive software gave back gains alongside the broad late-cycle de-risking.
2026-06-01.title_zh: 鹰派倾向6月回调,广度扩散
2026-06-01.body_zh: 停火后美联储维持加息倾向、科技领导力收窄,回调27%。当时是防御性轮动:VIX走强16->19,防御板块(+5.3%)跑赢周期股(-0.1%),成长大幅跑输价值(-11.5),市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +4.6%),处于放缓恐慌象限,利率敏感的软件随着广泛的周期末去风险一同回吐涨幅。

cybersecurity.now: Topping at the 87th percentile. Cyber (CRWD/PANW/ZS) compounded on secular spend and breach catalysts, but as a high-beta growth-software basket it amplified the 2026 risk-on melt-up — and now breadth is broadening (RSP beat SPY +2.9%), the dollar is firming (+3.4% DXY) and the broad tech-leadership rollover argues for consolidation off a stretched rally.
cybersecurity.now_zh: 在87百分位见顶。网络安全(CRWD/PANW/ZS)受益于长期支出和数据泄露催化而复利增长,但作为高贝塔成长软件篮子,它放大了2026年的风险偏好飙升——如今市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)、美元走强(DXY +3.4%),广泛的科技领导力回落令过度拉伸的涨势指向盘整。

2021-11-09.title: Growth-multiple compression in a rate-shock bear
2021-11-09.body: Cyber fell 36% as the Fed pivot de-rated high-multiple security-software growth names: yields surged (TLT -12.3%) and the dollar firmed +5.4% in a stagflation-ish, risk-off regime (VIX 18->32, defensives +1.3% vs cyclicals -5.1%). Rising rates outweighed strong secular bookings in the broad SaaS sell-off, and the basket's high beta amplified the de-rating (SMH -20.6% vs SPY -10.5%).
2021-11-09.title_zh: 成长估值压缩,处于利率冲击熊市
2021-11-09.body_zh: 美联储转向令高估值的安全软件成长股估值下杀,网络安全下跌36%:收益率飙升(TLT -12.3%)、美元走强+5.4%,处于类滞胀、避险行情(VIX 18->32,防御板块+1.3% 对 周期股-5.1%)。在广泛的SaaS抛售中,利率上升盖过了强劲的长期订单,篮子的高贝塔放大了估值下杀(SMH -20.6% 对 SPY -10.5%)。

2022-03-14.title: Oversold relief bounce
2022-03-14.body: A +28% bounce as rate volatility briefly cooled (VIX 32->19) in a reflation/growth-up quad, with breadth narrow (RSP lagged SPY -3.0%). The geopolitical backdrop kept a structural cyber-spend bid even as macro pressure lingered, but the move was an oversold reflex rather than a regime turn.
2022-03-14.body_zh: 利率波动短暂降温(VIX 32->19),反弹+28%,处于再通胀/增长向上象限,市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -3.0%)。即便宏观压力犹存,地缘政治背景维持了结构性的网络安全支出买盘,但此波是超卖反射而非行情转向。

2022-04-04.title: Rate-shock new lows
2022-04-04.body: A 36% slide as surging real yields (TLT -10.1%) and a stronger dollar (+4.9%) hit growth software again in a slowdown-scare flight-to-safety (VIX 19->33, defensives -4.5% vs cyclicals -11.9%). Budget-scrutiny worries layered onto the macro de-rating, and the high-beta basket fell well past the index (SMH -18.6% vs SPY -14.0%).
2022-04-04.body_zh: 实际收益率飙升(TLT -10.1%)、美元走强(+4.9%)再度冲击成长软件,处于放缓恐慌的避险行情(VIX 19->33,防御板块-4.5% 对 周期股-11.9%),下滑36%。预算审视担忧叠加于宏观估值下杀之上,高贝塔篮子跌幅远超指数(SMH -18.6% 对 SPY -14.0%)。

2022-05-11.title: Peak-inflation relief rally
2022-05-11.body: A +33% rebound on peak-inflation hopes as VIX eased 33->20 in a goldilocks-flavored quad (cyclicals +8.2% vs defensives +5.9%), even as the dollar firmed +2.6% and bonds stayed soft (TLT -1.6%). Resilient security budgets supported the bounce relative to broader software, but it tracked the broad high-beta risk-on squeeze rather than a fundamental inflection.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 受通胀见顶预期提振,VIX回落33->20,处于类金发姑娘象限(周期股+8.2% 对 防御板块+5.9%),反弹+33%,尽管美元走强+2.6%、债券依旧偏弱(TLT -1.6%)。有韧性的安全预算使其反弹强于大盘软件,但此波跟随广泛的高贝塔风险偏好挤压而非基本面拐点。

2022-08-15.title: Hawkish, rate-driven leg down
2022-08-15.body: A 30% drop into January 2023 as Jackson Hole pushed yields higher (TLT -9.5%) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. Notably breadth broadened (RSP beat SPY +4.9%) and growth lagged value hard (-14.2), a rotation away from long-duration growth in which lengthening sales cycles and macro caution pressured cyber (SMH -16.8% vs SPY -10.8%).
2022-08-15.body_zh: 杰克逊霍尔推高收益率(TLT -9.5%),跌至2023年1月,下挫30%,处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。值得注意的是市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +4.9%),成长大幅跑输价值(-14.2),是远离长久期成长的轮动,拉长的销售周期和宏观谨慎压制网络安全(SMH -16.8% 对 SPY -10.8%)。

2023-01-05.title: Secular-spend compounding on a narrow melt-up
2023-01-05.body: A +136% run as disinflation, the genAI rally and relentless secular security demand compounded — riding a goldilocks risk-on melt-up where VIX fell 22->15, growth crushed value by +67.4 and breadth was extremely narrow (RSP lagged SPY -33.1%), a mega-cap-led tape. Breach catalysts and platform-consolidation wins at CrowdStrike and Palo Alto sustained the bid through the 2024 cut cycle even as yields drifted up (TLT -7.2%).
2023-01-05.title_zh: 长期支出复利,搭乘窄幅飙升
2023-01-05.body_zh: 去通胀、生成式AI上涨和不断增长的长期安全需求叠加,上涨+136%——搭乘金发姑娘式风险偏好飙升,VIX回落22->15,成长大幅跑赢价值+67.4,市场广度极度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -33.1%),是大盘股主导的行情。数据泄露催化和CrowdStrike、Palo Alto的平台整合胜利,在2024年降息周期前维持买盘,即便收益率上行(TLT -7.2%)。

2025-02-13.title: DeepSeek & tariff risk-off dip
2025-02-13.body: A -23% pullback through the DeepSeek scare and April's reciprocal-tariff crash, in a violent flight-to-safety: VIX exploded 15->52, high-beta cratered vs low-vol by -20.9%, and defensives (-7.3%) beat cyclicals (-18.0%) in a slowdown-scare quad. Macro de-risking hit growth software despite resilient cyber fundamentals, with the basket amplifying the move (SMH -28.6% vs SPY -18.3%).
2025-02-13.body_zh: 经历DeepSeek恐慌和4月对等关税崩盘,在剧烈避险中回调23%:VIX暴涨15->52,高贝塔相对低波重挫-20.9%,放缓恐慌象限中防御板块(-7.3%)跑赢周期股(-18.0%)。尽管网络安全基本面稳健,宏观去风险仍冲击成长软件,篮子放大了跌幅(SMH -28.6% 对 SPY -18.3%)。

2025-04-08.title: Recovery on breach catalysts and a risk-on melt-up
2025-04-08.body: A +44% recovery off the April low as tariff fears eased and a goldilocks risk-on regime returned: VIX collapsed 52->17, high-beta beat low-vol by +61.7, growth>value +25.0 and the dollar fell -3.4%. Breadth was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -13.2%); high-profile breaches plus AI-security and identity demand kept this high-beta group bid (SMH +95.1%) into November.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 数据泄露催化复苏,搭乘风险偏好飙升
2025-04-08.body_zh: 关税担忧消退、金发姑娘式风险偏好行情卷土重来,从4月低点回升+44%:VIX崩落52->17,高贝塔跑赢低波+61.7,成长跑赢价值+25.0,美元下跌-3.4%。市场广度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -13.2%);备受关注的数据泄露叠加AI安全和身份认证需求,维持这只高贝塔板块的买盘(SMH +95.1%)至11月。

2025-11-11.title: Hawkish-reset consolidation as leadership broadens
2025-11-11.body: A 29% drop as the late-2025 hawkish reset and the early-2026 Hormuz oil/CPI shock pressured growth multiples. This was a rotation more than a crash: SPY was flat (+0.2%) while breadth broadened sharply (RSP beat SPY +6.6%) and growth lagged value (-14.9) in a stagflation-ish quad. Stretched valuations made cyber vulnerable as capital left over-owned high-beta growth for the rest of the tape.
2025-11-11.title_zh: 鹰派重置盘整,领导力扩散
2025-11-11.body_zh: 2025年末鹰派重置和2026年初霍尔木兹石油/CPI冲击压制成长估值,下跌29%。这更多是轮动而非崩盘:SPY持平(+0.2%),市场广度急剧扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +6.6%),成长跑输价值(-14.9),处于类滞胀象限。过高的估值使网络安全脆弱,资金从被过度持有的高贝塔成长流向其余板块。

2026-02-23.title: Ceasefire-relief rally to top
2026-02-23.body: A +64% rally as the mid-June Hormuz ceasefire eased macro fear and a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up resumed: VIX fell 21->16, high-beta beat low-vol by +30.6 and growth>value +8.5 in a reflation/growth-up quad. Breadth stayed narrow (RSP lagged SPY -7.5%); durable security spend reasserted leadership and this high-beta group ran to topping levels (SMH +47.2%) before the broad tech-leadership rollover began.
2026-02-23.body_zh: 6月中旬霍尔木兹停火缓和宏观恐慌、科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好飙升重启,反弹+64%:VIX回落21->16,高贝塔跑赢低波+30.6,成长跑赢价值+8.5,处于再通胀/增长向上象限。市场广度保持狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -7.5%);稳健的安全支出重申领导力,这只高贝塔板块涨至见顶水平(SMH +47.2%),随后广泛的科技领导力回落开始。

quantum_computing.now: Trending with strong relative strength but speculative by nature. As a high-beta, retail-driven theme it amplifies the regime in both directions — and the current tape is risk-on but cooling: SMH +67.9% yet breadth is broadening (RSP beat SPY +2.9%) and the dollar is firming (+3.4% DXY) in a reflation/growth-up quad. With only two long legs of history, quantum remains prone to violent spikes, still riding the 2023-25 AI-adjacency narrative.
quantum_computing.now_zh: 处于上升趋势且相对强度强,但本质投机。作为高贝塔、散户驱动的主题,它在两个方向都放大行情——当前行情风险偏好但正在降温:SMH +67.9%,但市场广度扩散(RSP跑赢SPY +2.9%)、美元走强(DXY +3.4%),处于再通胀/增长向上象限。仅有两条长腿的历史,量子计算仍易发生剧烈飙升,继续搭乘2023-25年的AI邻接叙事。

2021-11-17.title: SPAC-era speculative washout in a rate-shock bear
2021-11-17.body: Quantum names fell 61% over 15 months as a rate-shock bear crushed profitless, pre-revenue speculative tech: yields surged (TLT -25.2%) and the dollar ripped +9.2% in a risk-off, slowdown-scare regime (VIX 17->26, defensives +1.1% vs cyclicals -7.2%). As the highest-beta, most speculative cohort, the pre-revenue de-SPAC names saw the deepest multiple compression of the rate shock — far worse than the index (SPY -15.2%).
2021-11-17.title_zh: SPAC时代投机洗盘,处于利率冲击熊市
2021-11-17.body_zh: 利率冲击熊市重创未盈利、零营收的投机科技,量子计算股15个月内下跌61%:收益率飙升(TLT -25.2%)、美元大涨+9.2%,处于避险、放缓恐慌行情(VIX 17->26,防御板块+1.1% 对 周期股-7.2%)。作为贝塔最高、最投机的群体,零营收的de-SPAC名字在利率冲击中遭遇最深的估值压缩——远逊于指数(SPY -15.2%)。

2023-03-15.title: AI-adjacency moonshot in a risk-on melt-up
