2023-03-15.body: An explosive +1,773% run as the genAI boom and headline milestones (Google/IBM/Nvidia quantum signals) drew retail into the highest-beta frontier-tech theme — supercharged by a goldilocks risk-on tape: the dollar fell -5.4%, growth crushed value +59.6 and breadth was extremely narrow (RSP lagged SPY -34.1%), a mega-cap-led melt-up (yields drifted up over the span, TLT -5.2%, but a weaker dollar and crushed-vol risk appetite did the lifting). As leveraged speculative longs, quantum names amplified that risk-on regime violently and largely detached from near-term revenue, peaking in October 2025.
2023-03-15.title_zh: AI邻接登月,处于风险偏好飙升
2023-03-15.body_zh: 生成式AI热潮和标志性里程碑(谷歌/IBM/英伟达的量子信号)将散户引入贝塔最高的前沿科技主题,爆发性上涨+1,773%——被金发姑娘式风险偏好行情助燃:美元下跌-5.4%,成长大幅跑赢价值+59.6,市场广度极度狭窄(RSP跑输SPY -34.1%),是大盘股主导的飙升(该期间收益率实为上行,TLT -5.2%,真正的推力来自走弱的美元和波动率崩塌后的风险偏好)。作为带杠杆的投机多头,量子计算名字剧烈放大了这一风险偏好行情,且基本脱离近期营收,在2025年10月见顶。

data_center_power.now: Power & cooling kit for AI datacenters (GE Vernova, Vertiv, Eaton) — the electricity super-cycle re-rated this group from late 2023 as AI compute exploded demand for generation, transformers and thermal management. It just ran +287% off the April-2025 tariff low inside a semis-led risk-on tape (SMH +68%, VIX 14-18), but the regime is now broadening (equal-weight beating cap-weight +2.9%) and a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%) plus a reflation/growth-up quad have leadership rotating toward Energy and Industrials — the basket is rolling over as the AI-capex pace gets re-examined.
data_center_power.now_zh: 为AI数据中心供电与散热的设备龙头（GE Vernova、Vertiv、Eaton）——电力超级周期自2023年底起重估这一组别，因AI算力激增推高了发电、变压器与热管理需求。它刚在半导体领涨的风险偏好行情中（半导体SMH +68%、VIX 14-18）自4月关税低点上涨287%，但当前象限转为再通胀/增长向上、市场广度正在扩散（等权跑赢市值权+2.9%）、美元走强（DXY +3.4%），领涨向能源与工业轮动——随着市场重新审视AI资本开支节奏，该篮子正在见顶回落。

2021-11-08.title: Rate-driven 2022 bear de-rates the group
2021-11-08.body: Power-infrastructure names fell -28% with the broad 2022 bear as the Fed pivoted to aggressive hiking: this was a rate-regime move, with the 10Y surging (TLT -21.3%) and a soaring dollar (DXY +11.8%) crushing long-duration capex stories. This pre-dated the AI-power thesis, so the group traded as ordinary rate-sensitive industrial/utility cyclicals into a stagflation-ish quad where defensives (+4.0%) led cyclicals (-13.3%) amid flight-to-safety (VIX 17->27).
2021-11-08.title_zh: 利率驱动的2022年熊市压估值
2021-11-08.body_zh: 电力基础设施类股随2022年大熊市下跌28%，原因是美联储转向激进加息：这是一轮利率主导行情，10年期收益率飙升（TLT -21.3%）、美元暴涨（DXY +11.8%），长久期资本开支题材遭压垮。此时尚无AI电力主线，该组别只是按利率敏感的工业／公用事业周期股交易，进入类滞胀象限，避险情绪下防御股（+4.0%）跑赢周期股（-13.3%）（VIX 17->27）。

2022-07-01.title: AI super-cycle re-rates into a semis-led melt-up
2022-07-01.body: From the 2022 low this basket compounded +319% as the AI-datacenter electricity thesis took hold through 2023-24 — power, transformers, switchgear and liquid cooling became the bottleneck on the AI buildout. As a high-beta capex play it amplified a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +153.6%, growth>value +33.7, VIX collapsing 27->12) that pulled flows out of defensives; breadth was narrow (equal-weight lagged cap-weight -16.8%), a mega-cap-led tape that rewarded Vertiv, GE Vernova and Eaton as they re-rated from sleepy industrials into AI-power core holdings.
2022-07-01.title_zh: AI超级周期在半导体领涨的暴涨中重估
2022-07-01.body_zh: 自2022年低点起，该篮子累计上涨319%，因AI数据中心电力主线在2023–24年确立——电力、变压器、开关设备与液冷成为AI建设的瓶颈环节。作为高贝塔资本开支标的，它放大了一轮金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好暴涨（半导体SMH +153.6%、成长跑赢价值+33.7、VIX由27跌至12），资金流出防御股；市场广度偏窄（等权跑输市值权-16.8%），这种巨头领涨的行情奖励了从沉闷工业股重估为AI电力核心持仓的Vertiv、GE Vernova与Eaton。
drivers_zh: 半导体领涨风险偏好暴涨

2024-05-24.title: Aug-2024 deflation-scare flight-to-safety
2024-05-24.body: A shallow -20% pullback as megacap-tech and AI-adjacent names wobbled into the August 2024 volatility scare and yen-carry unwind — a slowdown/deflation-scare quad with VIX exploding 12->28, yields falling (TLT +6.0%) and defensives (+2.4%) beating cyclicals (-3.4%) in a classic risk-off rotation into safety. As a high-beta group it overshot the broad tape (SMH -13.4%), but the power thesis stayed intact; this was froth coming off an extended name on a vol spike, not a thesis break.
2024-05-24.body_zh: 浅幅回调20%，在2024年8月波动惊魂与日元套利平仓前，巨型科技与AI相关股震荡——这是放缓/通缩惊魂象限，VIX由12飙至28、收益率下行（TLT +6.0%）、防御股（+2.4%）跑赢周期股（-3.4%），典型的避险轮动。作为高贝塔组别它超调于大盘（半导体SMH -13.4%），但电力主线依旧完好；这是涨幅过大标的在波动飙升时的泡沫挤出，并非逻辑破裂。

2024-08-07.title: Fed cuts spark a narrow goldilocks risk-on bid
2024-08-07.body: A +60% leg as the Fed began cutting in September 2024 and hyperscaler capex guidance plus nuclear/grid power deals validated the AI electricity demand story. The macro backdrop was a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on tape (SMH +26.9%, growth>value +13.9, VIX falling 28->15) with narrow mega-cap-led breadth (equal-weight lagged -5.7%) and a firmer dollar (DXY +4.8%) — a regime that rewards high-beta AI proxies. Datacenter power-purchase agreements and surging load forecasts kept the bid firm.
2024-08-07.title_zh: 美联储降息点燃窄幅金发女郎风险偏好
2024-08-07.body_zh: 上涨60%，因美联储于2024年9月开始降息，叠加超大规模厂商资本开支指引与核电／电网供电协议验证了AI电力需求逻辑。宏观背景是金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好行情（半导体SMH +26.9%、成长跑赢价值+13.9、VIX由28降至15），广度狭窄、巨头领涨（等权跑输-5.7%）、美元走强（DXY +4.8%）——奖励高贝塔AI代理标的的环境。数据中心购电协议与飙升的负荷预测使买盘稳固。

2025-01-22.title: DeepSeek shock detonates a risk-off flush
2025-01-22.body: A -37% drawdown triggered by DeepSeek's late-January efficiency shock — which briefly questioned whether AI would need as much electricity — that deepened into the April tariff crash. As a high-beta AI proxy the basket amplified a violent risk-off flush: VIX tripled 15->45, semis cratered (SMH -32.3%) and defensives (-2.2%) outran cyclicals (-16.3%) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. The most directly power-levered names were hit hardest on the demand-destruction fear even as yields fell (TLT +7.2%).
2025-01-22.body_zh: 回撤37%，由DeepSeek 1月底效率冲击触发——市场一度质疑AI是否仍需如此大量电力——随后在4月关税崩盘中加深。作为高贝塔AI代理，该篮子放大了一轮剧烈的避险急挫：VIX翻三倍由15升至45、半导体崩跌（半导体SMH -32.3%）、防御股（-2.2%）跑赢周期股（-16.3%），处于放缓/通缩惊魂象限。即便收益率下行（TLT +7.2%），电力杠杆最直接的标的在需求毁灭担忧下跌幅最大。

2025-04-04.title: Tariff-low moonshot in a semis-led risk-on tape
2025-04-04.body: A +287% recovery off the April-2025 tariff low as the DeepSeek scare faded and hyperscaler capex re-accelerated — power, cooling and grid kit reclaimed AI-leadership status. The basket rode a once-in-a-cycle semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +271.1%, VIX collapsing 45->17) with narrow mega-cap-led breadth (equal-weight lagged -13.4%), amplifying the regime as a high-beta capex proxy. It ran hard into mid-2026 before rolling over as the AI-capex pace was re-examined.
2025-04-04.title_zh: 关税低点暴涨于半导体领涨的风险偏好行情
2025-04-04.body_zh: 自2025年4月初关税低点上涨287%，DeepSeek惊魂消退、超大厂商资本开支重新加速——电力、散热与电网设备重夺AI领涨地位。该篮子搭乘周期一遇的半导体领涨风险偏好暴涨（半导体SMH +271.1%、VIX由45崩至17），广度狭窄、巨头领涨（等权跑输-13.4%），作为高贝塔资本开支代理放大了该象限。它一路猛涨至2026年中，随后因AI资本开支节奏被重新审视而见顶回落。

nuclear_power.now: Nuclear utilities + SMR developers (Constellation, Vistra, Oklo, SMR) — the highest-beta way to play AI baseload power demand, reactor restarts and new-build optionality. After a ~205% surge into October 2025 the group corrected hard; now in prime-entry territory after a fresh leg lower into mid-2026. The current tape is a broadening reflation/growth-up quad (equal-weight beating cap-weight +2.9%, oil +19.2%, copper-gold +17.6) with a firmer dollar (DXY +3.4%) and calm VIX (14-18) — leadership has rotated toward Energy/Industrials, leaving these speculative pure-plays out of the immediate bid.
nuclear_power.now_zh: 核电公用事业＋小型模块化反应堆(SMR)开发商（Constellation、Vistra、Oklo、SMR）——押注AI基荷电力需求、反应堆重启与新建产能期权的最高弹性方式。在2025年10月飙升约205%后大幅回调；经2026年中又一轮下跌后，目前处于优选入场区间。当前行情是广度扩散的再通胀/增长向上象限（等权跑赢市值权+2.9%、油价+19.2%、铜金比+17.6），美元走强（DXY +3.4%）、VIX平静（14-18）——领涨已向能源／工业轮动，使这些投机性纯标的暂未获得买盘。

2024-07-12.title: Aug-2024 vol scare clips high-beta leaders
2024-07-12.body: A sharp -26% pullback into the August 2024 volatility spike and yen-carry unwind, as the newly hot nuclear-for-AI names gave back froth. The macro was a slowdown/deflation-scare risk-off (VIX exploding 12->39, defensives +0.3% vs cyclicals -6.6%, broadening +4.2%); as a high-beta cohort the group overshot the broad tape (SMH -22.3%). The restart/baseload thesis stayed intact — this was a positioning flush in a vol shock, not a fundamental break.
2024-07-12.title_zh: 2024年8月波动惊魂回吐高贝塔涨幅
2024-07-12.body_zh: 在2024年8月波动飙升与日元套利平仓前急跌26%，新晋火热的核电AI概念股吐出泡沫。宏观是放缓/通缩惊魂的避险（VIX由12飙至39、防御股+0.3%对周期股-6.6%、广度扩散+4.2%）；作为高贝塔组别它超调于大盘（半导体SMH -22.3%）。重启／基荷逻辑完好——此为波动冲击中的仓位急挫，而非基本面破裂。

2024-08-05.title: Datacenter-nuclear deals ignite a goldilocks re-rate
2024-08-05.body: A +202% rocket leg as marquee datacenter-nuclear deals — Constellation's Three Mile Island restart for Microsoft, Amazon/Google SMR commitments — validated nuclear as the AI baseload answer. The basket amplified a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on tape (SMH +23.1%, growth>value +12.9, VIX collapsing 39->15) with narrow mega-cap-led breadth (equal-weight lagged -5.5%) and a firmer dollar (DXY +4.6%); Fed cuts and reactor-restart headlines compounded the buying frenzy in the highest-beta corner of AI power.
2024-08-05.title_zh: 数据中心核电协议在金发女郎行情中点燃重估
2024-08-05.body_zh: 上涨202%的火箭行情，标志性数据中心核电协议——Constellation为微软重启三哩岛、亚马逊／谷歌的SMR承诺——确立核电为AI基荷答案。该篮子放大了金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好行情（半导体SMH +23.1%、成长跑赢价值+12.9、VIX由39崩至15），广度狭窄、巨头领涨（等权跑输-5.5%）、美元走强（DXY +4.6%）；美联储降息与反应堆重启新闻在AI电力中弹性最高的角落叠加放大买盘狂热。

2025-01-24.title: DeepSeek demand-shock high-beta flush
2025-01-24.body: A two-session -22% flush as DeepSeek's efficiency claims hit late January 2025, hammering the AI-power-demand premium hardest in the high-beta nuclear/SMR cohort. It was a sharp risk-off jolt (VIX 15->18, defensives +0.9% vs cyclicals -0.9%, slowdown/deflation-scare quad) in which pre-revenue SMR developers — speculative leveraged longs — were the most exposed to the demand-destruction narrative.
2025-01-24.title_zh: DeepSeek需求冲击的高贝塔急挫
2025-01-24.body_zh: 两个交易日内急挫22%，2025年1月底DeepSeek效率说法冲击AI电力需求溢价，对高弹性核电／SMR组别打击最重。这是一次急促的避险冲击（VIX 15->18、防御股+0.9%对周期股-0.9%、放缓/通缩惊魂象限），尚无营收的SMR开发商——投机性杠杆多头——最受需求毁灭叙事拖累。

2025-01-27.title: Snap-back bargain bid as risk steadies
2025-01-27.body: A quick +22% bounce as dip-buyers concluded the DeepSeek demand-destruction read was overdone — efficiency gains arguably expand AI deployment and total power draw (the Jevons rebuttal). The tape was flat-to-stagflation-ish (VIX 18->16, cyclicals and defensives both +0.2%, copper-gold +5.4), so this was idiosyncratic, headline-driven mean-reversion in a thin high-beta pure-play group rather than a regime-driven rally.
2025-01-27.title_zh: 风险企稳下超跌反弹捡漏买盘
2025-01-27.body_zh: 迅速反弹22%，抄底资金认为DeepSeek需求毁灭解读过度——效率提升反而可能扩大AI部署与总用电量（杰文斯反驳）。行情近乎走平、略偏类滞胀（VIX 18->16、周期股与防御股均+0.2%、铜金比+5.4），因此这是薄盘高贝塔纯概念组别中由个股新闻驱动的均值回归，而非象限驱动的反弹。

2025-02-10.title: Pre-tariff risk-off drains the speculative premium
2025-02-10.body: A -34% slide as the broad risk-off into the spring 2025 tariff scare drained the speculative premium from high-multiple nuclear/SMR names. The quad turned slowdown/deflation-scare with VIX rising 16->28, defensives (+1.1%) beating cyclicals (-6.8%) and a weaker dollar (DXY -4.1%); rate-sensitive utilities and pre-revenue developers both leaked as the high-beta cohort led the AI-power complex into the April low.
2025-02-10.title_zh: 关税前避险抽走投机溢价
2025-02-10.body_zh: 下跌34%，2025年春关税惊魂前的广泛避险抽走了高估值核电／SMR标的的投机溢价。象限转为放缓/通缩惊魂，VIX由16升至28、防御股（+1.1%）跑赢周期股（-6.8%）、美元走弱（DXY -4.1%）；利率敏感的公用事业与尚无营收的开发商均承压，高贝塔组别领跌AI电力板块至4月低点。

2025-03-10.title: Choppy relief rally on policy hopes
2025-03-10.body: A +24% bounce on nuclear-friendly policy signals and bargain-hunting before the final pre-tariff leg lower. The macro briefly stabilized into a mild goldilocks/growth-up quad (VIX easing 28->17, cyclicals +3.6% vs defensives -0.9%, oil +4.7%), but breadth was unimpressive and the market struggled to price the tariff overhang — a two-way, headline-sensitive tape against a still-intact AI-baseload story.
2025-03-10.title_zh: 政策预期带来震荡反弹
2025-03-10.body_zh: 反弹24%，受利好核电的政策信号与逢低买盘推动，随后在关税前最后一轮下跌。宏观短暂企稳为温和的金发女郎/增长向上象限（VIX由28回落至17、周期股+3.6%对防御股-0.9%、油价+4.7%），但广度乏力，市场难以为关税阴影定价——这是依旧完好的AI基荷逻辑下、对新闻敏感的双向震荡行情。

2025-03-24.title: Final pre-tariff capitulation flush
2025-03-24.body: A -26% drop into the early-April 2025 tariff-crash low, completing the deep correction from the January peak. This was a full risk-off capitulation (VIX exploding 17->45, defensives -4.6% vs cyclicals -12.7%, slowdown/deflation-scare quad) in which the high-beta nuclear group overshot the broad selloff (SMH -21.6%) alongside the whole AI complex before the recovery began.
2025-03-24.title_zh: 关税前最后投降性急挫
2025-03-24.body_zh: 下跌26%至2025年4月初关税崩盘低点，完成自2025年1月高点的深度回调。这是一次彻底的避险投降（VIX由17飙至45、防御股-4.6%对周期股-12.7%、放缓/通缩惊魂象限），高弹性核电组别随整个AI板块超调于大盘抛售（半导体SMH -21.6%），随后反弹启动。

2025-04-04.title: Tariff-low moonshot in a semis-led risk-on tape
2025-04-04.body: A +205% surge off the April-2025 tariff low as AI-power demand reasserted, hyperscaler capex re-accelerated and the reactor-restart/SMR newsflow returned. As the highest-beta AI-power proxy the group amplified a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +89%, growth>value +23.0, VIX collapsing 45->21) with narrow mega-cap-led breadth (equal-weight lagged -11.2%) and a weaker dollar (DXY -4.1%), running to a fresh peak by mid-October 2025 on relentless AI-baseload buying.
2025-04-04.title_zh: 关税低点暴涨于半导体领涨的风险偏好行情
2025-04-04.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点飙升205%，AI电力需求重新确立、超大厂商资本开支再加速、反应堆重启／SMR新闻流回归。作为弹性最高的AI电力代理，该组别放大了金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好暴涨（半导体SMH +89%、成长跑赢价值+23.0、VIX由45崩至21），广度狭窄、巨头领涨（等权跑输-11.2%）、美元走弱（DXY -4.1%），在持续的AI基荷买盘下于2025年10月中创出新高。

2025-10-15.title: Blow-off top unwinds as breadth broadens
2025-10-15.body: A -39% drawdown from the October-2025 blow-off top as the most stretched AI-power trade unwound — AI-capex digestion fears and froth in pre-revenue SMR names drove the de-rate. The regime had quietly rotated to a broadening reflation/growth-up quad (equal-weight beating cap-weight +4.9%, Energy +45.7% on a 76.6% oil rip) that drained flows from narrow high-multiple AI proxies even as VIX only rose modestly (21->31); the fundamental restart thesis stayed intact through the price reset.
2025-10-15.title_zh: 喷发顶部在广度扩散中平仓
2025-10-15.body_zh: 自2025年10月喷发顶部回撤39%，最被拉伸的AI电力交易平仓——AI资本开支消化担忧与尚无营收SMR标的的泡沫推动估值下杀。行情已悄然轮动至广度扩散的再通胀/增长向上象限（等权跑赢市值权+4.9%、油价大涨76.6%带动能源+45.7%），即便VIX仅小幅上行（21->31），资金仍从狭窄的高估值AI代理流出；价格重置过程中重启基本面逻辑依旧完好。

2026-03-30.title: Oversold bounce as semis-led risk-on resumes
2026-03-30.body: A +30% recovery as bargain-hunting met fresh reactor-restart and SMR-licensing milestones in early 2026, riding a semis-led risk-on rebound (SMH +51.6%, VIX collapsing 31->17, narrow breadth -7.2%) in a reflation/growth-up quad. As a high-beta proxy the basket leveraged the up-tape; house view: a relief rally within a still-volatile group rather than a confirmed new uptrend.
2026-03-30.title_zh: 半导体领涨风险偏好重启下的超跌反弹
2026-03-30.body_zh: 反弹30%，2026年初逢低买盘遇上新的反应堆重启与SMR许可里程碑，搭乘半导体领涨的风险偏好反弹（半导体SMH +51.6%、VIX由31崩至17、窄广度-7.2%），处于再通胀/增长向上象限。作为高贝塔代理，该篮子放大了上涨行情；本观点：这是仍然波动的组别内的修复性反弹，而非确认的新上升趋势。
drivers_zh: 半导体领涨风险偏好反弹(SMH +51.6%)

2026-05-06.title: Stagflation-ish pullback into prime entry
2026-05-06.body: A -22% give-back into mid-June 2026 on a mild stagflation-ish risk-off (VIX 17->22, defensives +0.4% vs cyclicals -1.7%, firmer dollar DXY +2.0%, copper-gold +14.1), leaving the basket deeply washed out and screening as prime-entry on our framework. House view: positioning is light and the AI-baseload thesis is durable, but confirmation of a trend turn is still pending in this high-beta group.
2026-05-06.title_zh: 类滞胀回落至优选入场区
2026-05-06.body_zh: 至2026年6月中回吐22%，受温和类滞胀避险影响（VIX 17->22、防御股+0.4%对周期股-1.7%、美元走强DXY +2.0%、铜金比+14.1），使篮子深度超跌，在我们框架中显示为优选入场。本观点：仓位轻、AI基荷逻辑持久，但这一高贝塔组别趋势反转的确认仍待出现。

power_grid.now: Grid & transmission buildout — transformers, switchgear, utility-adjacent capex riding the same AI-load + electrification wave. The group ran ~249% off the 2022 low but now sits in bottoming territory after a 2025-26 consolidation; the tape is a broadening reflation/growth-up quad (equal-weight beating cap-weight +2.9%, oil +19.2%, copper-gold +17.6) with a firmer dollar (DXY +3.4%) and calm VIX (14-18). Positioning is washed out while the multi-year grid-capex story stays intact.
power_grid.now_zh: 电网与输配电建设——变压器、开关设备、公用事业相关资本开支，搭乘同一波AI负荷＋电气化浪潮。该组别自2022年低点上涨约249%，但经2025–26年盘整后目前处于筑底区间；行情为广度扩散的再通胀/增长向上象限（等权跑赢市值权+2.9%、油价+19.2%、铜金比+17.6），美元走强（DXY +3.4%）、VIX平静（14-18）。仓位已超跌，而多年期电网资本开支逻辑依旧完好。

2022-09-12.title: Rate-driven 2022 bear-market low
2022-09-12.body: A -15% slide into the October 2022 cycle low as peak-hawkish Fed pricing hit rate-sensitive utilities and capital-goods names — a rate-regime move with the 10Y surging (TLT -8.0%) and a stronger dollar (DXY +4.6%) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad (defensives -11.2% and cyclicals -11.7% both deep red, VIX 24->32). Grid/electrification was not yet a market theme, so this traded as ordinary rate-sensitive defensive-cyclical weakness.
2022-09-12.title_zh: 利率驱动的2022年末熊市低点
2022-09-12.body_zh: 下跌15%至2022年10月周期低点，美联储鹰派定价见顶打击利率敏感的公用事业与资本品标的——这是利率主导行情，10年期收益率飙升（TLT -8.0%）、美元走强（DXY +4.6%），处于放缓/通缩惊魂象限（防御股-11.2%、周期股-11.7%皆深跌，VIX 24->32）。电网／电气化尚未成为市场主线，故此为普通的利率敏感防御周期股走弱。

2022-10-14.title: Grid super-cycle re-rates into a semis-led melt-up
2022-10-14.body: A +249% multi-year run as AI-datacenter load surge, electrification and aging-grid replacement turned transmission and transformer suppliers into a structural-growth story through 2023-24. It rode a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +208.7%, growth>value +56.6, VIX collapsing 32->15) and a weaker dollar (DXY -5.2%), with extremely narrow mega-cap-led breadth (equal-weight lagged cap-weight a striking -28.1%) — power-grid capex went from defensive to one of the market's best secular themes.
2022-10-14.title_zh: 电网超级周期在半导体领涨暴涨中重估
2022-10-14.body_zh: 多年期上涨249%，AI数据中心负荷激增、电气化与老化电网更换使输配电与变压器供应商在2023–24年成为结构性成长故事。它搭乘金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好暴涨（半导体SMH +208.7%、成长跑赢价值+56.6、VIX由32崩至15）与美元走弱（DXY -5.2%），市场广度极窄、巨头领涨（等权大幅跑输市值权达-28.1%）——电网资本开支从防御性变为市场最佳长期主线之一。

2025-01-24.title: DeepSeek + tariff risk-off de-rate
2025-01-24.body: A -29% correction triggered by DeepSeek's late-January efficiency shock — which questioned AI power demand — and deepened by the April tariff crash. The macro was a violent risk-off: VIX tripled 15->45, semis cratered (SMH -30.9%), defensives (-3.4%) beat cyclicals (-16.3%) and yields fell (TLT +7.6%) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. Grid names sold off on demand-doubt even though their order books reflected multi-year backlogs; breadth broadened (+3.3%) as the mega-cap AI tape unwound.
2025-01-24.body_zh: 回调29%，由DeepSeek 1月底效率冲击（质疑AI电力需求）触发，并在4月关税崩盘中加深。宏观是剧烈避险：VIX翻三倍由15升至45、半导体崩跌（半导体SMH -30.9%）、防御股（-3.4%）跑赢周期股（-16.3%）、收益率下行（TLT +7.6%），处于放缓/通缩惊魂象限。尽管订单簿反映多年积压，电网股仍因需求疑虑而下跌；随着巨头领涨的AI行情瓦解，广度扩散（+3.3%）。

2025-04-04.title: Tariff-low recovery in a semis-led risk-on tape
2025-04-04.body: A +115% recovery off the April-2025 tariff low as AI-load forecasts and grid-interconnection backlogs reasserted the structural bid. The basket amplified a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +103.9%, growth>value +30.0, VIX collapsing 45->17) with narrow mega-cap-led breadth (equal-weight lagged -16.0%) and a weaker dollar (DXY -3.7%); utility capex guidance and transformer-supply tightness kept the bid firm through October 2025.
2025-04-04.title_zh: 关税低点反弹于半导体领涨的风险偏好行情
2025-04-04.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点上涨115%，AI负荷预测与电网并网积压重新确立结构性买盘。该篮子放大了金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好暴涨（半导体SMH +103.9%、成长跑赢价值+30.0、VIX由45崩至17），广度狭窄、巨头领涨（等权跑输-16.0%）、美元走弱（DXY -3.7%）；公用事业资本开支指引与变压器供应紧张使买盘稳固至2025年10月。

2025-10-29.title: Autumn AI-capex digestion dip
2025-10-29.body: A -17% pullback as the broad AI-capex complex digested its run into late 2025 — a mild slowdown/deflation-scare consolidation (VIX flat 17->18, defensives +1.9% vs cyclicals +0.3%, breadth broadening +4.2%) rather than a true risk-off. A garden-variety pause in an extended group as flows rotated, not a thesis break.
2025-10-29.title_zh: 秋季AI资本开支消化回调
2025-10-29.body_zh: 回调17%，整个AI资本开支板块在2025年底消化涨幅——这是温和的放缓/通缩惊魂盘整（VIX走平17->18、防御股+1.9%对周期股+0.3%、广度扩散+4.2%），而非真正的避险。这是涨幅过大组别在资金轮动时的常规歇脚，而非逻辑破裂。

2025-12-17.title: Grinds back as reflation rotation builds
2025-12-17.body: A +36% recovery into May 2026 in a reflation/growth-up quad (oil ripping +70.0%, cyclicals +13.4% vs defensives +3.7%, SMH +62.6%, VIX calm 18->17) that nonetheless leaves the group screening as bottoming with low positioning after the choppy 2025-26 range. House view: the multi-year grid/transmission-capex backlog is durable; a fresh trending breakout is still unconfirmed.
2025-12-17.title_zh: 再通胀轮动中缓步回升，目前筑底
2025-12-17.body_zh: 至2026年5月回升36%，处于再通胀/增长向上象限（油价大涨+70.0%、周期股+13.4%对防御股+3.7%、半导体SMH +62.6%、VIX平静18->17），但经2025–26年震荡区间后该组别仍显示为筑底、仓位偏低。本观点：多年期电网／输配电资本开支积压持久；新的趋势突破仍未确认。

energy_complex.now: Broad US oil & gas — integrateds, E&P, services and midstream that track crude (XLE). The basket round-tripped the 2022 Russia spike and 2025 tariff crash, spiked again on the 2026 Iran/Strait-of-Hormuz oil shock, then rolled over as the mid-June 2026 ceasefire unwound the war premium. The current tape is favorable on paper — a reflation/growth-up quad with oil +19.2% and copper-gold +17.6, Energy a top sector leader (+21.5%) — but a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%) is a direct headwind for the commodity complex.
energy_complex.now_zh: 广义美国油气——综合油企、勘探开采、油服与中游，跟随原油走势(XLE)。该篮子经历了2022年俄乌飙升与2025年关税崩盘的往返，又在2026年伊朗／霍尔木兹海峡石油冲击中再度飙升，随后随2026年6月中停火、战争溢价消退而见顶回落。当前行情账面上有利——再通胀/增长向上象限、油价+19.2%、铜金比+17.6，能源为领涨板块之一（+21.5%）——但美元走强（DXY +3.4%）对大宗商品板块构成直接逆风。

2020-10-28.title: Reflation super-spike, Energy leads the bear
2020-10-28.body: A +331% rocket from the 2020 COVID trough through June 2022, as reopening demand collided with OPEC+ discipline and Russia's February 2022 invasion of Ukraine sent crude soaring (oil +219.4%). This was a textbook reflation/growth-up quad — the 10Y surged (TLT -26.5%), the dollar strengthened (DXY +9.5%), cyclicals (+70.6%) crushed defensives (+26.6%) and breadth broadened (equal-weight beat cap-weight +13.8%) — and Energy (+255.8%) was the best-performing sector even as the rest of the market fell into a rate-driven bear.
2020-10-28.title_zh: 再通胀超级飙升，能源领涨于熊市
2020-10-28.body_zh: 自2020年疫情谷底至2022年6月火箭式上涨331%，复工需求碰上OPEC+限产，叠加2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰将原油推升（油价+219.4%）。这是教科书式的再通胀/增长向上象限——10年期收益率飙升（TLT -26.5%）、美元走强（DXY +9.5%）、周期股（+70.6%）碾压防御股（+26.6%）、广度扩散（等权跑赢市值权+13.8%）——在大盘陷入利率驱动的熊市之际，能源（+255.8%）是表现最佳的板块。

2022-06-07.title: Recession-fear crude pullback
2022-06-07.body: A -27% drop as demand-destruction and recession fear from aggressive Fed hiking pulled crude sharply off its June 2022 peak (oil -19.8%, copper-gold -19.9). The quad flipped to slowdown/deflation-scare with a surging dollar (DXY +6.1%), defensives (-3.6%) beating cyclicals (-14.0%) and Energy the worst sector (-25.9%) — the fastest leg of the broad commodity de-rate as growth expectations rolled over.
2022-06-07.title_zh: 衰退担忧引发原油回调
2022-06-07.body_zh: 下跌27%，美联储激进加息带来的需求毁灭与衰退担忧使原油从2022年6月峰值急挫（油价-19.8%、铜金比-19.9）。象限翻转为放缓/通缩惊魂，美元飙升（DXY +6.1%）、防御股（-3.6%）跑赢周期股（-14.0%）、能源为最差板块（-25.9%）——在增长预期回落之际，这是广义大宗商品估值下杀中最快的一段。

2022-07-14.title: Range-bound grind under a semis-led melt-up
2022-07-14.body: A +78% grind into late November 2024 as crude chopped in a wide range while disciplined buybacks, dividends and strong free cash flow rewarded integrateds and E&P. Notably this ran against the regime tide: the macro was a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +137.6%, growth>value +35.1, oil actually -25.6%) with narrow mega-cap-led breadth (equal-weight lagged -18.3%) where defensives/cyclicals favored tech — so Energy's slow, fundamentals-driven climb on capital discipline was a value-factor outlier, not a crude-price moonshot.
2022-07-14.title_zh: 半导体领涨暴涨下的区间缓步上涨
2022-07-14.body_zh: 至2024年11月底缓步上涨78%，原油宽幅震荡，而有纪律的回购、分红与强劲自由现金流回报综合油企与勘探开采商。值得注意的是这逆势而行：宏观为金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好暴涨（半导体SMH +137.6%、成长跑赢价值+35.1、油价实际-25.6%），广度狭窄、巨头领涨（等权跑输-18.3%），偏向科技——因此能源凭资本纪律缓慢的基本面驱动攀升是价值因子的异类，而非油价暴涨。
drivers_zh: 逆半导体领涨风险偏好

2024-11-22.title: Tariff-crash risk-off + oversupply de-rate
2024-11-22.body: A -23% slide into the early-April 2025 tariff crash as global-growth fear and OPEC+ supply-add plans pressured crude (oil -16.4%). This was a slowdown/deflation-scare risk-off — VIX exploded 15->52, defensives (-7.1%) beat cyclicals (-18.7%) and a weaker dollar (DXY -4.2%) couldn't offset recession-demand worries. Energy underperformed badly (-20.1%) as a softening oil balance layered onto the broad de-risk.
2024-11-22.title_zh: 关税崩盘避险＋供给过剩压估值
2024-11-22.body_zh: 下跌23%至2025年4月初关税崩盘，全球增长担忧与OPEC+增产计划压制原油（油价-16.4%）。这是放缓/通缩惊魂的避险——VIX由15飙至52、防御股（-7.1%）跑赢周期股（-18.7%），即便美元走弱（DXY -4.2%）也无法抵消衰退需求担忧。在趋松的油市平衡叠加广泛去风险之际，能源大幅跑输（-20.1%）。

2025-04-08.title: Iran/Hormuz reflation oil-shock spike
2025-04-08.body: A +81% recovery off the tariff low, powered by the 2026 Iran/Strait-of-Hormuz crisis that spiked crude (oil +80.9%) and pushed CPI to 4.2% (house view). The backdrop turned to a reflation/growth-up quad with a broad semis-led risk-on tape underneath (SMH +203.2%, VIX collapsing 52->18) and a weaker dollar (DXY -3.6%) aiding the commodity bid; the war premium peaked into mid-May 2026 before the ceasefire, with Energy (+65.5%) a top leader on the supply-disruption bid.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 伊朗／霍尔木兹再通胀石油冲击飙升
2025-04-08.body_zh: 自关税低点反弹81%，由2026年伊朗／霍尔木兹海峡危机驱动，将原油推升（油价+80.9%）、CPI升至4.2%（本观点）。背景转为再通胀/增长向上象限，底下是广泛的半导体领涨风险偏好行情（半导体SMH +203.2%、VIX由52崩至18），美元走弱（DXY -3.6%）助推大宗商品买盘；战争溢价于2026年5月中、停火前见顶，供应中断买盘下能源（+65.5%）为领涨之一。

uranium_miners.now: Uranium miners + fuel cycle (Cameco, Sprott physical) — the high-beta, supply-driven fuel side of the nuclear revival, geared to uranium spot price and reactor restarts. After a ~292% run into October 2025 the group sold off hard; it now sits deeply washed out in bottoming territory amid a 2026 spot-price consolidation. The tape is a broadening reflation/growth-up quad (oil +19.2%, copper-gold +17.6, equal-weight beating cap-weight +2.9%) which favors commodity/cyclical themes, but a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%) is a headwind for the materials complex.
uranium_miners.now_zh: 铀矿商＋燃料循环（Cameco、Sprott实物）——核电复兴中高弹性、供给驱动的燃料侧，紧贴铀现货价格与反应堆重启。在2025年10月飙升约292%后大幅下跌；目前在2026年现货价盘整中深度超跌、处于筑底区间。行情为广度扩散的再通胀/增长向上象限（油价+19.2%、铜金比+17.6、等权跑赢市值权+2.9%），有利于大宗商品/周期主题，但美元走强（DXY +3.4%）对材料板块构成逆风。

2021-11-08.title: Sprott-squeeze froth unwinds in risk-off
2021-11-08.body: A -45% drop into late January 2022 as the 2021 Sprott Physical Trust-driven spot squeeze faded and the broad risk-off into Fed hiking hit speculative miners. The macro was a stagflation-ish flight-to-safety (VIX 17->30, defensives +0.7% vs cyclicals -5.1%, dollar +3.4%) and as a high-beta name the group overshot the broad tape (SMH -14.5%). Pure spot/supply dynamics, ahead of the AI-power demand era.
2021-11-08.title_zh: Sprott逼空泡沫在避险中消退
2021-11-08.body_zh: 下跌45%至2022年1月底，2021年由Sprott实物信托驱动的现货逼空消退，叠加美联储加息前的广泛避险打击投机性矿商。宏观为类滞胀避险（VIX 17->30、防御股+0.7%对周期股-5.1%、美元+3.4%），作为高贝塔标的它超调于大盘（半导体SMH -14.5%）。纯现货／供给动态，早于AI电力需求时代。

2022-01-27.title: Russia supply-fear spot bid amid stagflation
2022-01-27.body: A +66% spike as Russia's invasion of Ukraine raised fears over Russian enrichment and conversion supply, lifting uranium spot and the high-beta miners. This was a stagflation-ish reflation episode — oil +20.4%, defensives (+9.7%) and cyclicals (+5.5%) both green, yields surging (TLT -13.5%) and a firmer dollar (DXY +2.7%) — a geopolitics-on-supply leg that bucked the broad de-risk (SMH -4.3%), characteristic of this group.
2022-01-27.title_zh: 类滞胀中俄罗斯供应担忧推升现货
2022-01-27.body_zh: 飙升66%，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰引发对俄铀浓缩与转化供应的担忧，推高铀现货与高弹性矿商。这是类滞胀的再通胀片段——油价+20.4%、防御股（+9.7%）与周期股（+5.5%）皆涨、收益率飙升（TLT -13.5%）、美元走强（DXY +2.7%）——这是地缘政治冲击供给的一段，逆大盘去风险而行（半导体SMH -4.3%），为该组别的典型特征。

2022-04-13.title: Hawkish-Fed risk-off flush
2022-04-13.body: A -44% flush as peak-hawkish Fed pricing and a broad commodity/risk-asset de-rate hit the volatile miners. A slowdown/deflation-scare risk-off (VIX 22->32, defensives -6.6% beating cyclicals -10.3%, surging dollar DXY +5.0%) in which high-beta uranium gave back its geopolitical spike on macro de-risking, overshooting the broad selloff (SMH -10.2%).
2022-04-13.body_zh: 急挫44%，美联储鹰派定价见顶与广义大宗商品／风险资产估值下杀打击波动剧烈的矿商。这是放缓/通缩惊魂的避险（VIX 22->32、防御股-6.6%跑赢周期股-10.3%、美元飙升DXY +5.0%），高弹性铀股在宏观去风险下回吐地缘政治飙升，超调于大盘抛售（半导体SMH -10.2%）。

2022-05-12.title: Supply-deficit thesis re-bids as vol eases
2022-05-12.body: A +52% bounce as the structural supply-deficit story — underinvested mines versus reactor restarts and life-extensions — drew buyers back. The tape steadied into a goldilocks/growth-up quad (VIX easing 32->23, cyclicals +4.5% vs defensives +3.9%, high-beta minus low-vol +7.1) even as oil fell (-18.2%) and the dollar firmed (DXY +4.0%); spot uranium firmed on utility contracting and term-market activity, an idiosyncratic supply story riding a calmer risk backdrop.
2022-05-12.title_zh: 波动缓和下供给短缺逻辑重获买盘
2022-05-12.body_zh: 反弹52%，结构性供给短缺故事——投资不足的矿山对比反应堆重启与延寿——吸引买盘回归。行情企稳为金发女郎/增长向上象限（VIX由32回落至23、周期股+4.5%对防御股+3.9%、高贝塔减低波动+7.1），即便油价下跌（-18.2%）、美元走强（DXY +4.0%）；公用事业签约与长协市场活跃使铀现货走强，这是在更平静风险背景下的个股供给故事。

2022-09-09.title: Recession-demand de-rate vs a tech-led tape
2022-09-09.body: A -41% drawdown into May 2023 as global recession fear weighed on the cyclical miners. Notably the broad tape was a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on recovery (SMH +38.1%, growth>value +10.4, VIX falling 23->17, weaker dollar DXY -4.4%) with narrow breadth (-6.7%) — but uranium was a value/commodity laggard that diverged lower as spot consolidated, despite the durable long-term deficit narrative.
2022-09-09.title_zh: 科技领涨行情下的衰退需求下杀
2022-09-09.body_zh: 回撤41%至2023年5月，全球衰退担忧拖累周期性矿商。值得注意的是大盘为金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好修复（半导体SMH +38.1%、成长跑赢价值+10.4、VIX由23降至17、美元走弱DXY -4.4%），广度狭窄（-6.7%）——但铀作为价值/大宗落后者背离下行，现货盘整，尽管长期短缺叙事持久。
drivers_zh: 价值落后于科技领涨风险偏好

2023-05-30.title: Spot breakout to $100 in a reflation risk-on tape
2023-05-30.body: A +164% surge into May 2024 as uranium spot broke out toward $100/lb on supply tightness, Kazatomprom production warnings, Sprott physical buying and the dawning AI-power/reactor-restart narrative. It rode a semis-led, reflation/growth-up risk-on tape (SMH +59.7%, growth>value +11.7, VIX collapsing 17->12, oil +14.9, copper-gold +14.8) with narrow breadth (-6.8%) and yields rising (TLT -7.4%) — the high-beta miners amplified the up-regime into the group's biggest clean trend in years.
2023-05-30.title_zh: 再通胀风险偏好行情中现货突破奔向100美元
2023-05-30.body_zh: 至2024年5月飙升164%，铀现货因供应紧张、Kazatomprom减产预警、Sprott实物买入与初现的AI电力／反应堆重启叙事而突破奔向每磅100美元。它搭乘半导体领涨、再通胀/增长向上的风险偏好行情（半导体SMH +59.7%、成长跑赢价值+11.7、VIX由17崩至12、油价+14.9、铜金比+14.8），广度狭窄（-6.8%）、收益率上行（TLT -7.4%）——高弹性矿商放大上行象限，交出多年来最干净的趋势。

2024-05-20.title: Spot rolls over into the Aug-2024 vol flush
2024-05-20.body: A -38% drop into September 2024 as uranium spot retreated from the $100 high on thin-volume term-market softness, capped by the August 2024 volatility scare. The macro turned slowdown/deflation-scare with VIX spiking 12->22, yields falling (TLT +10.7%) and defensives (+6.5%) beating cyclicals (-0.9%); the high-beta miners overshot the spot pullback and the broad de-risk.
2024-05-20.title_zh: 现货回落进入2024年8月波动急挫
2024-05-20.body_zh: 下跌38%至2024年9月，铀现货因长协市场成交清淡转弱从100美元高位回落，并被2024年8月波动惊魂封顶。宏观转为放缓/通缩惊魂，VIX由12飙至22、收益率下行（TLT +10.7%）、防御股（+6.5%）跑赢周期股（-0.9%）；高弹性矿商超调于现货回调与大盘去风险。

2024-09-06.title: Restart headlines re-ignite the bid in reflation
2024-09-06.body: A +82% rocket as datacenter-nuclear deals (Three Mile Island restart) and Fed cuts re-ignited the nuclear-fuel bid. The backdrop was a reflation/growth-up quad (cyclicals +13.7% vs defensives +0.4%, oil +5.3) with yields surging (TLT -8.6%) and a strong dollar (DXY +6.2%); the high-beta miners were pulled up with the reactor-restart wave and the cyclical bid into late November 2024.
2024-09-06.title_zh: 再通胀中重启新闻重燃买盘
2024-09-06.body_zh: 火箭式上涨82%，数据中心核电协议（三哩岛重启）与美联储降息重燃核燃料买盘。背景为再通胀/增长向上象限（周期股+13.7%对防御股+0.4%、油价+5.3），收益率飙升（TLT -8.6%）、美元走强（DXY +6.2%）；高弹性矿商随反应堆重启浪潮与周期买盘被推升至2024年11月底。

2024-11-22.title: DeepSeek + tariff deep risk-off de-rate
2024-11-22.body: A -49% drawdown into the April-2025 tariff low, hit first by DeepSeek's late-January AI-power-demand shock and then the tariff crash. This was a violent slowdown/deflation-scare risk-off — VIX exploded 15->52, defensives (-7.1%) beat cyclicals (-18.7%), semis cratered (SMH -26.1%) — in which the high-beta miners led the AI-nuclear complex lower on demand-doubt and broad de-risk, even as a weaker dollar (DXY -4.2%) offered no support.
2024-11-22.body_zh: 回撤49%至2025年4月关税低点，先受DeepSeek 1月底AI电力需求冲击，再遭关税崩盘。这是剧烈的放缓/通缩惊魂避险——VIX由15飙至52、防御股（-7.1%）跑赢周期股（-18.7%）、半导体崩跌（半导体SMH -26.1%）——高弹性矿商在需求疑虑与广泛去风险下领跌整个AI核电板块，即便美元走弱（DXY -4.2%）也未能提供支撑。

2025-04-08.title: Tariff-low to spot moonshot in a semis-led melt-up
2025-04-08.body: A +292% surge off the April-2025 tariff low as uranium spot broke higher on reactor restarts, government nuclear support and supply-deficit buying, while the AI-baseload story re-accelerated. As the highest-beta fuel proxy it amplified a goldilocks, semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +89.9%, growth>value +22.7, VIX collapsing 52->21) with narrow breadth (-10.2%) and a weaker dollar (DXY -4.1%) aiding the commodity bid — the miners delivered the group's largest run into October 2025.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税低点至现货暴涨于半导体领涨行情
2025-04-08.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点飙升292%，铀现货因反应堆重启、政府核能支持与供给短缺买盘而上行，AI基荷故事同步再加速。作为弹性最高的燃料代理，它放大了金发女郎式、半导体领涨的风险偏好暴涨（半导体SMH +89.9%、成长跑赢价值+22.7、VIX由52崩至21），广度狭窄（-10.2%）、美元走弱（DXY -4.1%）助推大宗商品买盘——矿商交出该组别至2025年10月的最大一波涨幅。

2025-10-15.title: Blow-off top, 36% reset as flows rotate
2025-10-15.body: A -36% pullback from the October-2025 spot/equity peak as the most stretched fuel-cycle trade unwound on profit-taking and a spot-price stall. The macro was only a mild slowdown/deflation-scare (VIX 21->23, defensives +0.6% vs cyclicals -2.0%) — not a broad flush — so this was largely an idiosyncratic froth purge in a high-beta group as flows rotated off the AI-fuel trade, not a break of the supply-deficit thesis.
2025-10-15.title_zh: 喷发顶部，资金轮动中回调36%
2025-10-15.body_zh: 自2025年10月现货／股价峰值回调36%，最被拉伸的燃料循环交易因获利了结与现货价停滞而平仓。宏观仅为温和的放缓/通缩惊魂（VIX 21->23、防御股+0.6%对周期股-2.0%）——并非广泛急挫——因此这主要是高弹性组别在资金撤离AI燃料交易时的个股泡沫挤出，而非供给短缺逻辑破裂。

2025-11-21.title: Restart-driven relief bounce in reflation
2025-11-21.body: A +71% rebound into late January 2026 on renewed reactor-restart and utility-contracting headlines that firmed uranium spot. The tape was a reflation/growth-up quad (cyclicals +10.0% vs defensives +1.9%, oil +8.9, VIX easing 23->16) with a weaker dollar (DXY -3.7%) supporting commodities; volatile, headline-sensitive trade characteristic of the high-beta miners as they leveraged the up-regime.
2025-11-21.title_zh: 再通胀中重启驱动修复反弹
2025-11-21.body_zh: 至2026年1月底反弹71%，新一轮反应堆重启与公用事业签约新闻使铀现货走强。行情为再通胀/增长向上象限（周期股+10.0%对防御股+1.9%、油价+8.9、VIX由23回落至16），美元走弱（DXY -3.7%）支撑大宗商品；这是高弹性矿商典型的、对新闻敏感的剧烈交易，放大了上行象限。

2026-01-28.title: Spot consolidates into a deep washout
2026-01-28.body: A -42% slide into mid-June 2026 as uranium spot consolidated and the high-beta miners de-rated, leaving the group deeply washed out in bottoming territory. The macro was a mixed reflation/growth-up quad (oil +42.4, copper-gold +28.6 but a stronger dollar DXY +3.6% and rising VIX 16->22) where the commodity tailwind couldn't hold up the stretched fuel trade. House view: the multi-year supply-deficit and restart thesis is durable, but a confirmed spot-price turn is still pending.
2026-01-28.title_zh: 现货盘整进入深度超跌
2026-01-28.body_zh: 下跌42%至2026年6月中，铀现货盘整、高弹性矿商估值下杀，使该组别深度超跌、处于筑底区间。宏观为混合的再通胀/增长向上象限（油价+42.4、铜金比+28.6，但美元走强DXY +3.6%、VIX上行16->22），大宗商品顺风未能托住被拉伸的燃料交易。本观点：多年期供给短缺与重启逻辑持久，但现货价反转的确认仍待出现。

defense.now: Defense & Aerospace (RTX/LMT/GD/Boeing, ITA proxy) sits in the doghouse despite a world built for it — and the current tape explains the laggard read better than geopolitics does. The melt-up off the April-2025 low has been a narrow, tech/semis-led risk-on regime (SMH +67.9%, growth-led, mega-cap breadth) that pulls flows toward AI beta and away from a steady cyclical-defensive name; a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%) is an added headwind for the exporting primes. Two hot wars and NATO rearmament should be a tailwind, yet the basket ranks #32 in relative strength, tagged 'Bottoming' near its range floor (pos 9.0). The real tell is policy, not the regime: Trump-era DOGE efficiency cuts (~8%/yr reprioritization) threaten legacy programs (F-35, armored vehicles) the primes lean on. After cresting in January 2026 (+111% off the April-2025 low), defense rolled over -18% and has only limped back — a value-coiled spring waiting on order flow, not a momentum leader the risk-on tape rewards.
defense.now_zh: 国防与航空航天（RTX/LMT/GD/波音，ITA 为代理）所处的世界看似为其量身定做，却深陷冷宫——而当前的市场状态比地缘更能解释其落后表现。自 2025 年 4 月低点的融涨一直是狭窄、由科技/半导体引领的风险偏好（risk-on）regime（半导体 SMH +67.9%、成长引领、大盘股市场广度），把资金拉向 AI 高贝塔、远离稳健的周期防御品种；走强的美元（DXY +3.4%）对出口型主承包商又是逆风。两场热战与北约重整军备本应是顺风，然而该篮子相对强度排名第 32 位，被标记为'筑底'，接近区间底部（pos 9.0）。真正的关键在政策而非 regime：特朗普时代 DOGE 效率削减（每年约 8% 重新排序）威胁到主承包商赖以为生的传统项目（F-35、装甲车）。在 2026 年 1 月见顶后（较 2025 年 4 月低点 +111%），国防下挫 -18% 至今仅勉强回血——一根估值蓄势的弹簧，等待订单流，而非风险偏好行情奖励的动量领头羊。

2020-07-09.title: Post-COVID grind into the Ukraine bid, riding a reflation melt-up (+70%)
2020-07-09.body: Defense climbed off the 2020 COVID trough into a broad reflation/growth-up regime (SPY +47.6%, cyclicals +73% vs defensives +35.5%, breadth wide at RSP-SPY +14%) that lifted the whole risk complex even as yields surged (TLT -21.1%). The February 2022 Russian invasion then turned a cyclical recovery into a hard geopolitical re-rating — LMT/RTX bid as Europe woke to a multi-decade rearmament cycle. The leg topped in March 2022 at the invasion's emotional peak, just as the high-beta regime (SPHB-SPLV +67.5%) began to crack.
drivers: Broad reflation/growth-up melt-up (cyclicals +73%, breadth wide) amplifies the rally
Russia-Ukraine invasion (Feb 2022) ignites a European rearmament re-rate
Rate-regime: yields surged (TLT -21.1%) but risk-on dominated
2020-07-09.title_zh: 新冠后缓步走高迎俄乌买盘，搭乘再通胀融涨（+70%）
2020-07-09.body_zh: 国防自 2020 年新冠低谷爬升，进入广泛的再通胀/增长上行 regime（SPY +47.6%、周期股 +73% 对防御 +35.5%、市场广度宽 RSP-SPY +14%），即便收益率飙升（TLT -21.1%）也抬升了整个风险资产群。2022 年 2 月俄罗斯入侵把周期复苏变成强烈的地缘重估——随着欧洲意识到数十年重整军备周期，LMT/RTX 获买盘。该腿段于 2022 年 3 月入侵情绪高峰见顶，恰逢高贝塔 regime（SPHB-SPLV +67.5%）开始破裂。
drivers_zh: 广泛再通胀/增长上行融涨（周期股 +73%、广度宽）放大涨幅
俄乌战争爆发（2022 年 2 月）点燃欧洲重整军备重估
数十年北约国防预算上行周期叙事
利率 regime：收益率飙升（TLT -21.1%）但风险偏好主导

2022-03-25.title: Hiking-bear, rate-driven pullback off the war spike (-21%)
2022-03-25.body: Even a war bid couldn't resist the 2022 Fed-hiking bear: a rate-driven slowdown/deflation-scare regime (yields surged, TLT -12.7%; DXY +4.9%; VIX 21->33) compressed every multiple into the June low. Defensives outperformed cyclicals (-10% vs -17.5%) in a flight-to-safety, but defense de-rated with the cyclical-cyclical crowd. The de-rate was pure macro — order books were swelling even as the strong dollar and surging yields hit the primes.
drivers: Rate-regime move: yields surged (TLT -12.7%) compress all multiples
Strong dollar (DXY +4.9%) pressures the exporting primes
Profit-taking after the sharp invasion-week spike
2022-03-25.title_zh: 加息熊市利率驱动从战争尖峰回落（-21%）
2022-03-25.body_zh: 即便有战争买盘也难抵 2022 年美联储加息熊市：一个利率驱动的放缓/通缩恐慌 regime（收益率飙升，TLT -12.7%；DXY +4.9%；VIX 21->33）把每个倍数压缩至 6 月低点。避险（risk-off）中防御跑赢周期（-10% 对 -17.5%），但国防随周期股去估值。这是纯宏观去估值——订单簿仍在膨胀，强势美元与飙升收益率却冲击主承包商。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime 移动：收益率飙升（TLT -12.7%）压缩所有倍数
避险放缓恐慌（VIX 21->33）、避险轮动
强势美元（DXY +4.9%）施压出口型主承包商
入侵当周急升后的获利了结

2022-06-16.title: Summer relief bounce in a tech-led risk-on window (+23%)
2022-06-16.body: Defense rode the broad mid-2022 relief rally as a tech/semis-led risk-on regime took hold (SMH +19.5%, growth>value +8.8, VIX 33->20) on hopes of a Fed pause that never came. A fast, multiple-driven bounce off oversold — defense participated but lagged the high-beta growth that leads these windows, with a strong dollar (DXY +2.8%) still a mild drag.
drivers: Premature 'Fed pivot' hopes lift the whole complex
Strong order backlog as a floor under the group
Dollar (DXY +2.8%) a mild headwind for the primes
2022-06-16.title_zh: 夏季纾困反弹于科技引领的风险偏好窗口（+23%）
2022-06-16.body_zh: 国防搭上 2022 年年中大盘纾困反弹，一个科技/半导体引领的风险偏好 regime（半导体 +19.5%、成长>价值 +8.8、VIX 33->20）因美联储暂停预期（最终未现）而成形。这是从超卖出发、倍数驱动的快速反弹——国防参与但落后于领涨这类窗口的高贝塔成长，强势美元（DXY +2.8%）仍是轻微拖累。
drivers_zh: 科技/半导体引领风险偏好反弹（半导体 +19.5%、成长>价值），VIX 33->20
过早的'美联储转向'预期抬升整个群组
强劲订单积压为板块托底
美元（DXY +2.8%）对主承包商轻微逆风

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole hawkish, rate-driven flush (-19%)
2022-08-16.body: Powell's hawkish Jackson Hole reset killed the summer rally and triggered a rate-driven slowdown regime (yields surged, TLT -11.4%; DXY +5.3%; VIX 20->32) into the September-2022 capitulation low. Defense fell with everything — semis -24%, cyclicals -15.3% — a macro de-risk rather than a defense-specific problem, with the dollar spike adding pressure on the exporting primes.
drivers: Rate-regime move: yields surged (TLT -11.4%) on hawkish Jackson Hole
Broad risk-off capitulation (VIX 20->32, semis -24%) into the autumn low
Dollar surge (DXY +5.3%) pressuring the multinational primes
2022-08-16.title_zh: 杰克逊霍尔鹰派、利率驱动冲刷（-19%）
2022-08-16.body_zh: 鲍威尔杰克逊霍尔鹰派重置终结夏季反弹，触发利率驱动的放缓 regime（收益率飙升，TLT -11.4%；DXY +5.3%；VIX 20->32），跌至 2022 年 9 月投降低点。国防随一切下跌——半导体 -24%、周期股 -15.3%——这是宏观去风险而非国防特有问题，美元飙升对出口型主承包商再添压力。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime 移动：收益率飙升（TLT -11.4%），杰克逊霍尔鹰派
广泛避险投降（VIX 20->32、半导体 -24%）至秋季低点
美元飙升（DXY +5.3%）施压跨国主承包商
鹰派终端利率重新定价

2022-09-30.title: The long war-and-budget bull inside a goldilocks AI melt-up (+150%)
2022-09-30.body: From the autumn-2022 low defense ran two-plus years — its best stretch of the cycle — and the regime amplified it: a goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation melt-up (SMH +189.7%, growth>value +48.4, VIX 32->15, weaker dollar -3.6%) lifted the whole risk complex. The tape was narrow and mega-cap-led (RSP-SPY -25.9%), so defense leaned on its own fuel — Ukraine resupply, the Oct-2023 Mideast escalation, surging NATO budgets — to keep pace into a January-2025 top. War demand met record spending met a risk-on backdrop.
drivers: Goldilocks AI melt-up regime (SMH +189.7%, growth>value, VIX 32->15) lifts risk
Sustained Russia-Ukraine resupply and replenishment orders
Oct-2023 Mideast war adds a second conflict bid
NATO members ratcheting toward and above 2% of GDP; narrow breadth (RSP-SPY -25.9%)
2022-09-30.title_zh: 漫长战争与预算牛市，置于 goldilocks AI 融涨之中（+150%）
2022-09-30.body_zh: 从 2022 年秋季低点起国防连涨两年多——本周期最强一段——而 regime 放大了它：一个 goldilocks/增长上行去通胀融涨（半导体 +189.7%、成长>价值 +48.4、VIX 32->15、美元走弱 -3.6%）抬升整个风险资产群。市场狭窄、大盘股引领（RSP-SPY -25.9%），故国防靠自身燃料——乌克兰补给、2023 年 10 月中东升级、激增的北约预算——保持步调至 2025 年 1 月高点。战争需求遇上创纪录开支遇上风险偏好背景。
drivers_zh: Goldilocks AI 融涨 regime（半导体 +189.7%、成长>价值、VIX 32->15）抬升风险
持续的俄乌补给与补充订单
2023 年 10 月中东战争增添第二处冲突买盘
北约成员国预算迈向并超过 GDP 2%；市场广度狭窄（RSP-SPY -25.9%）

2025-01-21.title: Trump-trade unwind & DOGE-cut fears into a risk-off flush (-15%)
2025-01-21.body: Policy flipped the script just as the regime turned violently risk-off: a slowdown/deflation-scare flush (VIX 15->45, SMH -31.1%, SPHB-SPLV -25.4%) hit high-beta hardest, and the DeepSeek AI scare plus April-tariff fears compounded it. On top of that came defense-specific damage — talk of halving spending, ~8%/yr DOGE reprioritization, threats to legacy programs (F-35, armored vehicles) — that hit LMT/RTX even as defensives outperformed (-3.1% vs cyclicals -16.5%). The 'Trump = more defense' assumption broke into a falling tape.
drivers: Risk-off flush regime (VIX 15->45, high-beta SPHB-SPLV -25.4%) leads lower
Threats to legacy programs the primes depend on
DeepSeek shock + broad late-Jan de-risk; defensives led (-3.1% vs -16.5%)
2025-01-21.title_zh: 特朗普交易平仓与 DOGE 削减恐慌，置于避险冲刷（-15%）
2025-01-21.body_zh: 政策扭转剧本，恰逢 regime 剧烈转向避险：一次放缓/通缩恐慌冲刷（VIX 15->45、半导体 -31.1%、SPHB-SPLV -25.4%）对高贝塔打击最重，DeepSeek AI 恐慌加 4 月关税担忧雪上加霜。在此之上是国防特有的损伤——开支减半之议、每年约 8% DOGE 重新排序、对传统项目（F-35、装甲车）的威胁——冲击 LMT/RTX，即便防御跑赢（-3.1% 对周期 -16.5%）。'特朗普=更多国防'的假设在下跌行情中破裂。
drivers_zh: 避险冲刷 regime（VIX 15->45、高贝塔 SPHB-SPLV -25.4%）领跌
DOGE 五角大楼效率行动瞄准每年约 8% 削减
威胁主承包商赖以为生的传统项目
DeepSeek 冲击+1 月底普遍去风险；防御领先（-3.1% 对 -16.5%）

2025-04-04.title: Recovery off the tariff-crash low in a high-beta risk-on rip (+111%)
2025-04-04.body: Defense bottomed with the whole market at the April-8 reciprocal-tariff crash and then staged its sharpest run of the cycle, amplified by an explosive high-beta risk-on regime (VIX 45->16, SMH +122.1%, SPHB-SPLV +74.9%, weaker dollar -3.5%). A re-escalating geopolitical backdrop, allied rearmament and a re-think of the cut narrative drove it +111% into a January-2026 peak — the basket's most explosive leg, where a snap-back from deeply oversold met a market begging for beta.
drivers: Explosive high-beta risk-on regime (VIX 45->16, SPHB-SPLV +74.9%, SMH +122.1%) amplifies the snap-back
Snap-back off the April-2025 reciprocal-tariff crash low
Allied rearmament and Ukraine/Mideast escalation re-bid
Weaker dollar (DXY -3.5%); reassessment of worst-case budget cuts
2025-04-04.title_zh: 从关税崩盘低点回升，置于高贝塔风险偏好暴涨（+111%）
2025-04-04.body_zh: 国防随整个市场在 4 月 8 日对等关税崩盘触底，随后上演本周期最陡一段，被爆发性的高贝塔风险偏好 regime（VIX 45->16、半导体 +122.1%、SPHB-SPLV +74.9%、美元走弱 -3.5%）放大。地缘背景再升级、盟友重整军备、对削减叙事的重新思考，推升 +111% 至 2026 年 1 月高点——该篮子最具爆发力的腿，深度超卖的弹回遇上一个渴求贝塔的市场。
drivers_zh: 爆发性高贝塔风险偏好 regime（VIX 45->16、SPHB-SPLV +74.9%、半导体 +122.1%）放大弹回
从 2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘低点弹回
盟友重整军备与乌克兰/中东升级再买入
美元走弱（DXY -3.5%）；对最坏情形预算削减的重新评估

2026-01-16.title: Top rolls over on budget reality in a stagflation-ish tape (-18%)
2026-01-16.body: The January-2026 high faded as budget reality reasserted itself into a stagflation-ish regime (VIX 16->31, oil +73.1% on the Hormuz shock, energy the lone leader +30.8%). Risk-off but shallow (SPY -8.4%), with the dollar firming (DXY +1.1%) — a headwind for exporters. The headline DOGE reprioritization plus rotation out of the leg's parabolic run gave back -18% into late March, setting up the current bottoming, lagging posture.
drivers: Stagflation-ish regime (VIX 16->31, oil +73.1% Hormuz shock) caps risk
2026-01-16.title_zh: 见顶后因预算现实回落，置于类滞胀行情（-18%）
2026-01-16.body_zh: 随预算现实重新主导，2026 年 1 月高点回落，进入类滞胀 regime（VIX 16->31、油价 +73.1% 因霍尔木兹冲击、能源是唯一领头 +30.8%）。避险但浅（SPY -8.4%），美元转强（DXY +1.1%）——对出口商逆风。DOGE 重新排序加上从抛物线行情中的轮动，下挫 -18% 至 3 月底，奠定当前筑底、落后姿态。
drivers_zh: 类滞胀 regime（VIX 16->31、油价 +73.1% 霍尔木兹冲击）压制风险
预算削减与项目合理化现实重新定价
美元转强（DXY +1.1%）对出口商构成逆风
抛物线 +111% 腿段后的轮动/获利了结

2026-03-30.title: Tentative bounce, but lagging the narrow risk-on tape (+16%)
2026-03-30.body: A shallow recovery off the March low into a renewed tech/semis-led risk-on regime (SMH +65.5%, growth>value +10.3, VIX 31->16) — but defense lacked the relative-strength leadership to confirm a new uptrend and still ranks #32, the basket's chronic problem in a narrow, mega-cap-led tape (RSP-SPY -8.8%). The June-2026 Mideast flare and ceasefire kept defense demand topical, but in a market rewarding AI beta the group needs order flow, not headlines, to re-rate.
drivers: Narrow tech/semis-led risk-on tape (SMH +65.5%, RSP-SPY -8.8%) leaves defense behind
Oversold bounce off the March-2026 low
June-2026 Iran/Hormuz flare keeps defense demand topical
Awaiting order-book confirmation; RS still lagging at #32
2026-03-30.title_zh: 试探性反弹，却落后于狭窄的风险偏好行情（+16%）
2026-03-30.body_zh: 从 3 月低点出发的浅幅回升，进入重燃的科技/半导体引领风险偏好 regime（半导体 +65.5%、成长>价值 +10.3、VIX 31->16）——但国防缺乏相对强度领导力确认新上升趋势，仍排第 32 位，这是它在狭窄、大盘股引领行情（RSP-SPY -8.8%）中的痼疾。2026 年 6 月中东突发与停火让国防需求保持热度，但在奖励 AI 贝塔的市场里，板块重估需要订单流而非头条。
drivers_zh: 狭窄科技/半导体引领风险偏好行情（半导体 +65.5%、RSP-SPY -8.8%）把国防甩在身后
从 2026 年 3 月低点超卖反弹
2026 年 6 月伊朗/霍尔木兹突发使国防需求保持热度
等待订单簿确认；相对强度仍落后于第 32 位

reshoring.now: Reshoring & Industrial Capex (XLI proxy) is the policy-tailwind trade with the receipts, and the current regime suits it: a broadening reflation/growth-up tape (cyclicals +11.2% vs defensives +6.9%, equal-weight beating cap-weight by +2.9%, oil +19.2%) favors capex-cyclicals over pure AI beta. CHIPS/IRA/IIJA drove a real factory-construction boom — manufacturing construction spend roughly tripled from ~$80B/yr (2019) to ~$224B/yr by late 2025, $630B+ across 140 semiconductor projects. The 2024 Trump election layered an explicit reshoring/tariff lever on top. The basket is 'Trending', mid-pack at RS-rank #16 (pos 60.4), up +89% since the April-2025 low — a durable secondary leader, though a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%) is a mild headwind for its industrial multinationals. Not a parabolic momentum name like the chip-equipment complex, but a broadening tape is exactly its kind of regime.
reshoring.now_zh: 制造业回流与工业资本开支（XLI 为代理）是有实据支撑的政策顺风交易，当前 regime 也对它有利：一个广度扩张的再通胀/增长上行行情（周期股 +11.2% 对防御 +6.9%、等权跑赢市值权重 +2.9%、油价 +19.2%）偏好资本开支周期股而非纯 AI 高贝塔。CHIPS/IRA/IIJA 驱动了真实的工厂建设热潮——制造业建设开支从 2019 年约 800 亿美元/年大致翻三倍至 2025 年底约 2240 亿美元/年，140 个半导体项目逾 6300 亿美元。2024 年特朗普当选叠加了明确的回流/关税杠杆。该篮子'趋势中'，相对强度排名居中（第 16 位，pos 60.4），自 2025 年 4 月低点 +89%——一个耐久的次级领头羊，尽管走强的美元（DXY +3.4%）对其工业跨国企业是轻微逆风。它不像芯片设备群那样是抛物线动量品种，但市场广度（breadth）扩张恰是它的 regime。

2021-11-16.title: Hiking-bear, rate-and-dollar de-rate (-25%)
2021-11-16.body: Industrials de-rated through H1 2022 in a stagflation-ish regime — yields surged (TLT -19.4%), the dollar ripped (DXY +13.2%, a brutal headwind for industrial multinationals) and VIX ran 16->26 — as the Fed-hiking bear and China's COVID lockdowns crushed cyclical sentiment. Defensives held (+1.4%) while cyclicals fell -15.7% in a flight-to-safety. The reshoring thesis was nascent (CHIPS Act passed Aug 2022), so the group traded as plain rate-sensitive cyclicals into the June low.
drivers: Rate-regime + dollar shock (TLT -19.4%, DXY +13.2%) compress cyclical multiples
China COVID lockdowns disrupt supply chains
Reshoring policy not yet a catalyst (pre-CHIPS Act)
2021-11-16.title_zh: 加息熊市、利率与美元去估值（-25%）
2021-11-16.body_zh: 工业在 2022 年上半年于类滞胀 regime 去估值——收益率飙升（TLT -19.4%）、美元暴涨（DXY +13.2%，对工业跨国企业是残酷逆风）、VIX 16->26——美联储加息熊市和中国新冠封控压垮周期情绪。避险（risk-off）中防御守住（+1.4%），周期股跌 -15.7%。回流主题尚处萌芽（CHIPS 法案 2022 年 8 月通过），故板块作为普通利率敏感周期股交易至 6 月低点。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime+美元冲击（TLT -19.4%、DXY +13.2%）压缩周期股倍数
中国新冠封控扰乱供应链
回流政策尚未成为催化剂（CHIPS 法案前）

2022-07-14.title: Summer pause-hope bounce in a reflation risk-on window (+23%)
2022-07-14.body: A broad relief rally off the June low as the regime turned reflation/growth-up risk-on (cyclicals +16.7% vs defensives +7.6%, SMH +16.3%, growth>value, VIX 26->20, dollar easing -1.9%) on premature Fed-pause hopes. Industrials — geared to the cyclical, weaker-dollar trade — participated well; the CHIPS Act passing in August seeded an emerging structural narrative under the cyclical bounce.
drivers: Easing dollar (DXY -1.9%) tailwind for industrial multinationals
CHIPS Act passage (Aug 2022) seeds the reshoring thesis
2022-07-14.title_zh: 夏季暂停预期反弹于再通胀风险偏好窗口（+23%）
2022-07-14.body_zh: 从 6 月低点出发的大盘纾困反弹，regime 转向再通胀/增长上行风险偏好（周期股 +16.7% 对防御 +7.6%、半导体 +16.3%、成长>价值、VIX 26->20、美元走弱 -1.9%），因过早的美联储暂停预期。工业——偏向周期、弱美元交易——参与良好；8 月 CHIPS 法案通过在周期反弹之下播下新兴结构性叙事。
drivers_zh: 再通胀/增长上行风险偏好反弹（周期股 +16.7%、VIX 26->20）
美元走弱（DXY -1.9%）对工业跨国企业顺风
CHIPS 法案通过（2022 年 8 月）播下回流主题种子
过早的'美联储暂停'仓位

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole rate-driven flush (-18%)
2022-08-16.body: Powell's hawkish reset triggered a rate-driven slowdown regime (yields surged, TLT -12.7%; DXY +7.1%; VIX 20->33) into the autumn-2022 capitulation low. Macro, not fundamental — factory-construction commitments kept building underneath, but the surging dollar and yields hit the industrial multinationals (cyclicals -15.0% vs defensives -10.3%) regardless.
drivers: Rate-regime move: yields surged (TLT -12.7%) on hawkish Jackson Hole
Broad risk-off capitulation (VIX 20->33) into the autumn low
2022-08-16.title_zh: 杰克逊霍尔利率驱动冲刷（-18%）
2022-08-16.body_zh: 鲍威尔鹰派重置触发利率驱动的放缓 regime（收益率飙升，TLT -12.7%；DXY +7.1%；VIX 20->33），跌至 2022 年秋季投降低点。这是宏观而非基本面——工厂建设承诺仍在累积，但飙升的美元与收益率不分青红皂白地冲击工业跨国企业（周期股 -15.0% 对防御 -10.3%）。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime 移动：收益率飙升（TLT -12.7%），杰克逊霍尔鹰派
广泛避险投降（VIX 20->33）至秋季低点
美元走强（DXY +7.1%）施压工业跨国企业
鹰派终端利率重新定价

2022-09-27.title: The reshoring bull inside a goldilocks AI melt-up (+103%)
2022-09-27.body: From the autumn-2022 low industrials more than doubled over two-plus years — the cleanest expression of the reshoring/capex super-cycle, supercharged by a goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation melt-up (SMH +156.4%, growth>value +35.6, VIX 33->14, weaker dollar -6.2%). CHIPS/IRA/IIJA money flowed into shovels-in-the-ground projects; the 2023 AI rally and 2024 Fed cuts lifted risk; the Nov-2024 'Trump reshoring trade' compounded the bid into a November-2024 top. The tape was narrow/mega-cap-led (RSP-SPY -19.1%), but the weaker dollar was a clean tailwind for the multinationals.
drivers: Goldilocks AI melt-up regime (SMH +156.4%, growth>value, VIX 33->14) lifts risk
Weaker dollar (DXY -6.2%) tailwind; CHIPS/IRA/IIJA funding hits real spend
Electrification and AI-power capex emerging; narrow breadth (RSP-SPY -19.1%)
2022-09-27.title_zh: 回流牛市，置于 goldilocks AI 融涨之中（+103%）
2022-09-27.body_zh: 从 2022 年秋季低点起工业翻倍有余——回流/资本开支超级周期最清晰的表达，被 goldilocks/增长上行去通胀融涨（半导体 +156.4%、成长>价值 +35.6、VIX 33->14、美元走弱 -6.2%）大幅增强。CHIPS/IRA/IIJA 资金流入破土项目；2023 年 AI 反弹与 2024 年降息抬升风险；2024 年 11 月'特朗普回流交易'把买盘叠加至 2024 年 11 月高点。市场狭窄、大盘股引领（RSP-SPY -19.1%），但走弱美元对跨国企业是干净顺风。
drivers_zh: Goldilocks AI 融涨 regime（半导体 +156.4%、成长>价值、VIX 33->14）抬升风险
美元走弱（DXY -6.2%）顺风；CHIPS/IRA/IIJA 资金落地为实际开支
2024 年 11 月大选确立'回流/特朗普交易'
电气化与 AI 电力资本开支兴起；市场广度狭窄（RSP-SPY -19.1%）

2024-11-26.title: Tariff-crash selloff in a risk-off flush (-28%)
2024-11-26.body: The 'Trump trade' euphoria gave way to its dark side as the regime flipped violently risk-off (VIX 14->52, SMH -25.1%, SPHB-SPLV -19.7%) into the April-8 reciprocal-tariff crash. Globalized industrial supply chains were hit hardest — input costs, retaliation risk and demand fears at once — and defensives led (-8.4% vs cyclicals -19.0%). Reshoring beneficiaries sold off with the broad market despite being the structural policy winners.
drivers: Risk-off flush regime (VIX 14->52, high-beta SPHB-SPLV -19.7%) leads lower
April-2025 reciprocal-tariff crash hits supply chains
Rotation out of a parabolic two-year industrial run; defensives led (-8.4% vs -19.0%)
2024-11-26.title_zh: 关税崩盘抛售，置于避险冲刷（-28%）
2024-11-26.body_zh: '特朗普交易'狂热让位于其阴暗面，regime 剧烈转向避险（VIX 14->52、半导体 -25.1%、SPHB-SPLV -19.7%），跌入 4 月 8 日对等关税崩盘。全球化工业供应链打击最重——投入成本、报复风险、需求担忧同时袭来——防御领先（-8.4% 对周期 -19.0%）。回流受益者虽是政策的结构性赢家，却随大盘抛售。
drivers_zh: 避险冲刷 regime（VIX 14->52、高贝塔 SPHB-SPLV -19.7%）领跌
2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘冲击供应链
关税投入成本与报复担忧
从抛物线式两年工业行情中轮动出场；防御领先（-8.4% 对 -19.0%）

2025-04-08.title: Recovery & AI-power capex leg, lifted by a high-beta risk-on rip (+89%)
2025-04-08.body: Off the April-8 low reshoring recovered strongly inside an explosive risk-on regime (VIX 52->19, SMH +255%, SPHB-SPLV +118.3%, weaker dollar -1.5%) that lifted everything cyclical. The tariff regime that caused the crash also hardens the long-run onshoring case, while electrification and AI-datacenter-power capex became a second engine. Up +89% into June 2026, the basket is a steady secondary leader (RS #16) — durable and policy-backed, lagging the parabolic semis but riding the broad cyclical recovery rather than narrow mega-cap (RSP-SPY -8.8%).
drivers: Explosive risk-on regime (VIX 52->19, SMH +255%, SPHB-SPLV +118.3%) lifts cyclicals
Tariff regime reinforces structural onshoring incentive
Electrification + AI-datacenter-power capex as a fresh demand engine
2025-04-08.title_zh: 回升与 AI 电力资本开支腿段，被高贝塔风险偏好暴涨抬升（+89%）
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从 4 月 8 日低点起，回流强势回升于爆发性风险偏好 regime（VIX 52->19、半导体 +255%、SPHB-SPLV +118.3%、美元走弱 -1.5%），抬升一切周期品种。引发崩盘的关税体制也强化了长期本土化逻辑，而电气化与 AI 数据中心电力资本开支成为第二引擎。至 2026 年 6 月 +89%，该篮子是稳健的次级领头羊（相对强度第 16 位）——耐久、有政策支撑，落后于抛物线半导体，但搭乘广泛周期复苏而非狭窄大盘股（RSP-SPY -8.8%）。
drivers_zh: 爆发性风险偏好 regime（VIX 52->19、半导体 +255%、SPHB-SPLV +118.3%）抬升周期股
关税体制强化结构性本土化激励
电气化+AI 数据中心电力资本开支成为新需求引擎
创纪录的制造业建设开支（约 2240 亿美元/年）；市场广度狭窄（RSP-SPY -8.8%）

robotics_automation.now: Robotics & Automation (ABB/ROK/industrial controls, machine vision, surgical robotics; BOTZ proxy) is a quality industrial-tech theme caught mid-correction — a high-beta name whose moves amplify the regime in both directions. It's 'Rolling over' at RS-rank #20 (pos 35.9): the basket nearly doubled (+90%) off the April-2025 tariff-crash low into a May-2026 high, then began consolidating as the tape shifted from explosive risk-on toward a broadening reflation regime (cyclicals +11.2% vs defensives +6.9%, growth lagging value -15.2%) that no longer rewards long-duration industrial-tech. The thesis fuses classic factory-automation capex (overlapping reshoring) with the newer 'physical AI / humanoid' narrative. Near-term it digests a parabolic run against a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%) and sticky-CPI 2026 backdrop that pressure the industrial-multinational and capital-equipment buyers at its core.
robotics_automation.now_zh: 机器人与自动化（ABB/ROK/工业控制、机器视觉、手术机器人；BOTZ 为代理）是一个处于回调中段的优质工业科技主题——一个高贝塔品种，其运动在两个方向都放大 regime。它'见顶回落'，相对强度排名第 20 位（pos 35.9）：该篮子从 2025 年 4 月关税崩盘低点近乎翻倍（+90%）至 2026 年 5 月高点，随后开始盘整，因行情从爆发性风险偏好转向广度扩张的再通胀 regime（周期股 +11.2% 对防御 +6.9%、成长落后价值 -15.2%），不再奖励长久期工业科技。其逻辑融合经典工厂自动化资本开支（与回流重叠）和较新的'实体 AI/人形机器人'叙事。短期内它消化一段抛物线行情，背景是走强的美元（DXY +3.4%）和粘性 CPI 的 2026 年，这压制了位于核心的工业跨国企业和资本设备买家。

2021-12-27.title: Hiking-bear, rate-driven growth de-rate (-29%)
2021-12-27.body: High-multiple automation/robotics names led the 2022 growth-stock de-rate in a stagflation-ish, rate-driven regime — yields surged (TLT -20.3%), the dollar ripped (DXY +8.1%) and VIX ran 18->33. As long-duration industrial-tech, the group got hit harder than plain cyclicals (growth-value -18.1%) into the May-2022 low, even as breadth held (RSP-SPY +4.5%).
drivers: Rate-regime + dollar shock (TLT -20.3%, DXY +8.1%) crush long-duration multiples
High-beta rotation out of industrial tech
2021-12-27.title_zh: 加息熊市、利率驱动成长去估值（-29%）
2021-12-27.body_zh: 高倍数自动化/机器人个股领跌 2022 年成长股去估值，处于类滞胀、利率驱动 regime——收益率飙升（TLT -20.3%）、美元暴涨（DXY +8.1%）、VIX 18->33。作为长久期工业科技，该板块所受冲击重于普通周期股（成长-价值 -18.1%），跌至 2022 年 5 月低点，尽管市场广度守住（RSP-SPY +4.5%）。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime+美元冲击（TLT -20.3%、DXY +8.1%）压垮长久期倍数
类滞胀避险（VIX 18->33）、成长去估值（成长-价值 -18.1%）
供应链/元件短缺冲击硬件
从工业科技中高贝塔轮动

2022-05-11.title: Summer relief bounce in a growth-led risk-on window (+26%)
2022-05-11.body: Caught the broad mid-2022 relief rally off oversold as the regime briefly turned goldilocks/growth-up (growth>value +7.8, SMH +11.7%, VIX 33->20) on premature Fed-pause hopes. A multiple-driven bounce where high-beta automation amplified the upside (SPHB-SPLV +12.6%) — not a fundamental turn.
drivers: Growth-led risk-on bounce (growth>value +7.8, VIX 33->20) amplifies high-beta
2022-05-11.title_zh: 夏季纾困反弹于成长引领的风险偏好窗口（+26%）
2022-05-11.body_zh: 从超卖中搭上 2022 年年中大盘纾困反弹，因过早的美联储暂停预期，regime 短暂转向 goldilocks/增长上行（成长>价值 +7.8、半导体 +11.7%、VIX 33->20）。倍数驱动的反弹，高贝塔自动化放大上行（SPHB-SPLV +12.6%）——而非基本面转折。
drivers_zh: 成长引领风险偏好反弹（成长>价值 +7.8、VIX 33->20）放大高贝塔
过早的'美联储转向'预期
元件短缺缓解的乐观情绪

2022-08-12.title: Jackson Hole rate-driven flush (-21%)
2022-08-12.body: Powell's hawkish reset ended the bounce in a rate-driven slowdown regime (yields surged, TLT -12.5%; DXY +8.0%; VIX 20->33) into the autumn-2022 capitulation low. Pure macro de-risking of long-duration tech — the strong dollar an extra weight on the industrial multinationals (cyclicals -14.7%).
drivers: Rate-regime move: yields surged (TLT -12.5%) on hawkish Jackson Hole
2022-08-12.title_zh: 杰克逊霍尔利率驱动冲刷（-21%）
2022-08-12.body_zh: 鲍威尔鹰派重置在利率驱动的放缓 regime（收益率飙升，TLT -12.5%；DXY +8.0%；VIX 20->33）中终结反弹，跌至 2022 年秋季投降低点。纯粹是对长久期科技的宏观去风险——强势美元对工业跨国企业再添重压（周期股 -14.7%）。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime 移动：收益率飙升（TLT -12.5%），杰克逊霍尔鹰派
美元飙升（DXY +8.0%）施压工业跨国企业

2022-09-27.title: AI-rally recovery in a goldilocks, weaker-dollar tape (+63%)
2022-09-27.body: From the autumn-2022 low the group rode the 2023 AI rally in a goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation regime (SMH +69.6%, growth>value +11.6, VIX 33->14, dollar collapsing -10.7%) — a weaker-dollar tailwind for the industrial multinationals. Automation re-rated as a near-AI industrial-tech beneficiary in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP-SPY -5.0%), topping in July 2023 as early-AI enthusiasm cooled.
drivers: Goldilocks AI risk-on regime (SMH +69.6%, growth>value, VIX 33->14)
2022-09-27.title_zh: AI 反弹回升于 goldilocks、弱美元行情（+63%）
2022-09-27.body_zh: 从 2022 年秋季低点起，该板块在 goldilocks/增长上行去通胀 regime（半导体 +69.6%、成长>价值 +11.6、VIX 33->14、美元崩跌 -10.7%）中搭乘 2023 年 AI 反弹——弱美元对工业跨国企业是顺风。自动化作为近 AI 工业科技受益者在狭窄大盘股行情（RSP-SPY -5.0%）中获重估，随早期 AI 热情降温于 2023 年 7 月见顶。
drivers_zh: Goldilocks AI 风险偏好 regime（半导体 +69.6%、成长>价值、VIX 33->14）
美元崩跌（DXY -10.7%）对跨国企业顺风
回流资本开支叙事支撑订单簿
近 AI 重估；市场广度狭窄（RSP-SPY -5.0%）

2023-07-31.title: Rate-scare, yield-driven pullback (-22%)
2023-07-31.body: The autumn-2023 bond-yield spike (10Y toward 5%, TLT -13.9%) defined the regime and hit rate-sensitive growth and industrial-tech hardest (SPHB-SPLV -13.6%), with a firming dollar (DXY +4.9%). A clean rates-driven correction into the late-October low — even with growth>value holding (+3.1), the duration hit dominated.
drivers: Rate-regime move: 10Y spike toward 5% (TLT -13.9%) hits duration
2023-07-31.title_zh: 利率恐慌、收益率驱动回落（-22%）
2023-07-31.body_zh: 2023 年秋季债券收益率飙升（10 年期逼近 5%、TLT -13.9%）定义了 regime，对利率敏感的成长与工业科技打击最重（SPHB-SPLV -13.6%），伴随美元转强（DXY +4.9%）。一次干净的利率驱动回调至 10 月底低点——即便成长>价值守住（+3.1），久期冲击仍主导。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime 移动：10 年期逼近 5%（TLT -13.9%）冲击久期
更高更久重新定价压垮成长倍数（SPHB-SPLV -13.6%）
AI 反弹腿段后的获利了结

2023-11-01.title: Soft-landing rally on a falling-yield, risk-on regime (+48%)
2023-11-01.body: The late-2023 dovish pivot drove a goldilocks regime where yields fell (TLT +13.6%), VIX dropped 17->13, semis ripped (+93.4%) and growth>value (+16.7) — the duration tailwind that had been a headwind. Automation rode broad risk into a July-2024 top in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP-SPY -7.5%), with reshoring capex and early physical-AI optimism adding a thematic bid.
drivers: Goldilocks risk-on regime: yields fell (TLT +13.6%), VIX 17->13, SMH +93.4%
Late-2023 Fed dovish pivot, 2024 cut cycle
2023-11-01.title_zh: 软着陆反弹于收益率下行、风险偏好 regime（+48%）
2023-11-01.body_zh: 2023 年底鸽派转向驱动一个 goldilocks regime，收益率下行（TLT +13.6%）、VIX 17->13、半导体暴涨（+93.4%）、成长>价值（+16.7）——曾经的久期逆风转为顺风。自动化搭乘大盘风险至 2024 年 7 月高点，处于狭窄大盘股行情（RSP-SPY -7.5%），回流资本开支与早期实体 AI 乐观增添主题买盘。
drivers_zh: Goldilocks 风险偏好 regime：收益率下行（TLT +13.6%）、VIX 17->13、半导体 +93.4%
2023 年底美联储鸽派转向、2024 年降息周期
回流资本开支+早期'实体 AI'叙事

2024-07-16.title: Yen-carry unwind, high-beta flush (-16%)
2024-07-16.body: The early-August 2024 yen-carry-trade unwind triggered a sharp risk-off flush (VIX 13->28, SMH -22.7%, SPHB-SPLV -14.6%); high-beta automation amplified the move into the August low while defensives held (+0.9% vs cyclicals -8.1%). Sharp and brief — a positioning shock, not a fundamental change.
drivers: Risk-off flush regime (VIX 13->28, high-beta SPHB-SPLV -14.6%) hits hardest
Global high-beta de-risking; defensives led (+0.9% vs -8.1%)
2024-07-16.title_zh: 日元套利平仓、高贝塔冲刷（-16%）
2024-07-16.body_zh: 2024 年 8 月初日元套利交易平仓触发急剧避险冲刷（VIX 13->28、半导体 -22.7%、SPHB-SPLV -14.6%）；高贝塔自动化放大跌势至 8 月低点，防御守住（+0.9% 对周期 -8.1%）。急促而短暂——是仓位冲击而非基本面变化。
drivers_zh: 避险冲刷 regime（VIX 13->28、高贝塔 SPHB-SPLV -14.6%）打击最重
2024 年 8 月日元套利交易平仓
全球高贝塔去风险；防御领先（+0.9% 对 -8.1%）

2024-08-07.title: Election & physical-AI bid in a goldilocks risk-on tape (+26%)
2024-08-07.body: Recovered off the August low into a November-2024 high as the regime turned goldilocks/growth-up risk-on (cyclicals +18.3% vs defensives +5.9%, SMH +15.2%, VIX 28->15). The 'Trump reshoring trade' and intensifying physical-AI/humanoid enthusiasm met capex optimism — though a firming dollar (DXY +3.5%) was a mild headwind for the multinationals.
drivers: Goldilocks risk-on regime (cyclicals +18.3%, VIX 28->15) lifts the group
2024-08-07.title_zh: 大选与实体 AI 买盘于 goldilocks 风险偏好行情（+26%）
2024-08-07.body_zh: 从 8 月低点回升至 2024 年 11 月高点，regime 转向 goldilocks/增长上行风险偏好（周期股 +18.3% 对防御 +5.9%、半导体 +15.2%、VIX 28->15）。'特朗普回流交易'与日益高涨的实体 AI/人形机器人热情遇上资本开支乐观——尽管美元转强（DXY +3.5%）对跨国企业是轻微逆风。
drivers_zh: Goldilocks 风险偏好 regime（周期股 +18.3%、VIX 28->15）抬升板块
2024 年 11 月大选'回流/特朗普交易'
实体 AI/人形机器人叙事升温

2024-11-25.title: Tariff-crash selloff, high-beta amplifies the flush (-33%)
2024-11-25.body: Robotics took a deep hit into the April-8 reciprocal-tariff crash as the regime collapsed to violent risk-off (VIX 15->52, SMH -25.8%, SPHB-SPLV -21.0%). Its globalized hardware supply chains sit squarely in the tariff blast radius, and high beta meant it fell harder than the market (-33% vs SPY -16.4%) — the basket's harshest drawdown of the cycle — with the DeepSeek-led tech de-rate compounding it.
drivers: Violent risk-off regime (VIX 15->52, high-beta SPHB-SPLV -21.0%) amplifies the drop
April-2025 reciprocal-tariff crash hits hardware supply chains
2024-11-25.title_zh: 关税崩盘抛售，高贝塔放大冲刷（-33%）
2024-11-25.body_zh: 机器人在 4 月 8 日对等关税崩盘中深度受挫，regime 崩塌为剧烈避险（VIX 15->52、半导体 -25.8%、SPHB-SPLV -21.0%）。其全球化硬件供应链正处关税冲击半径，高贝塔意味着跌幅大于大盘（-33% 对 SPY -16.4%）——该篮子本周期最严酷回撤——DeepSeek 引领的科技去估值雪上加霜。
drivers_zh: 剧烈避险 regime（VIX 15->52、高贝塔 SPHB-SPLV -21.0%）放大跌幅
2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘冲击硬件供应链
DeepSeek 引领的科技去估值（2025 年 1 月）加剧跌势

2025-04-08.title: Recovery & physical-AI re-rate, riding the high-beta risk-on rip (+90%)
2025-04-08.body: Off the April-8 low robotics nearly doubled (+90%) into a May-2026 high, supercharged by an explosive risk-on regime (VIX 52->17, SMH +235.7%, SPHB-SPLV +107.2%, weaker dollar -3.7%) where high beta led. The physical-AI/humanoid narrative re-accelerated and reshoring capex underpinned orders. The leg is now rolling over as the basket digests a parabolic run against a stronger dollar and sticky-CPI 2026 backdrop that pressures capital-equipment buyers.
drivers: Explosive high-beta risk-on regime (VIX 52->17, SPHB-SPLV +107.2%, SMH +235.7%) leads the run
Reshoring-capex order support; weaker dollar (DXY -3.7%) tailwind
2026 strong dollar / sticky CPI now pressures capital-equipment buyers
2025-04-08.title_zh: 回升与实体 AI 重估，搭乘高贝塔风险偏好暴涨（+90%）
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从 4 月 8 日低点起机器人近乎翻倍（+90%）至 2026 年 5 月高点，被爆发性风险偏好 regime（VIX 52->17、半导体 +235.7%、SPHB-SPLV +107.2%、美元走弱 -3.7%）大幅增强，高贝塔领涨。实体 AI/人形机器人叙事再加速、回流资本开支支撑订单。该腿段如今见顶回落，篮子在走强美元、粘性 CPI 的 2026 年背景下消化抛物线行情，这压制资本设备买家。
drivers_zh: 爆发性高贝塔风险偏好 regime（VIX 52->17、SPHB-SPLV +107.2%、半导体 +235.7%）领跑
实体 AI/人形机器人重估再加速
回流资本开支订单支撑；美元走弱（DXY -3.7%）顺风
2026 年强势美元/粘性 CPI 如今压制资本设备买家

space_economy.now: Space Economy (RKLB/launch/satcom/Earth-obs, ARKX proxy) is the high-beta speculative end of the industrials complex — a leveraged long on the regime that swings 30-40% in both directions and amplifies whatever the tape is doing. It's 'Rolling over' at RS-rank #26 (pos 43.9), having dumped -42% off a late-May-2026 high. The 2023-25 era turned space from a SPAC graveyard into a credible build-out (launch cadence, direct-to-device satcom, Earth observation, a defense-space bid), but RKLB-style names trade like long-duration call options: when risk appetite is on they melt up vertically, and when VIX spikes or a milestone slips they crater. The late-2025/2026 Neutron-rocket delays triggered exactly the 35%+ drawdown this group is prone to, even with backlogs intact, and it's now in a risk-off phase against a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%). High torque, low quality of trend; size accordingly.
space_economy.now_zh: 太空经济（RKLB/发射/卫星通信/对地观测，ARKX 为代理）是工业群组中高贝塔的投机端——一个对 regime 的杠杆多头，在两个方向都以 30-40% 摆动，放大行情的任何走向。它'见顶回落'，相对强度排名第 26 位（pos 43.9），刚从 2026 年 5 月底高点暴跌 -42%。2023-25 年间太空从 SPAC 坟场变成可信的建设浪潮（发射节奏、直连设备卫星通信、对地观测、国防航天买盘），但 RKLB 这类个股交易起来像长久期看涨期权：风险偏好（risk-on）时垂直融涨，VIX 飙升或里程碑滑期时暴跌。2025 年底/2026 年的 Neutron 火箭延期，恰恰触发了该板块易发的 35%+ 回撤（即便积压完好），如今处于避险阶段，背景是走强的美元（DXY +3.4%）。高扭矩、低趋势质量；据此控制仓位。

2021-02-19.title: SPAC-bubble unwind, speculation de-rates first (-44%)
2021-02-19.body: Space de-SPACs led the 2021-22 unwind well before the broad bear — the regime hadn't even turned risk-off yet (SPY still +9.6%, cyclicals +16.7%), but as liquidity tightened and the Fed pivoted hawkish, the most speculative, profitless corner of growth got hit first and hardest into the February-2022 low. High beta cuts both ways: it led down even while the index was up.
drivers: Speculation de-rates ahead of the regime (SPY still +9.6% as space crashed)
Fed-hiking pivot punishes profitless growth first
2021-02-19.title_zh: SPAC 泡沫破裂，投机最先去估值（-44%）
2021-02-19.body_zh: 太空 de-SPAC 早在大盘熊市之前就领跌 2021-22 年破裂——彼时 regime 甚至尚未转向避险（SPY 仍 +9.6%、周期股 +16.7%），但随流动性收紧、美联储转鹰，最具投机性、无盈利的成长角落最先、最重受挫至 2022 年 2 月低点。高贝塔双向切割：即便指数上涨它也领跌。
drivers_zh: 投机领先 regime 去估值（太空崩盘时 SPY 仍 +9.6%）
美联储加息转向最先惩罚无盈利成长

2022-02-23.title: Sharp dead-cat bounce off a stagflation tape (+28%)
2022-02-23.body: A high-beta oversold snap-back typical of this group's violent two-way moves, in a choppy stagflation-ish regime (VIX 31->19, dollar firming +2.9%) where the index barely moved (SPY +8.6%, breadth narrow). No fundamental turn — just speculative torque off a deep low.
drivers: High-beta oversold bounce in a flat, stagflation-ish tape (SPY +8.6%)
2022-02-23.title_zh: 急促死猫反弹于类滞胀行情（+28%）
2022-02-23.body_zh: 高贝塔超卖弹回，是该板块剧烈双向运动的典型，处于震荡的类滞胀 regime（VIX 31->19、美元转强 +2.9%），指数几乎不动（SPY +8.6%、广度狭窄）。无基本面转折——只是从深低点的投机扭矩。
drivers_zh: 高贝塔超卖反弹于平淡、类滞胀行情（SPY +8.6%）

2022-04-04.title: Hiking-bear, rate-driven flush (-33%)
2022-04-04.body: Resumed the broad 2022 decline as the Fed-hiking bear intensified into a rate-driven slowdown regime (yields surged, TLT -10.1%; DXY +4.9%; VIX 19->33) into the June low. Speculative space got no shelter — high beta meant it fell harder than the index (-33% vs SPY -14.0%, SPHB-SPLV -15.1%).
drivers: Rate-regime move: yields surged (TLT -10.1%) into a risk-off slowdown
2022-04-04.title_zh: 加息熊市、利率驱动冲刷（-33%）
2022-04-04.body_zh: 随美联储加息熊市加剧进入利率驱动的放缓 regime（收益率飙升，TLT -10.1%；DXY +4.9%；VIX 19->33），恢复 2022 年大盘下跌至 6 月低点。投机性太空毫无庇护——高贝塔意味着跌幅大于指数（-33% 对 SPY -14.0%、SPHB-SPLV -15.1%）。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime 移动：收益率飙升（TLT -10.1%）进入避险放缓
流动性撤出对投机打击最重

2022-05-11.title: Summer relief bounce, high-beta upside mirror (+42%)
2022-05-11.body: A big high-beta bounce off the spring low as the regime turned goldilocks/growth-up (growth>value +7.9, SMH +10.9%, VIX 33->20) on premature Fed-pause hopes — the upside mirror of this group's outsized drawdowns, with SPHB-SPLV +11.5% amplifying a modest +9.9% index move.
2022-05-11.title_zh: 夏季纾困反弹、高贝塔上行镜像（+42%）
2022-05-11.body_zh: 从春季低点的高贝塔大反弹，regime 转向 goldilocks/增长上行（成长>价值 +7.9、半导体 +10.9%、VIX 33->20），因过早的美联储暂停预期——是该板块超大回撤的上行镜像，SPHB-SPLV +11.5% 放大了温和的 +9.9% 指数涨幅。
drivers_zh: 成长引领风险偏好反弹（成长>价值 +7.9、VIX 33->20）
从超卖出发的高贝塔上行扭矩（SPHB-SPLV +11.5%）
过早的'美联储暂停'纾困反弹

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole rate-driven flush (-34%)
2022-08-16.body: Powell's hawkish reset sent speculative space into the December-2022 low in a rate-driven slowdown regime (yields surged, TLT -12.6%; SPHB-SPLV -11.8%). High-beta names lagged the broad late-2022 recovery as liquidity stayed tight — when the cost of carry is rising, the longest-duration speculation gets no bid.
drivers: Rate-regime move: yields surged (TLT -12.6%) on hawkish Jackson Hole
2022-08-16.title_zh: 杰克逊霍尔利率驱动冲刷（-34%）
2022-08-16.body_zh: 鲍威尔鹰派重置把投机性太空送入 2022 年 12 月低点，处于利率驱动的放缓 regime（收益率飙升，TLT -12.6%；SPHB-SPLV -11.8%）。流动性持续偏紧，高贝塔个股落后于 2022 年底大盘复苏——持有成本上升时，最长久期的投机得不到买盘。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime 移动：收益率飙升（TLT -12.6%），杰克逊霍尔鹰派
紧流动性对高贝塔投机的惩罚（SPHB-SPLV -11.8%）

2022-12-27.title: January high-beta squeeze on a risk-on flip (+83%)
2022-12-27.body: A ferocious early-2023 high-beta rally as the regime flipped reflation/growth-up risk-on (SPHB-SPLV +18.3%, SMH +17.2%, VIX flat 22) and the most-shorted, most-oversold speculation ripped on the 'soft landing' re-risk. Pure high-beta torque — the basket +83% against a +4.5% index — topped fast in February 2023.
drivers: Risk-on flip (SPHB-SPLV +18.3%, SMH +17.2%) ignites the squeeze
Speculative mean-reversion off deep lows (basket +83% vs SPY +4.5%)
2022-12-27.title_zh: 1 月高贝塔逼空于风险偏好翻转（+83%）
2022-12-27.body_zh: 2023 年初凶猛的高贝塔反弹，regime 翻转为再通胀/增长上行风险偏好（SPHB-SPLV +18.3%、半导体 +17.2%、VIX 持平 22），最被做空、最超卖的投机在'软着陆'再担风险中暴涨。纯高贝塔扭矩——篮子 +83% 对 +4.5% 指数——于 2023 年 2 月快速见顶。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好翻转（SPHB-SPLV +18.3%、半导体 +17.2%）点燃逼空
从深低点的投机均值回归（篮子 +83% 对 SPY +4.5%）

2023-02-22.title: Rate-scare grind lower under higher-for-longer (-44%)
2023-02-22.body: Space gave most of the squeeze back through 2023 as the SVB scare and then the autumn yield spike (TLT -14.9%) hammered speculation in a regime where breadth was punishingly narrow (RSP-SPY -12.4%) and high beta lagged badly (SPHB-SPLV -3.6% even as growth>value +18.3). A long, grinding -44% into the October-2023 low — the index actually rose (+4.2%) while space bled.
drivers: Rate-regime move: autumn 10Y spike toward 5% (TLT -14.9%) de-rates duration
Narrow breadth (RSP-SPY -12.4%) starves speculation while SPY +4.2%
2023-02-22.title_zh: 利率恐慌于更高更久缓步下行（-44%）
2023-02-22.body_zh: 随 SVB 恐慌、继而秋季收益率飙升（TLT -14.9%）重击投机，太空在 2023 年间回吐大部分逼空涨幅，处于市场广度极度狭窄（RSP-SPY -12.4%）、高贝塔严重落后（SPHB-SPLV -3.6%，即便成长>价值 +18.3）的 regime。一段漫长缓慢的 -44% 至 2023 年 10 月低点——指数实际上涨（+4.2%）而太空流血。
drivers_zh: 利率 regime 移动：秋季 10 年期逼近 5%（TLT -14.9%）使久期去估值
SVB 区域银行恐慌（2023 年 3 月）
市场广度狭窄（RSP-SPY -12.4%）饿死投机，而 SPY +4.2%
更高更久惩罚最长久期个股

2023-10-27.title: The space build-out bull on a goldilocks AI melt-up (+381%)
2023-10-27.body: The defining leg: +381% over 16 months as the regime turned goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation (SMH +82.4%, growth>value +23.1, VIX 21->16, yields falling TLT +11.3%) — falling yields and risk-on are rocket fuel for the longest-duration speculation. A genuine fundamental shift (launch cadence, direct-to-device satcom, Earth-obs, defense-space) turned the SPAC graveyard into a credible build-out, and high beta turned that into a 381% melt-up in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP-SPY -11.9%). RKLB-type names led into the February-2025 top.
drivers: Goldilocks AI melt-up (SMH +82.4%, falling yields TLT +11.3%, VIX 21->16) is rocket fuel
Real fundamentals: launch cadence, satcom, Earth-obs, defense-space
High-beta amplifies risk-on into a +381% run; narrow breadth (RSP-SPY -11.9%)
SPAC-era survivors mature into investable businesses
2023-10-27.title_zh: 太空建设牛市于 goldilocks AI 融涨（+381%）
2023-10-27.body_zh: 决定性的一段：16 个月内 +381%，regime 转向 goldilocks/增长上行去通胀（半导体 +82.4%、成长>价值 +23.1、VIX 21->16、收益率下行 TLT +11.3%）——收益率下行加风险偏好是最长久期投机的火箭燃料。一次真实基本面转变（发射节奏、直连设备卫星通信、对地观测、国防航天）把 SPAC 坟场变成可信建设浪潮，高贝塔把它变成狭窄大盘股行情（RSP-SPY -11.9%）中的 381% 融涨。RKLB 这类个股领涨至 2025 年 2 月高点。
drivers_zh: Goldilocks AI 融涨（半导体 +82.4%、收益率下行 TLT +11.3%、VIX 21->16）是火箭燃料
真实基本面：发射节奏、卫星通信、对地观测、国防航天
高贝塔放大风险偏好至 +381% 行情；市场广度狭窄（RSP-SPY -11.9%）
SPAC 时代幸存者成长为可投资企业

2025-02-10.title: DeepSeek & tariff de-risk, high-beta leads down (-40%)
2025-02-10.body: Speculative space led the early-2025 de-risk: the DeepSeek AI scare then the April-8 tariff crash flipped the regime violently risk-off (VIX 16->52, SMH -27.9%, SPHB-SPLV -21.9%). The highest-beta theme on the board flushed hardest into the April low while defensives held (-6.5% vs cyclicals -17.7%).
drivers: Violent risk-off regime (VIX 16->52, high-beta SPHB-SPLV -21.9%) leads space down
Defensives led (-6.5% vs -17.7%) as high beta flushed
2025-02-10.title_zh: DeepSeek 与关税去风险、高贝塔领跌（-40%）
2025-02-10.body_zh: 投机性太空领跌 2025 年初去风险：DeepSeek AI 恐慌继而 4 月 8 日关税崩盘把 regime 剧烈翻转为避险（VIX 16->52、半导体 -27.9%、SPHB-SPLV -21.9%）。面板上扭矩最高的主题在 4 月低点冲刷最重，防御守住（-6.5% 对周期 -17.7%）。
drivers_zh: 剧烈避险 regime（VIX 16->52、高贝塔 SPHB-SPLV -21.9%）领跌太空
DeepSeek AI 恐慌（2025 年 1 月）冲击投机
2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘
防御领先（-6.5% 对 -17.7%），高贝塔冲刷

2025-04-08.title: Tariff-low moonshot on a high-beta risk-on rip (+154%)
2025-04-08.body: Classic high-beta torque off the April-8 low: +154% into an October-2025 high as the regime snapped to risk-on (VIX 52->21, SPHB-SPLV +59.4%, growth>value +22.7, weaker dollar -4.1%) and the build-out narrative re-engaged. Speculative space does this — vertical rallies that amplify a +34.7% index into a triple-digit basket move and demand respect for both directions.
drivers: High-beta risk-on rip (VIX 52->21, SPHB-SPLV +59.4%, growth>value +22.7) amplifies the snap-back
Snap-back off the April-2025 crash low
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税低点登月于高贝塔风险偏好暴涨（+154%）

2025-10-15.title: Autumn high-beta flush front-runs a risk wobble (-39%)
2025-10-15.body: A sharp high-beta correction off the October high — the regime only wobbled mildly (VIX 21->26, SPY -1.9%), but speculative space front-ran it with its usual outsized drawdown (-39% on a -1.9% index, SPHB-SPLV -5.3%). drivers: High beta front-runs a mild risk wobble (-39% vs SPY -1.9%, VIX 21->26)

Pure speculative torque off an oversold low, the basket +120% against a +6.9% index.
drivers: Reflation risk-on flip (VIX 26->16, SPHB-SPLV +16.0%) fuels the rip
High-beta torque off oversold (basket +120% vs SPY +6.9%)

drivers_zh: 再通胀风险偏好翻转（VIX 26->16、SPHB-SPLV +16.0%）助燃暴涨
年末/新年风险偏好重燃

2026-01-28.title: Quick correction as defensives bid (-26%)
2026-01-28.body: A fast pullback off the January high as the regime tilted mildly risk-off/stagflation-ish (VIX 16->21, defensives +4.6% vs cyclicals +0.8%, growth-value -6.5%). 2026-02-12.title: Spring melt-up on a tech-led risk-on regime (+115%)

2026-05-28.title: Neutron-delay drawdown into a risk-off, strong-dollar tape (-42%)
2026-05-28.body: The current selloff. RKLB-style names dumped as Neutron-rocket qualification setbacks and a delayed maiden flight (slipping toward mid-2026) collided with profit-taking off a parabolic high — exactly the 35%+ drawdown this group is structurally prone to. The regime turned risk-off/stagflation-ish (VIX 16->19, oil -19.1%, growth-value -10.0%, dollar firming +2.4%, defensives bid), and high beta meant the basket fell -42% against a -2.4% index. Backlogs stayed intact ($1B+), but space trades on milestones and torque, not backlog. Now 'Rolling over' (RS #26) — a high-volatility theme back in its risk-off phase.
drivers: Risk-off/stagflation tilt (VIX 16->19, growth-value -10.0%, dollar +2.4%) caps the high-beta theme

industrial_distribution.now: Industrial Distribution & Capital Goods (Grainger/Fastenal-type MRO distributors, equipment rental, short-cycle tooling; XLI proxy) is the late-cycle workhorse — the boring-but-effective, lower-beta end of industrials. It's 'Trending' at RS-rank #15 (pos 67.2), up +58% off the April-2025 tariff-crash low, and the current regime suits it: a broadening reflation/growth-up tape (cyclicals +11.2% vs defensives +6.9%, equal-weight beating cap-weight +2.9%, oil +19.2%) rewards capex-cyclicals over pure AI beta. The thesis is restock + nonresidential construction + pricing power — distributors sell the picks-and-shovels (fasteners, tools, MRO) to everyone building factories and grids. Quality, steady, lower-beta compounders rather than a torque trade — precisely why they hold up better than the speculative themes when the tape gets choppy, and why a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%) only mildly dents the multinationals here.
industrial_distribution.now_zh: 工业分销与资本货物（Grainger/Fastenal 这类 MRO 分销商、设备租赁、短周期工具；XLI 为代理）是后周期主力——工业群组中乏味却有效、低贝塔的一端。它'趋势中'，相对强度排名第 15 位（pos 67.2），自 2025 年 4 月关税崩盘低点 +58%，当前 regime 也对它有利：一个广度扩张的再通胀/增长上行行情（周期股 +11.2% 对防御 +6.9%、等权跑赢市值权重 +2.9%、油价 +19.2%）奖励资本开支周期股而非纯 AI 高贝塔。其逻辑是补库+非住宅建设+定价权——分销商向所有建工厂、建电网的人出售'镐与铲'（紧固件、工具、MRO）。它们是优质、稳健、低贝塔的复利机器，而非扭矩交易——这恰是它们在行情震荡时比投机主题更抗跌的原因，也是走强美元（DXY +3.4%）在此仅轻微影响跨国企业的原因。

A multiple compression, not an earnings break: short-cycle demand stayed firm under the price weakness, but the surging dollar and yields hit the rate-sensitive cyclical (cyclicals -14.6% vs defensives -5.3%).
drivers: Rate-regime + dollar shock (TLT -22.0%, DXY +9.2%) compress cyclical multiples
Stagflation-ish risk-off (VIX 16->31) as recession fears mount

As a lower-beta name it didn't lead the narrow mega-cap tape (RSP-SPY -18.3%), but the weaker dollar was a clean tailwind — the late-cycle compounder thesis working cleanly.
