critical_minerals.now: Critical Minerals & Rare Earths (MP Materials/lithium/allied ex-China supply; REMX proxy) is the most policy-driven, most violent basket here — and right now the most beaten-down, tagged 'Bottoming' at pos 1.6 (range floor), RS-rank #27. It's idiosyncratic: a supply-policy story, not a demand story, so it marches to China export-control headlines more than to the macro regime. But it is still high-beta, and the current backdrop is no help — a broadening reflation tape that nonetheless carries a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%, a headwind for materials). China controls rare-earth processing and weaponizes it (the strict April-2025 regime, then a June-2026 escalation sanctioning MP/USA Rare Earth and barring 46 US firms incl. LMT/RTX/Boeing/GD). The US response is state-backed: a ~15% Pentagon stake in MP, a $110/kg NdPr floor, a 10-year magnet offtake, a $725M metallization loan. The result is a complex that gapped +715% (2024-25), then whipsawed 30-43% as the trade war escalated and de-escalated. Whippy, headline-hostage, asymmetric — a strategic theme trading like an option on geopolitics.
critical_minerals.now_zh: 关键矿产与稀土（MP Materials/锂/盟友去中国化供应；REMX 为代理）是此处最受政策驱动、最剧烈的篮子——眼下也最被打压，标记为'筑底'，pos 1.6（区间底部），相对强度排名第 27 位。它特立独行：是供应政策故事而非需求故事，故更随中国出口管制头条而非宏观 regime 起舞。但它仍是高贝塔，当前背景也无助——一个广度扩张的再通胀行情却携带走强的美元（DXY +3.4%，对材料是逆风）。中国掌控稀土加工并以之为武器（2025 年 4 月严格体制，继而 2026 年 6 月升级，制裁 MP/USA Rare Earth 并排除 46 家美国企业含 LMT/RTX/波音/GD）。美国回应是国家背书：五角大楼约 15% MP 股权、110 美元/公斤镨钕下限、10 年磁体包销、7.25 亿美元金属化贷款。结果是一个群组跳涨 +715%（2024-25），随后在贸易战升级与缓和中以 30-43% 来回鞭打。鞭打剧烈、被头条挟持、不对称——一个交易起来像地缘政治期权的战略主题。

2021-11-12.title: Hiking-bear, high-beta commodity de-rate (-28%)
2021-11-12.body: Rare-earth and lithium names de-rated through early 2022 in a stagflation-ish, risk-off regime (VIX 16->30, defensives +0.3% vs cyclicals -4.5%) as the Fed-hiking bear and China lockdowns hit commodity-linked equities. Speculative, high-beta materials sold off ahead of the broad market — the basket fell -28% while SPY was only -7.4%.
drivers: Stagflation-ish risk-off (VIX 16->30) hits high-beta commodity equities
2021-11-12.title_zh: 加息熊市、高贝塔大宗去估值（-28%）
2021-11-12.body_zh: 稀土和锂个股在 2022 年初于类滞胀、避险 regime（VIX 16->30、防御 +0.3% 对周期 -4.5%）去估值，美联储加息熊市和中国封控冲击大宗相关股票。投机性、高贝塔材料领先大盘抛售——篮子跌 -28%，而 SPY 仅 -7.4%。
drivers_zh: 类滞胀避险（VIX 16->30）冲击高贝塔大宗股票
美联储加息熊市；篮子 -28% 对 SPY -7.4%
中国封控抑制材料需求

2022-01-27.title: Commodity-supercycle bounce against a yield surge (+46%)
2022-01-27.body: Rallied with the 2022 commodity/inflation spike even as the rate regime savaged the index — yields surged (TLT -22.3%, SPY -1.8%) and the dollar firmed (DXY +4.6%), but the Russia-Ukraine supply shock lifted the whole materials complex into early 2023. A commodity-driven move decoupled from the equity tape: breadth was broad (RSP-SPY +6.5%) and lithium prices ran hot.
drivers: Commodity-supercycle bid decoupled from the rate regime (TLT -22.3%, SPY -1.8%)
Lithium price spike on EV demand
Broad breadth (RSP-SPY +6.5%) despite a firming dollar (DXY +4.6%)
2022-01-27.title_zh: 大宗超级周期反弹，逆收益率飙升（+46%）
2022-01-27.body_zh: 随 2022 年大宗/通胀飙升上涨，即便利率 regime 重创指数——收益率飙升（TLT -22.3%、SPY -1.8%）、美元转强（DXY +4.6%），但俄乌供应冲击抬升整个材料群组至 2023 年初。一次与股市行情脱钩的大宗驱动行情：市场广度宽（RSP-SPY +6.5%），锂价火热。
drivers_zh: 大宗超级周期买盘与利率 regime 脱钩（TLT -22.3%、SPY -1.8%）
俄乌供应冲击对材料的买盘
EV 需求推动锂价飙升
市场广度宽（RSP-SPY +6.5%），尽管美元转强（DXY +4.6%）

2023-02-02.title: Lithium/rare-earth price collapse while the index melted up (-39%)
2023-02-02.body: A long, brutal bear as the 2022 commodity spike fully unwound — lithium prices crashed on oversupply and slowing EV growth, dragging the basket -39% for a full year into the February-2024 low. The regime was the opposite of helpful for this group: a goldilocks AI melt-up (SMH +56.9%, growth>value +27.8, narrow RSP-SPY -16.1%) where SPY rose +21% while commodities and these names bled — capital was chasing semis, not rare earths.
drivers: Commodity bust vs a goldilocks AI melt-up (SPY +21% while basket -39%)
2023-02-02.title_zh: 锂/稀土价格崩盘，而指数融涨（-39%）
2023-02-02.body_zh: 一段漫长残酷的熊市，2022 年大宗飙升彻底回吐——锂价因供过于求和 EV 增长放缓崩盘，把篮子拖累 -39% 整整一年至 2024 年 2 月低点。regime 对该板块恰恰相反地不利：一个 goldilocks AI 融涨（半导体 +56.9%、成长>价值 +27.8、狭窄 RSP-SPY -16.1%），SPY 涨 +21% 而大宗与这些个股流血——资金追逐半导体而非稀土。
drivers_zh: 大宗崩盘对 goldilocks AI 融涨（SPY +21% 而篮子 -39%）
锂供过于求与价格崩盘
狭窄科技引领市场广度（RSP-SPY -16.1%）饿死材料

2024-02-20.title: The policy-driven moonshot, regime-agnostic (+715%)
2024-02-20.body: The defining leg — a staggering +715% over 20 months that ran almost entirely on policy, not the macro tape. As China tightened rare-earth export controls and the US/allied response crystallized (the 2025 Pentagon stake in MP, the $110/kg NdPr floor, magnet offtake), the ex-China supply chain re-rated from value trap to strategic must-own. The backdrop was a benign goldilocks regime (SMH +69.4%, VIX 15->21, weaker dollar -4.8%) that didn't hurt, but this was a national-security re-rating: government backing turned a commodity story into a must-own, and the stocks gapped into an October-2025 top.
drivers: Policy re-rating dominates the regime (+715% as SPY +36%, weaker dollar -4.8%)
China tightens rare-earth export controls (the strict 2025 regime)
US/allied ex-China supply policy (Pentagon stake in MP, $110/kg NdPr floor, 10-yr offtake)
Rare earths re-rated as a national-security imperative
2024-02-20.title_zh: 政策驱动的登月，与 regime 无关（+715%）
2024-02-20.body_zh: 决定性的一段——20 个月内惊人的 +715%，几乎全凭政策而非宏观行情。随中国收紧稀土出口管制、美国/盟友回应成型（2025 年五角大楼入股 MP、110 美元/公斤镨钕下限、磁体包销），去中国化供应链从价值陷阱重估为战略必持。背景是良性的 goldilocks regime（半导体 +69.4%、VIX 15->21、美元走弱 -4.8%），无害但非主因：这是国家安全重估，政府背书把大宗故事变成必持，股票跳涨至 2025 年 10 月高点。
drivers_zh: 政策重估主导 regime（+715% 而 SPY +36%、美元走弱 -4.8%）
中国收紧稀土出口管制（严格的 2025 年体制）
美国/盟友去中国化供应政策（五角大楼入股 MP、110 美元/公斤镨钕下限、10 年包销）
稀土被重估为国家安全要务

2025-10-14.title: Parabolic-top flush on a mild risk wobble (-43%)
2025-10-14.body: A sharp -43% reset off the October-2025 high — a parabolic +715% run does not unwind gently. The regime barely moved (SPY +1.2%, VIX 21->20, breadth flat), but high beta plus extreme extension meant the most-stretched theme on the board flushed -43% on a basically flat tape, on profit-taking alone.
drivers: High beta + extreme extension flush on a flat tape (-43% vs SPY +1.2%)
2025-10-14.title_zh: 抛物线顶部冲刷于轻微风险动摇（-43%）
2025-10-14.body_zh: 从 2025 年 10 月高点的急剧 -43% 重置——抛物线 +715% 行情不会温和回吐。regime 几乎不动（SPY +1.2%、VIX 21->20、广度持平），但高贝塔加极度延伸意味着面板上最拉伸的主题在基本持平的行情中仅凭获利了结就冲刷 -43%。
drivers_zh: 高贝塔+极度延伸于平淡行情冲刷（-43% 对 SPY +1.2%）
抛物线 +715% 行情后的获利了结
过度延伸主题最先去风险

2025-11-06.title: Policy-escalation rip on a broadening tape (+80%)
2025-11-06.body: Snapped back +80% into late January 2026 as trade-war escalation re-ignited the supply-security bid — paradoxically, every fresh export-control headline is bullish for the ex-China names that benefit from scarcity. The regime helped at the margin (broadening RSP-SPY +4.2%, VIX 20->16, weaker dollar -2.1%, materials-led leadership), but the driver was policy: the basket +80% against a +3.1% index.
drivers: Policy escalation drives the rip (basket +80% vs SPY +3.1%)
Trade-war / export-control re-escalation re-ignites the supply-security bid
Broadening tape (RSP-SPY +4.2%, weaker dollar -2.1%) a tailwind
2025-11-06.title_zh: 政策升级暴涨于广度扩张行情（+80%）
2025-11-06.body_zh: 弹回 +80% 至 2026 年 1 月底，因贸易战升级重新点燃供应安全买盘——悖论地，每条新出口管制头条对受益于稀缺的去中国化个股是利好。regime 边际有利（广度扩张 RSP-SPY +4.2%、VIX 20->16、美元走弱 -2.1%、材料引领），但驱动是政策：篮子 +80% 对 +3.1% 指数。
drivers_zh: 政策升级驱动暴涨（篮子 +80% 对 SPY +3.1%）
贸易战/出口管制再升级重新点燃供应安全买盘
广度扩张行情（RSP-SPY +4.2%、美元走弱 -2.1%）顺风
材料引领；稀缺溢价重新定价

2026-01-23.title: De-escalation pullback into a stagflation, strong-dollar tape (-30%)
2026-01-23.body: Gave back -30% into late March as the trade war cooled (a partial export-control suspension was negotiated, to Nov-10-2026). Easing tensions remove the scarcity premium — the inverse of the escalation rip — and the regime turned against it: a stagflation-ish risk-off (VIX 16->31, oil +68.5% on the Hormuz shock) with a firming dollar (DXY +3.0%, a direct materials headwind). The basket -30% on a -8.1% index.
drivers: Stagflation-ish risk-off + strong dollar (VIX 16->31, DXY +3.0%) compound the de-rate
2026-01-23.title_zh: 降级回落进入类滞胀、强美元行情（-30%）
2026-01-23.body_zh: 随贸易战降温（谈成部分出口管制暂停，至 2026 年 11 月 10 日），回吐 -30% 至 3 月底。紧张缓和移除稀缺溢价——升级暴涨的反面——而 regime 转为不利：一个类滞胀避险（VIX 16->31、油价 +68.5% 因霍尔木兹冲击）伴随美元转强（DXY +3.0%，对材料的直接逆风）。篮子 -30% 对 -8.1% 指数。
drivers_zh: 类滞胀避险+强美元（VIX 16->31、DXY +3.0%）加重去估值
谈成部分出口管制暂停（至 2026 年 11 月）

2026-03-30.title: Re-escalation bounce on a high-beta risk-on flip (+61%)
2026-03-30.body: Another +61% whip higher into early May as supply-security headlines flared again, amplified by a regime flip to tech/semis-led risk-on (SMH +51.6%, growth>value +7.2, VIX 31->17, weaker dollar -2.5%). The pattern is unmistakable: this basket is an option on US-China trade tension, ripping on escalation and fading on detente — and high beta turns a +16% index into a +61% basket move.
drivers: High-beta risk-on flip (SMH +51.6%, VIX 31->17) amplifies the bounce (+61% vs SPY +16%)
2026-03-30.title_zh: 再升级反弹于高贝塔风险偏好翻转（+61%）
2026-03-30.body_zh: 随供应安全头条再度爆发，又一次 +61% 鞭打走高至 5 月初，被 regime 翻转为科技/半导体引领风险偏好（半导体 +51.6%、成长>价值 +7.2、VIX 31->17、美元走弱 -2.5%）放大。模式明白无误：该篮子是中美贸易紧张的期权，升级则暴涨、缓和则消退——高贝塔把 +16% 指数变成 +61% 篮子涨幅。
drivers_zh: 高贝塔风险偏好翻转（半导体 +51.6%、VIX 31->17）放大反弹（+61% 对 SPY +16%）
供应安全/贸易紧张头条重燃
稀缺溢价重新定价；美元走弱（DXY -2.5%）顺风
对中美紧张的期权式敏感性

2026-05-06.title: Current de-risk to the lows, policy-supported washout (-32%)
2026-05-06.body: The current selloff — down -32% to pos 1.6 (range floor), tagged 'Bottoming'. The June-2026 escalation (China sanctioning MP/USA Rare Earth and barring 46 US firms) is a double-edged headline: bullish for the long-run scarcity thesis, but it landed in a stagflation-ish, strong-dollar tape (VIX 17->18, DXY +3.4%, oil -27.2%, defensives bid) that drained the high-beta materials complex. With the Pentagon backstop ($110/kg floor, $725M metallization loan) under the leaders, this reads as a policy-supported washout in an unhelpful regime rather than a structural break.
drivers: Stagflation-ish, strong-dollar tape (DXY +3.4%, defensives bid) flushes high-beta materials
June-2026 China sanctions on MP/USA Rare Earth + 46 US-firm procurement ban
Pentagon backstop ($110/kg floor, $725M metallization loan) under the leaders
Bottoming at the range floor (pos 1.6) on a policy-supported washout
2026-05-06.title_zh: 当前去风险至低位，政策支持的洗盘（-32%）
2026-05-06.body_zh: 当前的抛售——下跌 -32% 至 pos 1.6（区间底部），标记为'筑底'。2026 年 6 月升级（中国制裁 MP/USA Rare Earth 并排除 46 家美国企业）是双刃头条：对长期稀缺逻辑利好，但它落在类滞胀、强美元行情（VIX 17->18、DXY +3.4%、油价 -27.2%、防御获买盘）中，抽干了高贝塔材料群组。在五角大楼后盾（110 美元/公斤下限、7.25 亿美元金属化贷款）支撑龙头之下，这读作不利 regime 中政策支持的洗盘，而非结构性断裂。
drivers_zh: 类滞胀、强美元行情（DXY +3.4%、防御获买盘）冲刷高贝塔材料
2026 年 6 月中国制裁 MP/USA Rare Earth+46 家美国企业采购禁令
五角大楼后盾（110 美元/公斤下限、7.25 亿美元金属化贷款）支撑龙头
在区间底部（pos 1.6）于政策支持的洗盘中筑底

insurance.now: Insurance & brokers (KIE) keep grinding higher in a low-drama uptrend — the quietest compounder in Financials and a low-beta anchor in a reflation/growth-up tape where Tech leads (+24.3%) and Financials lag (−2.7%). The whole story since mid-2022 is one long rally: a hard property/casualty pricing cycle (rate-on-line still firm), and a rate tailwind that turned every dollar of insurance float into real investment income once the Fed left policy restrictive. Brokers (Marsh, Aon, Gallagher) compound fees regardless of the rate path; P&C names (Progressive, Chubb, Travelers) earn the underwriting margin. With the dollar firm (+3.4% DXY), breadth broadening (RSP beat SPY +2.9%) and VIX a calm 14→18, this is a hold-and-collect, not a chase. The 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock and a Fed back in hiking bias are mild positives here (more investment income, no credit blow-up), which is exactly why this low-beta group is where you hide when the high-beta AI trade wobbles.
insurance.now_zh: 保险与经纪（KIE）在低波动上行趋势中继续稳步走高——金融板块中最安静的复利机器，也是再通胀/增长向上行情里的低贝塔锚（科技领涨+24.3%、金融落后−2.7%）。自2022年中以来就是一段长牛：财产险（P&C）定价处于硬周期（rate-on-line 仍坚挺），加上利率顺风——美联储维持限制性政策后，每一美元保险浮存金都转化为真实的投资收益。经纪商（Marsh、Aon、Gallagher）无论利率如何都靠手续费复利增长；P&C 巨头（Progressive、Chubb、Travelers）赚承保利润。美元坚挺（+3.4% DXY）、市场广度转宽（RSP 跑赢 SPY +2.9%）、VIX 平稳于14→18，本组属于持有收息、而非追涨的标的。2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击叠加美联储重回加息倾向，对这一低贝塔组温和利好（投资收益更多、无信用爆雷），这正是高贝塔 AI 交易动摇时资金避险的去处。

2022-04-20.title: 2022 rate-shock dip (−16% in a −18% tape)
2022-04-20.body: Insurance sold off with the broad 2022 Fed-hiking bear (SPY −18%, VIX 20→33), but as a low-beta defensive it fell far more shallowly than tech — a −16% drawdown versus 30%+ in growth, in a rate-regime move where the 10Y surged (TLT −7.8%). Higher discount rates hit every equity, yet for insurers the same rising rates were a long-term gift: bond reinvestment yields were climbing, and a hard P&C pricing cycle was already underway after years of catastrophe losses. This was a macro/rates drawdown, not a business-model crack.
2022-04-20.body_zh: 保险随2022年美联储加息熊市回调（SPY −18%、VIX 20→33），但作为低贝塔防御品，跌幅远浅于科技——回撤仅约−16%，而成长股跌逾30%；这是一次利率主导的下跌，10Y 飙升（TLT −7.8%）。更高的贴现率压制所有股票，但对保险公司而言，同样的利率上行是长期礼物：债券再投资收益率正在攀升，且在多年巨灾损失之后，P&C 硬定价周期已经启动。这是宏观/利率回撤，而非商业模式破裂。
drivers: Rate-regime move: 10Y surged (TLT −7.8%) compressed all equity multiples
Low-beta defensive: −16% vs 30%+ in growth in a −18% tape
Hard P&C pricing cycle already lifting rate-on-line
Rising reinvestment yields = future float income
drivers_zh: 利率主导下跌：10Y 飙升（TLT −7.8%）压缩全市场估值
低贝塔防御：大盘−18%中跌−16%，远浅于成长股逾30%
P&C 硬定价周期已在抬升 rate-on-line
再投资收益率上升＝未来浮存金收益

2022-06-16.title: The quiet +96% compounder rode the goldilocks tape (Jun '22 → Apr '25)
2022-06-16.title_zh: 安静的+96%复利行情乘 goldilocks 顺风（2022年6月→2025年4月）
2022-06-16.body: From the June 2022 low, insurance rallied ~96% in an almost straight line through a goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation regime — SPY +61%, VIX 33→22, semis +114.5% — yet as a low-beta name it didn't need the melt-up: it ignored every macro storm (SVB Mar '23, the 2024 Fed cuts and election, the April 2025 tariff crash). The engine is structural — a multi-year hard pricing cycle (insurers raising premiums faster than claims inflation) layered on a rate tailwind (the 10Y stayed elevated, TLT −9.5% over the leg) that made insurance float genuinely profitable for the first time in a decade. Brokers compounded fees; P&C names compounded underwriting margin. In a narrow, mega-cap-led tape (RSP lagged SPY −20.1%), this was the textbook steady compounder — the place capital rotates to when the speculative trade gets scary. The leg's end near April 2025 marks where the basket cooled off its peak, not where the thesis broke.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 自2022年6月低点起，保险在 goldilocks/增长向上去通胀的环境中近乎直线上涨约96%——SPY +61%、VIX 33→22、半导体 +114.5%——但作为低贝塔标的，它并不依赖这场融涨：它无视一切宏观风暴（2023年3月 SVB、2024年美联储降息与大选、2025年4月关税崩盘）。引擎是结构性的——多年期硬定价周期（保险公司提价快于理赔通胀）叠加利率顺风（10Y 维持高位，整段 TLT −9.5%），使保险浮存金十年来首次真正盈利。经纪商靠手续费复利，P&C 巨头靠承保利润复利。在狭窄、由大型股主导的行情中（RSP 落后 SPY −20.1%），这是教科书式的稳健复利——正是投机交易令人恐惧时资金轮动的去处。该行情在2025年4月附近见顶，标志篮子从高点回落，而非论点破裂。
drivers: Goldilocks/growth-up regime (SPY +61%, VIX 33→22) — but low-beta KIE didn't need the melt-up
Multi-year hard P&C pricing cycle (premiums > claims inflation)
Rate tailwind (TLT −9.5%) turned float into real investment income
Narrow mega-cap tape (RSP −20.1% vs SPY); shrugged off SVB + tariff crash
drivers_zh: Goldilocks/增长向上环境（SPY +61%、VIX 33→22）——但低贝塔 KIE 不依赖融涨
多年期 P&C 硬定价周期（保费涨幅＞理赔通胀）
利率顺风（TLT −9.5%）使浮存金转为真实投资收益
狭窄大型股行情（RSP 落后 SPY −20.1%）；无视 SVB 与关税崩盘

payments_fintech.now: Payments & fintech (proxied by XLF) is at Prime entry — pos 15.1, washed out near the bottom of its range after a sharp ~29% drawdown from the August 2025 peak into early 2026. This is the rate-sensitive, consumer-spend-levered corner of Financials, and it splits into two betas: the networks (Visa, Mastercard) are toll-roads on transaction volume, while the disruptors (PayPal, Block/Square) trade like long-duration high-beta growth and get whipsawed by every move in rates and recession odds. The current tape is reflation/growth-up (Tech leads +24.3%), but Financials lag (−2.7%) and growth>value has reversed hard (growth−value −15.2%) with the dollar firm (+3.4% DXY) — a mixed setup. The 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock (CPI 4.2%) and a Fed back in hiking bias are the proximate weight: higher rates compress fintech multiples and a squeezed consumer threatens spend volume. But the low absolute position and the strong V/MA secular volume story are why this scores as a setup, not a sell — the cash-flow networks anchor the basket; the speculative fintech tail is the high-beta risk.
payments_fintech.now_zh: 支付与金融科技（以 XLF 代理）处于黄金入场——pos 15.1，自2025年8月高点经历约−29%的急跌至2026年初后，已在区间底部附近被洗盘。这是金融板块中对利率敏感、与消费支出高度挂钩的角落，且分为两种贝塔：支付网络（Visa、Mastercard）是交易量上的收费公路，而颠覆者（PayPal、Block/Square）则像长久期高贝塔成长股，随利率与衰退概率的每次波动剧烈摇摆。当前行情为再通胀/增长向上（科技领涨+24.3%），但金融板块落后（−2.7%）、成长跑赢价值大幅反转（成长−价值 −15.2%）、美元坚挺（+3.4% DXY）——格局喜忧参半。2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击（CPI 4.2%）叠加美联储重回加息倾向，是当前压力的近因：高利率压缩金融科技估值，受挤压的消费者威胁支付量。但绝对位置偏低、加上 V/MA 强劲的长期交易量故事，正是本组被评为入场而非卖出的原因——现金流网络巨头锚定篮子；投机性金融科技尾部才是高贝塔风险所在。

2021-09-23.title: 2021-22 duration purge — rate/dollar shock ground zero (−45%)
2021-09-23.title_zh: 2021–22久期出清——利率/美元冲击震中（−45%）
2021-09-23.body: Fintech was ground zero for the 2022 Fed-hiking bear. As the most rate-sensitive, longest-duration, highest-beta corner of Financials, the basket fell ~45% while the broad market barely cracked (SPY −5.6%) — an outsized break driven by the rate/dollar shock (10Y surged, TLT −10.5%; DXY +6.4%) that obliterated growth-at-any-price names (PayPal off its pandemic highs, Block, Affirm) as discount rates rose and the work-from-home spend bubble deflated. Even the durable networks (V/MA) de-rated. This leg is the classic warning that fintech bundles two very different betas: toll-road networks and speculative long-duration growth.
2021-09-23.body_zh: 金融科技是2022年美联储加息熊市的震中。作为金融板块中对利率最敏感、久期最长、贝塔最高的角落，篮子下跌约45%，而大盘几乎没破裂（SPY −5.6%）——这是由利率/美元冲击驱动的超额破裂（10Y 飙升 TLT −10.5%、DXY +6.4%），随贴现率上升、居家办公支付泡沫消退，不计价格的成长群（PayPal 从疫情高点滑落、Block、Affirm）被摧毁。即便耐用的网络巨头（V/MA）也估值下修。这段行情是经典警示：金融科技捆绑了两类截然不同的贝塔——收费公路网络与投机性长久期成长。
drivers: Rate/dollar shock (TLT −10.5%, DXY +6.4%) → highest-duration multiple compression
Pandemic-stimulus spend bubble deflated; PYPL/SQ/AFRM crushed worst
drivers_zh: 利率/美元冲击（TLT −10.5%、DXY +6.4%）→最长久期估值压缩
超额破裂：−45% 而 SPY 仅−5.6%
疫情刺激支付泡沫消退；PYPL/SQ/AFRM 跌幅最深
即便耐用网络（V/MA）也估值下修

2022-03-14.title: Oversold relief bounce on a tech-led rip (+27%)
2022-03-14.title_zh: 超卖喘息反弹乘科技领涨急升（+27%）
2022-03-14.body: A sharp two-week snapback from the March 2022 low as the market priced the first Fed hike as 'known' and a tech/semis-led risk-on rip (SPY +11.0%, semis +18.8%, growth−value +8.7, VIX 32→19) lifted bombed-out long-duration growth. The high-beta fintech disruptors led the reflex bounce — but it was a counter-trend move inside the larger 2022 bear, in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP lagged SPY −2.4%), not a turn.
2022-03-14.body_zh: 自2022年3月低点起为期两周的急速回升，市场把首次美联储加息视为已知，科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好急升（SPY +11.0%、半导体 +18.8%、成长−价值 +8.7、VIX 32→19）提振了被打入谷底的长久期成长。高 beta 金融科技颠覆者领涨反射性反弹——但这是更大2022年熊市中的逆势波动，处于狭窄的大型股行情（RSP 落后 SPY −2.4%），而非转折。
drivers: First Fed hike priced as 'known' → reflex bounce in long-duration growth
High-beta fintech disruptors led; narrow tape (RSP −2.4%)
drivers_zh: 科技/半导体领涨风险偏好急升（半导体 +18.8%、成长−价值 +8.7、VIX 32→19）
首次美联储加息被视为已知→长久期成长反射性反弹
高 beta 金融科技颠覆者领涨；狭窄行情（RSP −2.4%）

2022-03-29.title: Hawkish-repricing leg down — rate shock + slowdown scare (−32%)
2022-03-29.title_zh: 鹰派重定价下行段——利率冲击＋放缓恐慌（−32%）
2022-03-29.body: The relief bounce reversed hard into May 2022 as the Fed signaled a faster, larger hiking path: the 10Y surged again (TLT −9.5%), the dollar ripped (DXY +5.5%), VIX 19→33, and the regime tipped to a slowdown/deflation-scare with high-beta crushed (high-beta minus low-vol −16.7%) and the whole market dropping (SPY −14.9%). Rate-sensitive fintech was hit worst — every upward revision in the terminal-rate path re-compressed the long-duration multiples. The networks held up far better than the speculative high-beta tail.
2022-03-29.body_zh: 随美联储释放更快、更大的加息路径信号，喘息反弹急转直下至2022年5月：10Y 再度飙升（TLT −9.5%）、美元大涨（DXY +5.5%）、VIX 19→33，环境转向放缓/通缩恐慌，高贝塔被碾压（高贝塔减低波 −16.7%），全市场下跌（SPY −14.9%）。对利率敏感的金融科技受创最重——终端利率路径的每次上修都再次压缩长久期估值。网络巨头远比投机性高贝塔尾部抗跌。
drivers: Rate shock (TLT −9.5%, DXY +5.5%) re-compressed long-duration multiples
Fed signaled faster/larger hiking path; recession fear built
Networks held up better than the speculative high-beta tail
drivers_zh: 利率冲击（TLT −9.5%、DXY +5.5%）再压缩长久期估值
放缓/通缩恐慌环境；高贝塔被碾压（高贝塔−低波 −16.7%）
美联储释放更快/更大加息路径信号；衰退担忧累积

2022-05-11.title: Short-squeeze bounce in a hated group (+24%)
2022-05-11.title_zh: 被嫌弃组别的空头回补反弹（+24%）
2022-05-11.body: A brief two-week bounce off the May 2022 low — an oversold, short-covering rally in a deeply hated group as the dollar softened (DXY −2.1%) and VIX eased 33→26. No fundamental catalyst; with the broad market only modestly up (SPY +5.7%) and risk appetite still fragile, the high-beta fintech tail caught a reflex bid that fizzled within weeks as the market resumed its slide toward the mid-2022 low.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 自2022年5月低点起为期两周的短暂反弹——深度被嫌弃组别中的超卖、空头回补行情，美元走软（DXY −2.1%）、VIX 回落33→26。无基本面催化剂；大盘仅温和上涨（SPY +5.7%）、风险偏好仍脆弱之际，高贝塔金融科技尾部抓住反射性买盘，数周内即熄火，随后大盘恢复向2022年中低点的下滑。
drivers: Oversold, short-covering rally in a deeply hated high-beta group
No fundamental catalyst; broad tape only +5.7%
drivers_zh: 深度被嫌弃高贝塔组别的超卖、空头回补行情
无基本面催化剂；大盘仅+5.7%

2022-05-27.title: Final 2022-bear leg down — rate shock + slowdown (−21%)
2022-05-27.title_zh: 2022年熊市最后下行段——利率冲击＋放缓（−21%）
2022-05-27.body: The last leg of the first-half 2022 selloff into the mid-June low, as a hot CPI print forced the Fed into a 75bp hike and recession pricing peaked. The regime was slowdown/deflation-scare (SPY −11.7%, VIX 26→33, cyclicals −12.5% vs defensives −10.5%) with another rate jolt (TLT −6.0%); rate-sensitive fintech bottomed here with the broad market before the summer relief rally.
2022-05-27.body_zh: 上半年2022年抛售的最后一段，至6月中旬低点，火热的 CPI 数据迫使美联储加息75个基点、衰退定价见顶。环境为放缓/通缩恐慌（SPY −11.7%、VIX 26→33、周期股 −12.5% 对防御股 −10.5%），伴随又一次利率震荡（TLT −6.0%）；对利率敏感的金融科技在此随大盘见底，随后迎来夏季喘息反弹。
drivers: Rate jolt (TLT −6.0%); hot CPI forced a 75bp Fed hike
Recession pricing peaked; bottomed with broad market at mid-June low
Set up the summer relief rally
drivers_zh: 利率震荡（TLT −6.0%）；火热 CPI 迫使美联储加息75个基点
衰退定价见顶；随大盘于6月中旬低点见底

2022-06-16.title: Summer relief rally on a tech-led risk-on melt-up (+34%)
2022-06-16.title_zh: 夏季喘息反弹乘科技领涨风险偏好融涨（+34%）
2022-06-16.body: A strong +34% summer rally into mid-August 2022 on a tech/semis-led, goldilocks-leaning risk-on bounce (SPY +17.7%, semis +19.5%, growth−value +8.8, VIX 33→20, oil collapsing −26.4%) and hopes that inflation had peaked and the Fed might pivot. Long-duration fintech, the most beaten-down high-beta cohort, led the bounce — but it was a classic bear-market rally that reversed once Jackson Hole reaffirmed the hawkish stance.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 随科技/半导体领涨、偏 goldilocks 的风险偏好反弹（SPY +17.7%、半导体 +19.5%、成长−价值 +8.8、VIX 33→20、油价暴跌−26.4%），加上通胀见顶、美联储或将转向的预期，出现强劲的+34%夏季反弹至2022年8月中旬。跌得最惨的高贝塔长久期金融科技领涨——但这是经典的熊市反弹，在杰克逊霍尔重申鹰派立场后即反转。
drivers: Hopes inflation had peaked / Fed pivot; oil collapsed −26.4%
Most beaten-down long-duration high-beta fintech led
Classic bear-market rally; reversed after Jackson Hole
drivers_zh: 科技/半导体领涨风险偏好融涨（半导体 +19.5%、成长−价值 +8.8、VIX 33→20）
通胀见顶/美联储转向预期；油价暴跌−26.4%
跌得最惨的长久期高贝塔金融科技领涨
经典熊市反弹；杰克逊霍尔后反转

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole give-back — the worst rate jolt of 2022 (−24%)
2022-08-16.title_zh: 杰克逊霍尔回吐——2022年最猛利率震荡（−24%）
2022-08-16.body: The summer rally unwound into November 2022 after Jackson Hole crushed pivot hopes and rates pushed to new cycle highs — the leg's TLT −17.8% is the most violent rate jolt of the whole 2022 saga, alongside DXY +3.8% and SPY −12.6%. Rate-sensitive fintech gave back most of the bounce as the long-duration discount-rate squeeze re-intensified; the basket made a higher low here as the broad market neared its October 2022 bottom.
2022-08-16.body_zh: 夏季反弹在杰克逊霍尔粉碎转向预期、利率推升至新周期高点后回吐至2022年11月——本段 TLT −17.8% 是整个2022年剧本中最猛烈的利率震荡，伴随 DXY +3.8% 与 SPY −12.6%。对利率敏感的金融科技回吐大部分涨幅，长久期贴现率挤压重新加剧；篮子在此筑出更高的低点，恰逢大盘逼近2022年10月底部。
drivers: Most violent rate jolt of 2022 (TLT −17.8%, DXY +3.8%)
Jackson Hole crushed pivot hopes; rates to new cycle highs
Higher low as broad market neared October bottom
drivers_zh: 杰克逊霍尔粉碎转向预期；利率至新周期高点
长久期贴现率挤压重新加剧
大盘逼近10月底部时筑更高低点

2022-11-09.title: First bounce off the lows — rates fall, dollar breaks (+32%)
2022-11-09.title_zh: 自低点的首次反弹——利率回落、美元破位（+32%）
2022-11-09.body: A sharp recovery into February 2023 as the regime flipped goldilocks: yields finally fell (TLT +15.3%), the dollar broke (DXY −8.0%), semis ripped +32.2% and high-beta led (high-beta minus low-vol +22.2%, VIX 26→19). The networks led on volume — Visa and Mastercard kept posting double-digit growth regardless of macro — while the bombed-out fintech disruptors got the high-beta oversold bounce. The move stalled by February 2023, just before the SVB regional-bank crisis re-introduced fear into anything Financials-coded.
2022-11-09.body_zh: 随环境翻转为 goldilocks，出现急速反弹至2023年2月：收益率终于回落（TLT +15.3%）、美元破位（DXY −8.0%）、半导体急升+32.2%、高贝塔领涨（高贝塔减低波 +22.2%、VIX 26→19）。网络巨头凭交易量领涨——无论宏观如何，Visa 与 Mastercard 持续录得两位数增长——同时被打入谷底的金融科技颠覆者迎来高贝塔超卖反弹。该行情在2023年2月停滞，恰在 SVB 区域银行危机给一切带金融标签的资产重新注入恐惧之前。
drivers: Goldilocks flip: yields fell (TLT +15.3%), dollar broke (DXY −8.0%)
Networks led on double-digit volume; disruptors got oversold bounce
Stalled into the Feb-2023 SVB scare

高贝塔领涨（半导体 +32.2%、高贝塔−低波 +22.2%、VIX 26→19）

2023-02-02.title: SVB-scare pullback — guilt by sector association (−22%)
2023-02-02.title_zh: SVB恐慌回调——板块关联的连坐（−22%）
2023-02-02.body: A −22% drop into May 2023 as the SVB regional-bank crisis hit anything Financials-coded — and notably this was an idiosyncratic Financials de-risk, not a market event (SPY −1.0%, VIX 19→18 barely moved), but breadth narrowed hard (RSP lagged SPY −6.3%). Payments got caught in the cross-asset de-risking even though the networks had no banking-deposit exposure — guilt by sector association. The basket bottomed in early May with the regional-bank low.
2023-02-02.body_zh: 回落−22%至2023年5月，SVB 区域银行危机冲击一切带金融标签的资产——值得注意，这是个体化的金融板块去风险，而非市场事件（SPY −1.0%、VIX 19→18 几乎没动），但广度大幅收窄（RSP 落后 SPY −6.3%）。支付被卷入跨资产去风险，尽管网络巨头并无银行存款敞口——板块关联的连坐。篮子于5月初随区域银行低点见底。
drivers: Idiosyncratic Financials de-risk: −22% while SPY only −1.0%, VIX flat 19→18
SVB crisis hit anything Financials-coded; breadth narrowed (RSP −6.3%)
Guilt by sector association (networks have no deposit risk)
Bottomed early May with regional-bank low

板块关联的连坐（网络无存款风险）

2023-05-02.title: Post-SVB recovery on the genAI risk-on (+41%)
2023-05-02.title_zh: SVB后复苏乘生成式AI风险偏好（+41%）
2023-05-02.body: A strong +41% rebound into August 2023 as the SVB panic faded and the early genAI rally broadened into a tech/semis-led risk-on (SPY +11.5%, semis +30.0%, growth−value +8.8, VIX 18→14). The durable networks led on resilient consumer spend while the fintech disruptors caught the high-beta tailwind — even with the 10Y still rising (TLT −6.4%), the risk-on impulse and falling VIX dominated. A real recovery leg, not just a bounce.
2023-05-02.body_zh: 强劲反弹+41%至2023年8月，SVB 恐慌消退、早期生成式 AI 行情扩散为科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好（SPY +11.5%、半导体 +30.0%、成长−价值 +8.8、VIX 18→14）。耐用的网络巨头凭借坚韧的消费支出领涨，金融科技颠覆者抓住高贝塔顺风——即便10Y 仍在上行（TLT −6.4%），风险偏好脉冲与回落的 VIX 占主导。这是真正的复苏行情，而非仅是反弹。
drivers: SVB panic faded; Fed near end of hiking cycle
Durable networks led on resilient consumer spend; disruptors caught high-beta upside
Risk-on dominated despite the 10Y still rising (TLT −6.4%)

SVB 恐慌消退；美联储接近加息尾声

2023-08-01.title: Higher-for-longer dip — yield toward 5% (−23%)
2023-08-01.title_zh: 更高更久回调——收益率逼近5%（−23%）
2023-08-01.body: A −23% pullback into late October 2023 as the 10-year yield spiked toward 5% on a 'higher-for-longer' Fed — a stagflation-ish, rate-driven selloff (TLT −13.5%, DXY +4.2%, VIX 14→21, SPY −9.7%) that hit all long-duration assets. Rate-sensitive fintech sold off with them, but this October 2023 low became the launchpad for the +117% bull run that followed.
2023-08-01.body_zh: 回调−23%至2023年10月底，10年期收益率在美联储更高更久立场下飙向5%——一场偏滞胀、由利率驱动的抛售（TLT −13.5%、DXY +4.2%、VIX 14→21、SPY −9.7%）冲击所有长久期资产。对利率敏感的金融科技随之抛售，但这个2023年10月低点成为随后+117%牛市的发射台。
drivers: Rate-sensitive fintech sold with all long-duration assets
Oct-2023 low became launchpad for the +117% run
drivers_zh: 利率驱动的偏滞胀抛售（TLT −13.5%、DXY +4.2%、VIX 14→21）
10年期收益率在更高更久立场下飙向5%
对利率敏感金融科技随长久期资产抛售

2023-10-27.title: The +117% post-SVB-to-peak bull rode the goldilocks melt-up
2023-10-27.title_zh: SVB之后至高点的+117%牛市乘 goldilocks 融涨
2023-10-27.body: The big leg: from the October 2023 low, payments & fintech more than doubled (+117%) into February 2025 — 2.3x the broad market (SPY +51.4%) — riding a goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation melt-up (semis +87.2%, growth−value +23.3%, yields falling TLT +10.2%, VIX 21→15). Falling-rate expectations, a resilient US consumer, and the September 2024 Fed cuts re-rated the long-duration fintech names, while the networks compounded steadily on cross-border travel and ecommerce volume. The November 2024 election added a deregulation/M&A tailwind to the whole financial complex. In a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP lagged SPY −12.2%), the speculative high-beta tail (Block, Affirm, the BNPL cohort) earned its biggest returns alongside the durable V/MA core.
2023-10-27.body_zh: 主升浪：自2023年10月低点起，支付与金融科技翻倍有余（+117%），一路涨至2025年2月——是大盘的2.3倍（SPY +51.4%），乘 goldilocks/增长向上去通胀的融涨（半导体 +87.2%、成长−价值 +23.3%、收益率回落 TLT +10.2%、VIX 21→15）。降息预期、坚韧的美国消费者、加上2024年9月美联储降息，使长久期金融科技股重估；同时网络巨头靠跨境旅行与电商交易量稳步复利。2024年11月大选为整个金融板块叠加放松监管/并购的顺风。在狭窄的大型股行情中（RSP 落后 SPY −12.2%），投机性高贝塔尾部（Block、Affirm、先买后付群）取得最大涨幅，与耐用的 V/MA 核心并肩。

Resilient US consumer + Nov-2024 deregulation/M&A tailwind
Narrow tape (RSP −12.2%); high-beta tail (BLOCK/AFRM/BNPL) led, V/MA core compounded

2025-02-18.title: DeepSeek-to-tariff air pocket — the VIX-15-to-52 flush (−30%)
2025-02-18.title_zh: DeepSeek至关税的真空区——VIX 15到52冲洗（−30%）
2025-02-18.body: Payments rolled over with the broad market in the early-2025 risk-off: the DeepSeek shock dented growth multiples, then the April 8 tariff crash hit the most cyclical, consumer-exposed names hardest. This was a violent flight-to-safety flush (VIX 15→52, high-beta minus low-vol −23.3%, defensives −6.9% vs cyclicals −18.7%, SPY −18.6%) — and as a high-beta consumer-cyclical group, fintech amplified it. A squeezed consumer means lower spend volume (the direct fear for payments) and higher recession odds compress fintech multiples. The basket bottomed with the broad market on April 8.
2025-02-18.body_zh: 支付随2025年初的避险情绪与大盘一同回落：DeepSeek 冲击削弱成长估值，随后4月8日关税崩盘对最具周期性、消费暴露最高的标的打击最重。这是一次猛烈的避险冲洗（VIX 15→52、高贝塔减低波 −23.3%、防御股 −6.9% 对周期股 −18.7%、SPY −18.6%）——作为高贝塔消费周期组别，金融科技将其放大。受挤压的消费者意味着更低的支付量（支付板块最直接的担忧），更高的衰退概率压缩金融科技估值。篮子于4月8日随大盘见底。

DeepSeek shock + April-8 tariff crash hit consumer-cyclical names hardest
Squeezed-consumer fear → lower spend volume; recession-odds compressed multiples

消费受挤压担忧→支付量下降；衰退概率压缩估值

2025-04-08.title: Tariff-low recovery rode the high-beta V-bounce (+57%)
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税低点修复乘高贝塔 V 型反弹（+57%）
2025-04-08.body: A strong +57% V-bounce off the April 2025 tariff low as the market recovered into a tech/semis-led risk-on (SPY +30.3%, semis +61.3%, growth−value +17.8, VIX 52→15, high-beta minus low-vol +47.4%, dollar weak DXY −5.0%). A capital-markets revival, easing recession fear, and renewed deal/IPO activity favored the whole financial complex; the networks resumed compounding and the high-beta fintech disruptors caught the outsized upside. In a narrow tape (RSP lagged SPY −6.5%), the leg ran into late August 2025 before the next macro reset.
2025-04-08.body_zh: 随大盘修复进入科技/半导体领涨的风险偏好（SPY +30.3%、半导体 +61.3%、成长−价值 +17.8、VIX 52→15、高贝塔减低波 +47.4%、美元走弱 DXY −5.0%），自2025年4月关税低点出现强劲的+57% V 型反弹。资本市场复苏、衰退担忧缓解、并购/IPO 活动重启，利好整个金融板块；网络巨头恢复复利，高贝塔金融科技颠覆者抓住超额上行。在狭窄行情中（RSP 落后 SPY −6.5%），该行情持续至2025年8月底，随后迎来下一轮宏观重置。

Narrow tape (RSP −6.5%); ran into late-Aug 2025 reset

2025-08-29.title: Oil-shock / hawkish-Fed drawdown — the stagflation squeeze (−29%)
2025-08-29.title_zh: 油价冲击/鹰派美联储回撤——滞胀挤压（−29%）
2025-08-29.body: The basket sold off ~29% from its August 2025 peak into March 2026, leading into the 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock — a stagflation-ish regime where oil exploded +55.7%, VIX 15→31, and growth>value reversed hard (growth−value −12.6%) even as the broad index barely moved (SPY −0.9%). Notably this was an idiosyncratic Financials drawdown (Financials −10.4% one of the worst sectors) within a flat tape. CPI running 4.2% and a Fed shifting back to a hiking bias is the worst macro mix for rate-sensitive fintech: higher discount rates compress the long-duration names, and an oil-driven squeeze on the consumer threatens transaction volume. This reset the basket to its current Prime-entry washout near pos 15.
2025-08-29.body_zh: 篮子自2025年8月高点下跌约−29%至2026年3月，领先于2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击——一个偏滞胀的环境，油价暴涨+55.7%、VIX 15→31、成长跑赢价值大幅反转（成长−价值 −12.6%），而大盘几乎没动（SPY −0.9%）。值得注意，这是平淡行情中的个体化金融回撤（金融板块 −10.4% 为最差板块之一）。CPI 高达4.2%、美联储重回加息倾向，是对利率敏感金融科技最糟糕的宏观组合：更高的贴现率压缩长久期标的，油价驱动的消费挤压威胁交易量。正是这轮回撤把篮子重置到当前 pos 15 附近的黄金入场洗盘状态。
drivers: Idiosyncratic Financials drawdown (Financials −10.4%) in a flat tape (SPY −0.9%)
2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock, CPI 4.2%, Fed back to hiking bias
Higher rates compressed long-duration fintech; oil-driven consumer squeeze hit volume

2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击，CPI 4.2%，美联储重回加息倾向
高利率压缩长久期金融科技；油价驱动的消费挤压打击交易量

2026-03-27.title: Mid-June-ceasefire bounce on the risk-on flip (+19%)
2026-03-27.title_zh: 6月中旬停火反弹乘风险偏好翻转（+19%）
2026-03-27.body: A reflex rally off the March 2026 low as the mid-June Hormuz ceasefire took the worst-case oil/inflation tail off the table and the regime flipped goldilocks (oil −10.1%, semis +24.0%, growth−value +6.8, VIX 31→19). Lower oil eases the consumer squeeze and softens the Fed's hawkish bias — both directly positive for spend volume and fintech multiples. The bounce is modest (+19%, lagging SPY +11.8% only slightly) and the basket sits low, which is the constructive read: most of the damage is done, and the durable V/MA core gives the setup a real floor.
2026-03-27.body_zh: 随6月中旬霍尔木兹停火消除最坏情形的油价/通胀尾部风险、环境翻转为 goldilocks（油价 −10.1%、半导体 +24.0%、成长−价值 +6.8、VIX 31→19），自2026年3月低点出现反射性反弹。油价回落缓解消费挤压、软化美联储鹰派倾向——两者都直接利好支付量与金融科技估值。反弹幅度温和（+19%，略逊于 SPY +11.8%）、篮子位置偏低，这正是建设性的解读：大部分损伤已消化，耐用的 V/MA 核心为这一入场提供了真实底部。
drivers: Mid-June Hormuz ceasefire removed worst-case oil/inflation tail
Lower oil eased consumer squeeze + softer Fed bias helped multiples
Durable V/MA core anchors the low-position setup

regional_banks.now: Regional banks (KRE) are Trending at pos 56.3 — fully healed from the trauma that defines this basket's modern history, and a high-beta, economically-sensitive corner of Financials that amplifies the cycle in both directions. KRE was the epicenter of the March 2023 crisis: Silicon Valley Bank's collapse over a duration-mismatched bond book triggered a deposit run that took down Signature and First Republic and gutted the whole group. What rebuilt it from the May 2023 low is the same thing that broke it, in reverse — net interest margin (NIM) stabilizing as the rate panic faded, deposits stickier, and from the November 2024 election a powerful deregulation/M&A Trump trade. The current tape is reflation/growth-up (cyclicals +11.2% vs defensives +6.9%, oil +19.2%, copper-gold +17.6) which is normally a bank tailwind, yet Financials lag (−2.7%) — and the 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock with a Fed in hiking bias cuts both ways: steeper rates can help NIM but stress commercial real estate and credit. At RS #14 and mid-range positioning, this is a participate-but-watch-credit basket.
regional_banks.now_zh: 区域银行（KRE）处于趋势中，pos 56.3——已从定义本篮子现代史的创伤中完全康复；它是金融板块中高贝塔、对经济高度敏感的角落，在两个方向上都放大周期。KRE 是2023年3月危机的震中：硅谷银行（SVB）因久期错配的债券账户崩溃，引发存款挤兑，拖垮了 Signature 与 First Republic 并重创整组。自2023年5月低点将其重建的，正是当初摧毁它的因素的反向运行——随利率恐慌消退，净息差（NIM）企稳、存款黏性增强；以及自2024年11月大选起强劲的放松监管/并购特朗普交易。当前行情为再通胀/增长向上（周期股 +11.2% 对防御股 +6.9%、油价 +19.2%、铜金比 +17.6），通常是银行顺风，但金融板块却落后（−2.7%）——而2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击叠加美联储加息倾向双向作用：更陡的利率可助 NIM，但会压力商业地产与信用。RS 第14位、位置居中，这是一个参与但需盯紧信用的篮子。

2020-07-09.title: Reopening rate-steepening boom amplified the reflation melt-up (+152%)
2020-07-09.title_zh: 复工/曲线趋陡繁荣放大再通胀融涨（+152%）
2020-07-09.body: From the COVID lows, regional banks ripped +152% into January 2022 — nearly 3x the broad market (SPY +51%) — as a high-beta cyclical levered into the classic early-cycle bank trade. The regime did the heavy lifting: a roaring reflation/growth-up melt-up (cyclicals +69.0% vs defensives +33.2%, oil +111.6%, copper-gold +55.0, high-beta minus low-vol +75.6%, broadening RSP beat SPY +13.5%) with a steepening curve (TLT −13.1% as yields rose) and reopening loan demand. Rising rates promised to finally widen net interest margins after years of zero-rate compression. In hindsight this leg planted the seed of the 2023 crisis — banks loaded up on long-dated bonds at peak prices, an unhedged duration bet that would detonate when rates spiked.
2020-07-09.body_zh: 自新冠低点起，区域银行飙升+152%至2022年1月——是大盘的近三倍（SPY +51%），作为高贝塔周期股放大了经典的周期早段银行交易。环境功不可没：轰鸣的再通胀/增长向上融涨（周期股 +69.0% 对防御股 +33.2%、油价 +111.6%、铜金比 +55.0、高贝塔减低波 +75.6%、广度转宽 RSP 跑赢 SPY +13.5%），曲线趋陡（收益率上行 TLT −13.1%），复工贷款需求。加息承诺在多年零利率压缩后终于拓宽净息差。事后看，正是这段行情埋下了2023年危机的种子——银行在价格高点囤积了长久期债券，一笔未对冲的久期押注，将在利率飙升时引爆。
drivers: High-beta cyclical amplified the regime: +152% vs SPY +51%
Steepening curve (TLT −13.1%) + reopening loan demand promised wider NIM
Banks loaded long-dated bonds at peak — the unhedged duration bet
drivers_zh: 再通胀/增长向上融涨（周期股 +69.0%、油价 +111.6%、广度 RSP +13.5%）
高贝塔周期股放大行情：+152% 对 SPY +51%
曲线趋陡（TLT −13.1%）＋复工贷款需求承诺更宽 NIM
银行在价格高点囤积长久期债券——未对冲久期押注

2022-01-14.title: 2022 Fed-hiking drawdown — rate/dollar shock loads the powder (−27%)
2022-01-14.title_zh: 2022年美联储加息回撤——利率/美元冲击铺设火药（−27%）
2022-01-14.body: Banks fell −27% with the broad 2022 bear (SPY −20.9%) in a stagflation-ish rate-and-dollar shock — the 10Y surged hard (TLT −20.8%), DXY ripped +8.9%, VIX 19→33 — and as a high-beta cyclical KRE tracked the cyclical wreckage (cyclicals −15.5% vs defensives −8.4%). The headline worry was recession-and-credit, but the deeper, under-appreciated damage was on the balance sheet: every rate hike marked those peak-priced bond portfolios further underwater. The market couldn't yet see it — held-to-maturity accounting masked the unrealized losses — but the same rate move powering the macro selloff was laying the powder for 2023.
2022-01-14.body_zh: 随2022年大熊市（SPY −20.9%），银行在偏滞胀的利率与美元冲击中下跌−27%——10Y 猛烈飙升（TLT −20.8%）、DXY 大涨+8.9%、VIX 19→33——作为高贝塔周期股，KRE 跟随周期股残局（周期股 −15.5% 对防御股 −8.4%）。表面担忧是衰退与信用，但更深、被低估的损伤在资产负债表上：每一次加息都让那些高价买入的债券组合浮亏更深。市场当时还看不到——持有至到期会计掩盖了未实现损失——但驱动宏观抛售的同一波利率走势，正在为2023年铺设火药。
drivers: Rate/dollar shock (TLT −20.8%, DXY +8.9%, VIX 19→33) drove the −27%
High-beta cyclical tracked the wreckage (cyclicals −15.5% vs defensives −8.4%)
Peak-priced bond books marked further underwater each hike
Held-to-maturity accounting masked the powder being laid for 2023

每次加息让高价债券账户浮亏加深
持有至到期会计掩盖为2023年铺设的火药

2022-06-16.title: Pre-crisis relief rally on the goldilocks bounce (+20%)
2022-06-16.title_zh: 危机前喘息反弹乘 goldilocks 反弹（+20%）
2022-06-16.body: A modest +20% recovery into February 2023, riding a goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation bounce (SPY +14.7%, VIX 33→19, oil −34.4% as the inflation scare eased, broadening RSP beat SPY +4.2%) on peak-rate hopes and the early-2023 genAI risk-on. It looked like a normal cyclical bank bounce — but it ended abruptly in early February, mere weeks before the deposit run began. In hindsight this is the calm before the storm: the unrealized bond losses were still buried, and the catalyst was about to arrive.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 随 goldilocks/增长向上去通胀的反弹（SPY +14.7%、VIX 33→19、通胀恐慌缓解油价 −34.4%、广度转宽 RSP 跑赢 SPY +4.2%），借利率见顶预期与2023年初生成式 AI 风险偏好，温和复苏+20%至2023年2月。看似一次普通的周期银行股反弹——但在2月初戛然而止，距存款挤兑开始仅数周。事后看这是暴风雨前的平静：未实现的债券损失仍被掩埋，而催化剂即将到来。
drivers: Unrealized bond losses still buried — calm before the SVB storm
drivers_zh: 利率见顶预期＋2023年初生成式 AI 风险偏好
看似普通的周期银行股反弹
未实现债券损失仍被掩埋——SVB 暴风雨前的平静

2023-02-07.title: The SVB crisis collapse — an idiosyncratic break (−38%)
2023-02-07.body: The defining event, and a rare idiosyncratic crash: in March 2023, Silicon Valley Bank's forced bond-portfolio sale revealed the unrealized losses the whole group was sitting on, triggering a digital-age deposit run that collapsed SVB, Signature, and First Republic within days. KRE crashed −38% while the broad market barely moved (SPY −2.1%, VIX 19→20) — this was not a macro de-risk but a sector-specific solvency panic, with capital fleeing anything regional for money-market funds and too-big-to-fail banks (narrow tape, RSP lagged SPY −5.8%). The Fed's emergency BTFP facility eventually stemmed the panic, but the basket bottomed in early May 2023 a shadow of itself — the crisis epicenter.
2023-02-07.body_zh: 决定性事件，且是罕见的个体化崩盘：2023年3月，硅谷银行（SVB）被迫抛售债券组合，暴露了全组所共有的未实现损失，引发数字时代的存款挤兑，数日内令 SVB、Signature 与 First Republic 相继崩溃。KRE 暴跌−38%，而大盘几乎没动（SPY −2.1%、VIX 19→20）——这不是宏观去风险，而是板块特异的偿付能力恐慌，资金逃离一切区域银行、奔向货币市场基金与大到不能倒银行（狭窄行情，RSP 落后 SPY −5.8%）。美联储紧急的 BTFP 工具最终遏制了恐慌，但篮子于2023年5月初触底时已大幅缩水——危机的震中。
drivers: Idiosyncratic break: −38% while SPY only −2.1% (sector solvency panic, not macro)

拖垮 SVB/Signature/First Republic；资金逃向货币基金与大到不能倒银行
美联储紧急 BTFP 工具最终遏制恐慌

2023-05-04.title: The +128% deregulation recovery rode the goldilocks melt-up
2023-05-04.title_zh: +128%放松监管复苏乘 goldilocks 融涨
2023-05-04.body: From the May 2023 crisis low, KRE more than doubled (+128%) into November 2024 — 2.5x the broad market (SPY +50.6%) — one of the great recovery trades, and a high-beta cyclical amplifying a goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation melt-up (semis +101.2%, growth−value +27.1%, VIX 20→15, credit firm HYG−LQD +10.0). The healing was mechanical at first: deposits stabilized, NIM bottomed as the rate panic faded, and survivors proved their books money-good. Then the November 2024 election added rocket fuel — a deregulation/M&A Trump trade promising lighter capital rules and a wave of consolidation. The September 2024 Fed cuts eased deposit-cost pressure. From epicenter to leader in eighteen months, even in a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP lagged SPY −14.2%).
2023-05-04.body_zh: 自2023年5月危机低点起，KRE 翻倍有余（+128%）至2024年11月——是大盘的2.5倍（SPY +50.6%），堪称伟大的复苏交易之一；作为高贝塔周期股，它放大了 goldilocks/增长向上去通胀的融涨（半导体 +101.2%、成长−价值 +27.1%、VIX 20→15、信用坚挺 HYG−LQD +10.0）。康复起初是机械式的：存款企稳，随利率恐慌消退 NIM 见底，幸存者证明其账户资产成色十足。随后2024年11月大选注入火箭燃料——放松监管/并购的特朗普交易，承诺更宽松的资本规则与整合潮。2024年9月美联储降息缓解了存款成本压力。十八个月内，从震中到领涨，即便处于狭窄的大型股行情（RSP 落后 SPY −14.2%）。
drivers: High-beta cyclical amplified it: +128% vs SPY +50.6%
Deposits/NIM healed; Nov-2024 deregulation/M&A Trump trade added rocket fuel
Sep-2024 Fed cuts eased deposit costs; narrow tape (RSP −14.2%)
drivers_zh: Goldilocks/增长向上融涨（半导体 +101.2%、成长−价值 +27.1%、VIX 20→15）
高贝塔周期股放大：+128% 对 SPY +50.6%
存款/NIM 康复；2024年11月放松监管/并购特朗普交易注入火箭燃料
2024年9月美联储降息缓解存款成本；狭窄行情（RSP −14.2%）

2024-11-25.title: Tariff-crash give-back — high-beta hit hardest (−30%)
2024-11-25.title_zh: 关税崩盘回吐——高贝塔受创最重（−30%）
2024-11-25.body: Banks gave back −30% of the post-election rally into the April 2025 tariff crash — deeper than the broad market (SPY −16.4%) in a flight-to-safety flush (VIX 15→52, high-beta minus low-vol −21.0%, defensives −7.6% vs cyclicals −18.9%). The Trump-trade optimism that had powered them since November ran into a tariff-driven growth scare, and recession-odds spiking is the direct enemy of bank credit — so this high-beta, economically-sensitive group sold off hardest. The basket bottomed with the broad market on April 8, 2025.
2024-11-25.body_zh: 随2025年4月关税崩盘，银行回吐了大选后涨幅−30%——在避险冲洗中（VIX 15→52、高贝塔减低波 −21.0%、防御股 −7.6% 对周期股 −18.9%）跌幅深于大盘（SPY −16.4%）。自11月以来推动它们的特朗普交易乐观情绪，撞上了关税驱动的增长恐慌，衰退概率飙升是银行信用的直接敌人——故这一高贝塔、对经济敏感的组别跌幅最深。篮子于2025年4月8日随大盘见底。
drivers: Flight-to-safety flush (VIX 15→52, high-beta−low-vol −21.0%) — sold harder than tape
−30% vs SPY −16.4%: high-beta economically-sensitive group hit hardest
Tariff growth scare; recession-odds spike is the enemy of bank credit
drivers_zh: 避险冲洗（VIX 15→52、高贝塔−低波 −21.0%）——抛售比大盘更猛
−30% 对 SPY −16.4%：高贝塔、经济敏感组别受创最重
关税增长恐慌；衰退概率飙升是银行信用的敌人

2025-04-08.title: The +68% tariff-low rally rode the risk-on V-bounce
2025-04-08.title_zh: +68%关税低点行情乘风险偏好 V 型反弹
2025-04-08.body: From the April 2025 tariff low, KRE rallied +68% into mid-2026, restoring its Trending status by riding a powerful reflation/growth-up V-bounce (SPY +49.6%, semis a blistering +255.0%, VIX 52→19, high-beta minus low-vol +118.3%, cyclicals +51.4% vs defensives +20.4%). The recovery rode the market-wide rebound, a renewed deregulation/M&A thrust, and stabilizing NIM. The 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock and Fed hiking bias cut both ways — steeper rates can widen margins, but the inflation/rates combo stresses commercial real estate and credit quality, the perennial regional-bank vulnerability. The mid-June ceasefire took the worst-case tail off. The basket is healthy and mid-range; in a narrow tape (RSP lagged SPY −8.8%) the thing to watch from here is credit, not deposits.
2025-04-08.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点起，KRE 上涨+68%至2026年中，借一场强劲的再通胀/增长向上 V 型反弹（SPY +49.6%、半导体狂飙+255.0%、VIX 52→19、高贝塔减低波 +118.3%、周期股 +51.4% 对防御股 +20.4%）重回趋势中状态。复苏借力全市场反弹、放松监管/并购的再度发力、以及企稳的 NIM。2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击与美联储加息倾向双向作用——更陡的利率可拓宽利差，但通胀/利率组合会压力商业地产与信用质量，这是区域银行长期的软肋。6月中旬停火消除了最坏尾部。篮子健康、位置居中；在狭窄行情中（RSP 落后 SPY −8.8%），从此往后要盯的是信用，而非存款。
drivers: +68% restored Trending; renewed deregulation/M&A thrust + stabilizing NIM
2026 oil shock/hiking bias cuts both ways for banks (NIM vs CRE/credit)
Narrow tape (RSP −8.8%); watch credit/CRE, not deposits, from here
drivers_zh: 风险偏好 V 型反弹（SPY +49.6%、半导体 +255.0%、高贝塔−低波 +118.3%、VIX 52→19）
+68% 重回趋势中；放松监管/并购再发力＋NIM 企稳
2026年油价冲击/加息倾向对银行双向（NIM 对商业地产/信用）
狭窄行情（RSP −8.8%）；从此往后盯信用/商业地产，而非存款

big_pharma.now: Big pharma (PPH) is Rolling over at pos 32.4 with weak RS (#31) — the policy-overhang laggard of Healthcare, and a low-beta defensive that the current reflation/growth-up tape has left behind: Tech leads +24.3%, Energy +21.5%, while this group sits in the back. This basket (Merck, Pfizer, Bristol, AbbVie, J&J; GLP-1 leaders sit in their own obesity basket) carries the heaviest political tax in the market: the May 2025 Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) drug-pricing executive order, which threatens to peg US drug prices to lower foreign benchmarks, plus RFK Jr. at HHS injecting genuine uncertainty into FDA, vaccines, and approval pathways. On top of that sits the structural patent-cliff problem — several mega-blockbusters losing exclusivity this decade — which keeps the group leaning on M&A to refill pipelines. The macro doesn't help: with growth>value reversing (growth−value −15.2%), defensives are not the leadership here, and after a long drug-pricing-driven slide into May 2025, the group's late-2025 defensive bid (cheap, dividend-paying, recession-resistant) has rolled back over. It's a value/yield hold with a policy sword hanging over it, not a momentum name.
big_pharma.now_zh: 大型药企（PPH）处于见顶回落，pos 32.4、RS 疲弱（第31位）——医疗板块中受政策压制的落后者，也是被当前再通胀/增长向上行情抛在身后的低贝塔防御品：科技领涨+24.3%、能源+21.5%，本组居后。该篮子（Merck、Pfizer、Bristol、AbbVie、J&J；GLP-1 龙头另列减肥药篮子）承担着市场上最重的政治税：2025年5月的最惠国（MFN）药品定价行政令，威胁将美国药价锚定至更低的海外基准；加上小肯尼迪（RFK Jr.）执掌 HHS，为 FDA、疫苗与审批路径注入真实的不确定性。叠加结构性专利悬崖问题——数款超级重磅药本十年将失去独占权——使该组别持续依赖并购来补充管线。宏观也不帮忙：随成长跑赢价值反转（成长−价值 −15.2%），防御股并非此处的领导者；在因药品定价拖累、长期下滑至2025年5月后，该组别2025年末的防御性买盘（低估值、派息、抗衰退）已再度回落。这是一个头顶政策利剑的价值/收益持有标的，而非动量品种。

2024-09-16.title: Idiosyncratic drug-pricing slide in a rising tape (−20%)
2024-09-16.title_zh: 上涨大盘中的个体化药品定价下滑（−20%）
2024-09-16.body: From September 2024, big pharma ground down −20% into May 2025 even though the broad market was up (SPY +5.4%) — a glaring idiosyncratic underperformance under a thickening policy cloud, not a macro drawdown. The tape was a narrow, goldilocks-leaning, rate-driven one (10Y surged, TLT −13.4%; RSP lagged SPY −4.0%; defensives −6.2% vs cyclicals +6.1%) that punished low-beta defensive yield names — and pharma's drag stacked policy on top: the November 2024 election and the incoming drug-pricing agenda, RFK Jr.'s nomination to HHS, the looming MFN threat (culminating in the May 2025 executive order), and the structural patent-cliff worry with several blockbusters facing loss of exclusivity. Even through the April 2025 tariff episode, pharma fell for its own reasons.
2024-09-16.body_zh: 自2024年9月起，尽管大盘上涨（SPY +5.4%），大型药企却在日益浓重的政策阴云下震荡下行−20%至2025年5月——这是刺眼的个体化跑输，而非宏观回撤。当时的行情狭窄、偏 goldilocks、由利率驱动（10Y 飙升，TLT −13.4%；RSP 落后 SPY −4.0%；防御股 −6.2% 对周期股 +6.1%），惩罚低贝塔防御收益股——而药企的拖累在此之上叠加了政策：2024年11月大选与新政府的药品定价议程、RFK Jr. 获提名执掌 HHS、逼近的 MFN 威胁（以2025年5月行政令收尾）、以及数款重磅药面临独占权到期的结构性专利悬崖担忧。即便穿越2025年4月关税事件，药企也因自身原因下跌。
drivers: Idiosyncratic: fell −20% while SPY rose +5.4% (policy, not macro)
Rate-driven low-beta tape (TLT −13.4%, defensives −6.2%) hurt yield names
Nov-2024 election + MFN drug-pricing overhang + RFK Jr. to HHS
drivers_zh: 个体化：SPY 涨+5.4% 时本组跌−20%（政策而非宏观）
利率驱动的低贝塔行情（TLT −13.4%、防御股 −6.2%）压制收益股
2024年11月大选＋MFN 药品定价压制＋RFK Jr. 执掌 HHS
结构性专利悬崖独占权到期担忧

2025-05-14.title: Defensive bid / policy-fatigue rally — the stagflation hiding place (+42%)
2025-05-14.title_zh: 防御性买盘/政策疲劳反弹——滞胀期的避风港（+42%）
2025-05-14.body: From the May 2025 low, big pharma rallied +42% into February 2026 — a recovery built less on growth than on defensiveness and policy fatigue, and one that suited the regime: a stagflation-ish, falling-rate window (TLT +10.1%, DXY −3.4%, copper-gold −34.2%) where defensives (+21.6%) finally matched cyclicals (+19.8%) and low-beta yield came back into favor. With the MFN order's actual bite proving slower and more negotiable than feared, the market stopped pricing the worst case, and the group caught a genuine defensive bid — cheap, fat dividends, recession-resistant cash flows, exactly the profile investors want when the AI/high-beta trade gets wobbly and the 2026 oil shock raises macro risk. The Rolling-over phase and weak RS say the rally has since stalled — the policy sword still hangs, and without pipeline catalysts pharma reverts to a value/yield holding pattern.
2025-05-14.body_zh: 自2025年5月低点起，大型药企上涨+42%至2026年2月——这是一场建立在防御性与政策疲劳、而非增长之上的复苏，且契合当时的环境：偏滞胀、利率下行的窗口（TLT +10.1%、DXY −3.4%、铜金比 −34.2%），防御股（+21.6%）终于追平周期股（+19.8%），低贝塔收益重获青睐。随着 MFN 行政令的实际杀伤力被证明比担忧的更慢、更可谈判，市场停止定价最坏情形，该组别获得真正的防御性买盘——低估值、丰厚股息、抗衰退现金流，正是 AI/高贝塔交易动摇、2026年油价冲击抬高宏观风险时投资者想要的画像。见顶回落阶段与疲弱 RS 表明该涨势此后停滞——政策利剑仍悬，缺乏管线催化剂时，药企回归价值/收益的横盘格局。
drivers: Stagflation-ish/falling-rate window (TLT +10.1%, DXY −3.4%) favored low-beta defensives
MFN bite proved slower/more negotiable; cheap, dividend, recession-resistant bid
Hiding place as AI/high-beta wobbled + 2026 oil shock; stalled since
drivers_zh: 偏滞胀/利率下行窗口（TLT +10.1%、DXY −3.4%）利好低贝塔防御
MFN 杀伤力更慢、更可谈判；低估值、派息、抗衰退买盘
AI/高贝塔动摇＋2026年油价冲击时的避险去处；此后停滞

obesity_glp1.now: GLP-1 & obesity is Trending at pos 44.1 with strong RS (#13) — the secular super-cycle, now maturing into a competitive war, and a basket whose growth-y, high-conviction names ride risk-on tape harder than ordinary pharma. This is the Eli Lilly / Novo Nordisk story: incretin drugs (Mounjaro/Zepbound, Ozempic/Wegovy) that reshaped metabolic medicine and created one of the largest TAMs in pharma history. The 2025-26 chapter is the pivot from monopoly to oligopoly and from injectable to oral. By late 2025 / early 2026 both giants brought oral pills to market — Novo's oral Wegovy approved first, but Lilly's orforglipron (no food/timing restrictions) is the Street's projected long-run winner. Critically, both agreed to White House pricing deals capping starter-dose orals near $149/month — a pricing reset that trades margin per script for vastly larger volume. The basket also holds the supply chain and the names the drugs hurt (food, dialysis, medical devices). Strong RS holding up even as the broad tape goes reflation/growth-up with Tech (+24.3%) leading says the market still rewards the volume story; the risk is pricing compression and a crowded late-stage pipeline.
obesity_glp1.now_zh: GLP-1 与减肥药处于趋势中，pos 44.1、RS 强劲（第13位）——长期超级周期，如今正成熟为一场竞争战争；这是一个成长属性、高信念的篮子，比普通药企更能放大风险偏好行情。这是礼来（Eli Lilly）/诺和诺德（Novo Nordisk）的故事：肠促胰素类药物（Mounjaro/Zepbound、Ozempic/Wegovy）重塑了代谢医学，缔造了制药史上最大的潜在市场（TAM）之一。2025–26 篇章是从垄断到寡头、从注射剂到口服剂的转折。到2025年末/2026年初，两巨头均推出口服丸剂——诺和诺德的口服 Wegovy 率先获批，但礼来的 orforglipron（无饮食/服用时间限制）被华尔街预期为长期赢家。关键是，两家均与白宫达成定价协议，将口服起始剂量封顶在约149美元/月——这是一次以单方处方利润换取远大销量的定价重置。篮子还纳入供应链与被该类药物伤害的标的（食品、透析、医疗器械）。即便大盘转入由科技领涨（+24.3%）的再通胀/增长向上行情，强劲 RS 依旧坚挺，表明市场仍奖励销量故事；风险在于定价压缩与拥挤的后期管线。

2021-09-02.title: Pre-super-cycle bear — just-pharma in the rate/dollar storm (−36%)
2021-09-02.title_zh: 超级周期前的熊市——利率/美元风暴中的普通药企（−36%）
2021-09-02.body: Before the obesity narrative exploded, these names traded as ordinary large pharma/biotech and fell ~36% into May 2022 — a deeper drawdown than the broad market (SPY −12.5%) in a stagflation-ish, rate-and-dollar-shock regime (TLT −20.3%, DXY +12.6%, VIX 16→33) that punished long-duration healthcare. Lilly and Novo were known quantities (diabetes, established franchises) — the market had not yet grasped that semaglutide and tirzepatide were about to redefine the entire metabolic category. This is the basket as just-pharma, swept along by the macro before the re-rating.
2021-09-02.body_zh: 在减肥叙事爆发之前，这些标的作为普通大型药企/生物科技交易，随2022年美联储加息熊市下跌约−36%至2022年5月——在偏滞胀、利率与美元双冲击的环境中（TLT −20.3%、DXY +12.6%、VIX 16→33），跌幅深于大盘（SPY −12.5%），长久期医疗受到惩罚。礼来与诺和诺德是已知量（糖尿病、成熟特许经营）——市场尚未领悟司美格鲁肽与替尔泊肽即将重新定义整个代谢领域。这是重估之前、被宏观裹挟、作为普通药企的篮子。
drivers: Rate/dollar shock regime (TLT −20.3%, DXY +12.6%) hit long-duration healthcare
Fell −36% vs SPY −12.5% — traded as ordinary pharma, swept by macro
Market had not yet grasped the GLP-1 TAM
drivers_zh: 利率/美元冲击环境（TLT −20.3%、DXY +12.6%）打击长久期医疗
跌−36% 对 SPY −12.5%——作为普通药企被宏观裹挟
市场尚未领悟 GLP-1 潜在市场

2022-05-11.title: Tirzepatide approval spark, against the grain (+43%)
2022-05-11.title_zh: 替尔泊肽获批火花，逆势而上（+43%）
2022-05-11.body: The first leg of recognition: Lilly's tirzepatide (Mounjaro) won FDA approval for diabetes in mid-2022 and the weight-loss data was stunning — the market began to see the metabolic super-cycle coming. The +43% rally vastly outran the modest goldilocks-leaning summer bounce in the broad market (SPY +9.7%, VIX 33→20), a stock-specific re-rating that fired even though the 2022 bear was still in force. This is the basket decoupling from macro on a genuine catalyst — the obesity TAM thesis taking hold.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 认知的第一段：礼来的替尔泊肽（Mounjaro）于2022年中获 FDA 批准用于糖尿病，且减重数据惊人——市场开始预见代谢超级周期的到来。+43%的上涨远超大盘温和的偏 goldilocks 夏季反弹（SPY +9.7%、VIX 33→20），这是个股特异性重估，尽管2022年熊市仍在持续依然点燃。这是篮子凭借真实催化剂与宏观脱钩——减肥潜在市场论点确立。
drivers: Stock-specific catalyst: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) FDA approval, stunning data
+43% vastly outran the modest summer tape (SPY +9.7%, VIX 33→20)
Decoupled from the still-active 2022 bear on the TAM thesis
drivers_zh: 个股催化剂：替尔泊肽（Mounjaro）获 FDA 批准、数据惊人
凭潜在市场论点与仍在持续的2022年熊市脱钩

2022-08-15.title: Brief macro pullback in the risk-off flush (−19%)
2022-08-15.title_zh: 避险冲洗中的短暂宏观回调（−19%）
2022-08-15.body: A short, shallow give-back into late September 2022 as the broad market made its 2022 bear-market low in a flight-to-safety flush (SPY −14.7%, VIX 20→32, defensives −8.8% vs cyclicals −14.8%, TLT −10.0%, DXY +7.1%). Nothing thesis-specific — the GLP-1 names were simply pulled along by the last leg of the macro selloff before the December 2022 bottom set up the real bull run. The basket fell less than the cyclical wreckage, but its growth tilt meant it couldn't fully dodge the rate-and-dollar risk-off.
2022-08-15.body_zh: 随大盘在避险冲洗中于2022年9月底创下2022年熊市低点（SPY −14.7%、VIX 20→32、防御股 −8.8% 对周期股 −14.8%、TLT −10.0%、DXY +7.1%），出现短暂而浅的回吐。无关论点本身——GLP-1 标的只是被宏观抛售的最后一段拖累，随后2022年12月触底为真正的牛市铺路。篮子跌幅小于周期股残局，但其成长倾向意味着无法完全躲过利率与美元的避险。
drivers: Flight-to-safety flush (VIX 20→32, defensives > cyclicals) dragged the group
Rate/dollar risk-off (TLT −10.0%, DXY +7.1%) hit growth tilt
No thesis-specific catalyst — pulled by macro
Set up the real bull run off the Dec-2022 bottom
drivers_zh: 避险冲洗（VIX 20→32、防御股跑赢周期股）拖累本组
利率/美元避险（TLT −10.0%、DXY +7.1%）打击成长倾向
无关论点的催化剂——被宏观拖累
为2022年12月底部后的真正牛市铺路

2022-09-26.title: The +224% super-cycle amplified the goldilocks melt-up
2022-09-26.title_zh: +224%超级周期放大 goldilocks 融涨
2022-09-26.body: The defining leg: from September 2022, the basket exploded +224% into December 2024 — more than 3x the broad market (SPY +70.9%) — as GLP-1 went from clinical promise to cultural and commercial phenomenon. The backdrop was a goldilocks/growth-up-disinflation melt-up (semis +163.4%, growth−value +45.4%, VIX 32→14, DXY −7.0%) that rewarded high-conviction growth, and this high-beta secular winner amplified it: Zepbound's obesity approval, Wegovy's cardiovascular-benefit data, chronic global supply shortages (demand vastly outran manufacturing), and ever-expanding labels turned Lilly and Novo into two of the most valuable companies on earth. In a narrow mega-cap tape (RSP lagged SPY −22.5%), this is exactly the kind of name a risk-on regime concentrates flows into — one of the great secular growth stories of the decade.
2022-09-26.body_zh: 决定性行情：自2022年9月起，篮子爆发式上涨+224%至2024年12月——是大盘的三倍多（SPY +70.9%），GLP-1 从临床前景跃升为文化与商业现象。背景是 goldilocks/增长向上去通胀的融涨（半导体 +163.4%、成长−价值 +45.4%、VIX 32→14、DXY −7.0%），奖励高信念成长，而这一高贝塔长期赢家将其放大：Zepbound 获批用于肥胖、Wegovy 的心血管获益数据、长期的全球供应短缺（需求远超产能）、不断扩展的适应症标签，把礼来与诺和诺德推上全球市值最高公司之列。在狭窄的大型股行情中（RSP 落后 SPY −22.5%），这正是风险偏好环境集中资金流入的那类标的——本十年伟大的长期成长故事之一。

Narrow mega-cap tape (RSP −22.5%) concentrated flows into the winner

2024-12-09.title: Policy + tariff drawdown — high-beta de-risk (−28%)
2024-12-09.title_zh: 政策＋关税回撤——高贝塔去风险（−28%）
2024-12-09.body: The super-cycle met its first real correction into April 2025 — a −28% drop steeper than the broad market (SPY −17.4%) in a flight-to-safety flush (VIX 14→52, high-beta minus low-vol −23.4%, defensives −6.3% vs cyclicals −18.0%). As a heavily-owned, richly-valued high-beta name it de-risked harder than the tape: the November 2024 election and incoming MFN agenda, RFK Jr. at HHS, and disappointing next-gen trial data introduced doubt, then the April 8 tariff crash finished the job. The valuation premium that powered the super-cycle on the way up also made it the first to get sold when the risk-off hit.
2024-12-09.body_zh: 超级周期迎来首次真正调整，至2025年4月——跌幅−28%深于大盘（SPY −17.4%），处于避险冲洗中（VIX 14→52、高贝塔减低波 −23.4%、防御股 −6.3% 对周期股 −18.0%）。作为持仓集中、估值高企的高贝塔标的，它去风险比大盘更猛：2024年11月大选与新政府 MFN 议程、RFK Jr. 执掌 HHS、下一代试验数据令人失望注入怀疑，随后4月8日关税崩盘完成最后一击。使超级周期在上行时如此强劲的估值溢价，也使其在避险来袭时最先被抛售。

Nov-2024 election + MFN overhang + RFK Jr. + weak next-gen trial data
April-8 tariff crash finished the de-risking

2025-04-08.title: The +77% oral-era recovery led the risk-on V-bounce
2025-04-08.title_zh: +77%口服时代复苏领跑风险偏好 V 型反弹
2025-04-08.body: From the April 2025 tariff low, the basket rallied +77% into mid-2026, outrunning a powerful risk-on V-bounce (SPY +48.5%, semis +240.9%, VIX 52→18, high-beta minus low-vol +111.3%) as the story matured from injectable monopoly to oral oligopoly. The regime — high-beta crushing low-vol, growth back in favor — rewarded this exact profile, and the fundamentals delivered: by late 2025 / early 2026 both giants commercialized obesity pills (Novo's oral Wegovy first, Lilly's orforglipron fast-tracked with the convenience edge and the Street's projected ~60% long-run share), and both signed White House deals capping starter-dose orals near $149/month — a deliberate margin-for-volume reset that gets ahead of the MFN threat. Strong RS held through the 2026 oil shock; the watch-items are pricing compression and an increasingly crowded next-gen pipeline.
2025-04-08.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点起，篮子上涨+77%至2026年中，跑赢一场强劲的风险偏好 V 型反弹（SPY +48.5%、半导体 +240.9%、VIX 52→18、高贝塔减低波 +111.3%），随故事从注射剂垄断成熟为口服剂寡头。当时的环境——高贝塔碾压低波、成长重获青睐——恰恰奖励这种画像，基本面也兑现：到2025年末/2026年初，两巨头均将减肥丸剂商业化（诺和诺德口服 Wegovy 率先，礼来 orforglipron 快速审批、凭便利优势与华尔街预期的约60%长期份额），并均签署白宫定价协议将口服起始剂量封顶约149美元/月——一次有意的以利润换销量重置，抢先化解 MFN 威胁。强劲 RS 穿越2026年油价冲击；需盯的是定价压缩与日益拥挤的下一代管线。

Outran the tape: +77% led the rebound; strong RS held through 2026 oil shock
Late-2025/early-2026 oral pills: Novo first, Lilly orforglipron leads long-run

跑赢大盘：+77% 领跑反弹；强劲 RS 穿越2026年油价冲击

managed_care.now: Managed care (UNH, Elevance, Cigna, Humana) is the standout of the entire screen — Topping at pos 99.7 (pinned to the top of its range) with RS rank #4 — and notably it is LEADING from the low-beta/defensive side while the tape is reflation/growth-up with Tech (+24.3%) and high-beta out front (high-beta minus low-vol +20.7%). That is a violent, idiosyncratic recovery from a genuine industry crisis, not a macro beta trade. Through 2025 the medical loss ratio blew out: seniors used outpatient surgery and high-cost GLP-1 drugs far above actuarial assumptions while Medicare Advantage funding was cut, pushing UNH's medical care ratio to ~88.9% and 2025 net profit down ~16%. The turn came when 2026 economics stabilized — Q1 2026 MCR improved to ~83.9%, UNH raised guidance, and CMS finalized favorable 2027 MA rates (~2.48%), with the Street modeling a sharp MA-EBIT rebound off pricing resets. The result is the +73% rally into mid-2026 that left the basket pinned at the top. The honest read: the recovery is real and stock-specific, but pos 99.7 + Topping is exactly where you respect the move and watch for exhaustion — the easy repricing is done, and utilization/policy risk never fully leaves this group.
managed_care.now_zh: 管理式医疗（UNH、Elevance、Cigna、Humana）是整张筛选表的标杆——见顶，pos 99.7（贴在区间顶部）、RS 第4位——值得注意，它是从低贝塔/防御一侧领跑，而当前行情为再通胀/增长向上、科技领涨（+24.3%）、高贝塔在前（高贝塔减低波 +20.7%）。这是从一场真正行业危机中的暴力、个体化复苏，而非宏观贝塔交易。2025年全年医疗损失率（MLR）失控：老年人使用门诊手术与高价 GLP-1 药物的频率远超精算假设，同时 Medicare Advantage（MA）资金被削减，使 UNH 的医疗成本率升至约88.9%、2025年净利润下降约16%。转折出现在2026年经济性企稳时——2026年一季度 MCR 改善至约83.9%、UNH 上调指引、CMS 敲定有利的2027年 MA 费率（约2.48%），华尔街据定价重置建模出 MA-EBIT 的急剧反弹。结果是涨至2026年中的+73%行情，使篮子贴在顶部。诚实的解读：复苏真实且个股驱动，但 pos 99.7＋见顶恰恰是应当尊重涨势、警惕衰竭的位置——容易的重估已经完成，而利用率/政策风险从未真正离开这一组别。

2021-05-28.title: 2021-22 defensive de-rate held up in the dollar shock (−21%)
2021-05-28.title_zh: 2021–22防御性估值下修，美元冲击中抗跌（−21%）
2021-05-28.body: Managed care drifted −21% into January 2022 — a relatively mild drawdown that actually held up against a flat tape (SPY +3.7%) through a stagflation-ish dollar shock (DXY +8.0%, oil +30.6%, VIX 17→30). Health insurers are low-beta, defensive, recession-resistant cash machines, so they fared better than the high-beta names (high-beta minus low-vol −12.2%) as the Fed turned hawkish. The MCO model (collect premiums, manage the medical-loss ratio, keep the spread) is countercyclical-ish, and that defensiveness is the through-line of the whole basket's history.
2021-05-28.body_zh: 管理式医疗震荡下行−21%至2022年1月——相对温和的回撤，实际上在偏滞胀的美元冲击中（DXY +8.0%、油价 +30.6%、VIX 17→30）相对平淡的大盘（SPY +3.7%）抗住了。健康保险公司是低贝塔、防御性、抗衰退的现金机器，因此在美联储转鹰时比高贝塔标的（高贝塔减低波 −12.2%）表现更好。MCO 模式（收保费、管理医疗损失率、赚取价差）略带逆周期性，而这种防御性是整个篮子历史的主线。
drivers: Low-beta defensive held up: −21% vs a flat SPY +3.7%, beat high-beta (−12.2%)
drivers_zh: 低贝塔防御抗跌：−21% 对平淡的 SPY +3.7%，跑赢高贝塔（−12.2%）
MCO 的保费减 MLR 价差略带逆周期

2022-01-27.title: Inflation-bear defensive bid — the first safe-haven episode (+28%)
2022-01-27.title_zh: 通胀熊市防御性买盘——首次避风港行情（+28%）
2022-01-27.body: A +28% rally into April 2022 as capital rotated into defensives during the early 2022 inflation/rate scare — a rate-driven, defensives-led tape (TLT −14.6% as yields surged, defensives +11.1% vs cyclicals +6.6%, VIX 30→20) where Utilities and Real Estate led with managed care. With growth stocks unraveling (growth−value −4.7%) and high-beta still soft, the steady, dividend-paying, recession-resistant MCOs were exactly where investors hid — the first of several times this basket plays the safe-haven role.
2022-01-27.body_zh: 随2022年初通胀/利率恐慌期间资金轮入防御股，出现+28%上涨至2022年4月——一个由利率驱动、防御股领涨的行情（收益率飙升 TLT −14.6%、防御股 +11.1% 对周期股 +6.6%、VIX 30→20），公用与地产与管理式医疗一同领涨。在成长股瓦解（成长−价值 −4.7%）、高贝塔仍疲软之际，稳健、派息、抗衰退的 MCO 正是投资者的避险去处——这是本篮子多次扮演避风港角色中的第一次。
drivers: Rate-driven, defensives-led tape (TLT −14.6%, defensives +11.1% vs cyclicals +6.6%)
Capital rotated into defensives during inflation scare; growth unraveled (growth−value −4.7%)

稳健、派息、抗衰退的避险买盘

2022-04-20.title: Macro pullback — even defensives caught in the rate flush (−18%)
2022-04-20.title_zh: 宏观回调——利率冲洗中连防御股也被卷入（−18%）
2022-04-20.body: A shallow −18% give-back into June 2022 alongside the broad market's mid-2022 leg lower (SPY −17.6%, VIX 20→33) in a stagflation-ish rate move (TLT −7.8%, DXY +3.2%). No MCO-specific catalyst — even defensives (−14.5%) got pulled into the general selloff, though they still beat cyclicals (−16.4%) before resuming their relative outperformance. A reminder that in a wholesale risk-off flush, low beta cushions but doesn't immunize.
2022-04-20.body_zh: 随大盘2022年中段下行（SPY −17.6%、VIX 20→33）、在偏滞胀的利率走势中（TLT −7.8%、DXY +3.2%），出现浅幅−18%回吐至2022年6月。无关 MCO 本身的催化剂——即便防御股（−14.5%）也被卷入整体抛售，但仍跑赢周期股（−16.4%），随后恢复相对超额表现。这提醒：在全面避险冲洗中，低贝塔提供缓冲但无法免疫。
drivers: Even defensives caught: −18% with SPY −17.6%, but beat cyclicals (−16.4%)
No MCO-specific catalyst — pulled into general risk-off

2022-06-16.title: Defensive leadership rally through the bear (+31%)
2022-06-16.title_zh: 穿越熊市的防御性领导反弹（+31%）
2022-06-16.body: A +31% surge into August 2022 as managed care led the defensive trade through the heart of the 2022 bear. The tape was a goldilocks-leaning summer bounce (SPY +17.5%, semis +20.8%, VIX 33→20, oil −24.0%), and notably this defensive group kept pace with the high-beta rip (defensives +14.2% nearly matched cyclicals +15.4%) — printing steady earnings while tech bled and the safe-haven premium widened. The group's relative strength peaked around here before a long 2022-23 consolidation set in.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 随管理式医疗在2022年熊市核心阶段领跑防御交易，出现+31%飙升至2022年8月。当时是偏 goldilocks 的夏季反弹（SPY +17.5%、半导体 +20.8%、VIX 33→20、油价 −24.0%），值得注意，这一防御组别跟上了高贝塔急升（防御股 +14.2% 几乎追平周期股 +15.4%）——科技流血之际录得稳定盈利、避险溢价扩大。该组别的相对强度在此附近见顶，随后进入漫长的2022–23盘整。
drivers: Led the defensive trade; steady earnings while tech bled
Relative strength peaked before long consolidation

2022-08-15.title: Defensives unwind into genAI risk-on — source of funds (−27%)
2022-08-15.title_zh: 防御股向生成式AI风险偏好的解仓——资金来源（−27%）
2022-08-15.body: Managed care fell −27% into March 2023 — the mirror image of its 2022 strength, and a striking divergence: the broad market barely fell (SPY −7.2%, semis actually +6.2%) but defensives were sold (−8.4% vs cyclicals −5.6%, DXY −3.8%). As the December 2022 low gave way to the early-2023 genAI risk-on, capital rotated OUT of defensives and INTO growth and tech. When the market wants beta, the safe-haven MCOs become a source of funds. The bottom in March 2023 coincided with the SVB crisis peak-fear moment.
2022-08-15.body_zh: 管理式医疗下跌−27%至2023年3月——其2022年强势的镜像，且是惊人的背离：大盘几乎没跌（SPY −7.2%、半导体反而 +6.2%），但防御股被抛售（−8.4% 对周期股 −5.6%、DXY −3.8%）。随2022年12月低点让位于2023年初的生成式 AI 风险偏好，资金从防御股轮出、流入成长与科技。当市场追逐 beta 时，避险型 MCO 成为资金来源。2023年3月的底部恰逢 SVB 危机的恐慌峰值时刻。
drivers: Divergence: −27% while SPY only −7.2% and semis +6.2%
Risk-on rotation OUT of defensives (−8.4%) INTO genAI growth
Safe-haven MCOs became a source of funds for the beta trade
Bottomed at the March-2023 SVB peak-fear

2023-03-23.title: The +57% pre-crisis bull lagged the AI melt-up (Mar '23 → Sep '24)
2023-03-23.title_zh: +57%危机前牛市跑输 AI 融涨（2023年3月→2024年9月）
2023-03-23.body: A long, steady +57% climb into September 2024 — solid in absolute terms but a laggard versus a roaring goldilocks/growth-up melt-up (SPY +45.5%, semis +84.3%, growth−value +25.4%, VIX 23→17) where the market chased AI and low-beta defensives trailed (defensives +25.6% vs cyclicals +35.7%, narrow tape RSP lagged SPY −15.4%). Strong enrollment, disciplined medical-cost management, and Medicare Advantage growth drove durable earnings regardless. This is the last normal uptrend before the 2025 crisis — the calm that preceded the medical-loss-ratio blowout, ending right at the September 2024 peak as the first cracks in MA economics appeared.
2023-03-23.body_zh: 稳健的长升浪，+57%至2024年9月——绝对意义上扎实，但相对一场轰鸣的 goldilocks/增长向上融涨（SPY +45.5%、半导体 +84.3%、成长−价值 +25.4%、VIX 23→17）属于落后者，市场追逐 AI、低贝塔防御股拖后（防御股 +25.6% 对周期股 +35.7%、狭窄行情 RSP 落后 SPY −15.4%）。强劲的参保人数、严格的医疗成本管理、以及 Medicare Advantage 增长仍驱动了持久盈利。这是2025年危机前最后一段正常上行趋势——医疗损失率失控前的平静，在2024年9月高点结束，恰逢 MA 经济性首批裂缝显现之际。

Strong enrollment + disciplined medical-cost management + MA growth

2024-09-13.title: First MA-cost crack — idiosyncratic, against a rising tape (−23%)
2024-09-13.title_zh: 首批MA成本裂缝——个体化，逆上涨大盘（−23%）
2024-09-13.body: The first leg down of the crisis, and a glaring idiosyncratic break: −23% into December 2024 even though the broad market rose (SPY +7.9%) in a goldilocks tape (VIX 17→16, growth−value +11.5%, DXY +5.8%). This was company/sector-specific, not macro — Medicare Advantage cost trends started running hot and a near-flat preliminary MA rate proposal landed. The market began to grasp that utilization (outpatient procedures, and increasingly expensive GLP-1 prescriptions) was overrunning the actuarial assumptions baked into premiums. The defensive armor was cracking.
2024-09-13.body_zh: 危机的第一段下跌，且是刺眼的个体化破裂：−23%至2024年12月，尽管大盘上涨（SPY +7.9%）、处于 goldilocks 行情（VIX 17→16、成长−价值 +11.5%、DXY +5.8%）。这是公司/板块特异，而非宏观——Medicare Advantage 成本趋势开始升温、近乎持平的初步 MA 费率提案落地。市场开始领悟，利用率（门诊手术、以及日益昂贵的 GLP-1 处方）正在压垮内置于保费中的精算假设。防御铠甲正在开裂。
drivers: Idiosyncratic: −23% while SPY rose +7.9% in a goldilocks tape (VIX 17→16)
Medicare Advantage cost trends ran hot; near-flat preliminary MA rate proposal
Company/sector-specific, not macro; defensive armor began cracking
drivers_zh: 个体化：SPY 涨+7.9%、goldilocks 行情（VIX 17→16）时本组跌−23%
Medicare Advantage 成本趋势升温；近乎持平的初步 MA 费率提案
利用率（门诊＋GLP-1）压垮精算假设

2024-12-17.title: Pre-tariff relief bounce — defensive bid in the VIX-16-to-38 flush (+29%)
2024-12-17.title_zh: 关税前喘息反弹——VIX 16到38冲洗中的防御性买盘（+29%）
2024-12-17.body: A +29% bounce into April 2025 as the market hoped the cost trend was a one-off and the final MA rate would beat the flat proposal. Helpfully, the regime turned flight-to-safety (SPY −11.1%, VIX 16→38, defensives flat 0.0% vs cyclicals −10.6%, DXY −6.7%), so as a defensive the group actually attracted a relative bid even as the broad market fell. The optimism was premature — the leg ended right at the April 2025 tariff-crash window, just before UNH's guidance cut revealed the cost problem was far worse and structural, not transitory.
2024-12-17.body_zh: 随市场期望成本趋势只是一次性、且最终 MA 费率会好于持平提案，出现+29%反弹至2025年4月。有利的是，环境转向避险（SPY −11.1%、VIX 16→38、防御股持平0.0% 对周期股 −10.6%、DXY −6.7%），故作为防御品，该组别在大盘下跌时反而吸引到相对买盘。这份乐观为时过早——该行情恰在2025年4月关税崩盘窗口结束，就在 UNH 的指引下调揭示成本问题远更严重且为结构性、而非暂时性之前。
drivers: Defensive bid as SPY fell −11.1%; hope cost trend was one-off
Hope final MA rate beats the flat proposal — premature optimism
Ended at April-2025 tariff window, before UNH guidance cut

2025-04-11.title: The crisis capitulation — idiosyncratic, against a roaring rally (−33%)
2025-04-11.title_zh: 危机投降——个体化，逆狂飙行情（−33%）
2025-04-11.body: The deepest leg of the crisis, and a stunning divergence: −33% into August 2025 while the broad market roared back (SPY +16.8%, semis +41.1%, high-beta minus low-vol +36.3%, VIX 38→20). This was pure company-specific carnage in the face of a risk-on melt-up — UNH cut guidance and the market finally priced the full severity: the medical care ratio blowing out toward ~88.9%, full-year 2025 net profit down ~16%, the cost overrun confirmed as industry-wide. GLP-1 utilization (the obesity-drug super-cycle, ironically) was itself a major cost driver. Berkshire's later stake exit and a leadership/regulatory cloud over UNH deepened the gloom. Genuine capitulation in what had been Healthcare's safest group — and the safe-haven character offered no cushion because the problem was fundamental, not macro.
2025-04-11.body_zh: 危机最深的一段，且是惊人的背离：−33%至2025年8月，而大盘狂飙回升（SPY +16.8%、半导体 +41.1%、高贝塔减低波 +36.3%、VIX 38→20）。这是面对风险偏好融涨时纯粹的公司特异屠杀——UNH 下调指引，市场终于定价完整严重程度：医疗成本率向约88.9%失控、2025全年净利润下降约16%、成本超支被确认为全行业。具讽刺意味的是，GLP-1 利用率（减肥药超级周期本身）正是主要成本驱动因素之一。伯克希尔后来退出持股、加上 UNH 的领导层/监管阴云加深了悲观。曾经医疗板块最安全组别中真正的投降——避险属性毫无缓冲，因为问题是基本面的、而非宏观的。
drivers: Stunning divergence: −33% while SPY roared +16.8% (risk-on melt-up)
Company-specific: UNH guidance cut; MCR blew out toward ~88.9%

2025-08-01.title: First recovery bounce — stock-specific, low-beta tape (+37%)
2025-08-01.title_zh: 首次复苏反弹——个股驱动，低贝塔行情（+37%）
2025-08-01.body: A sharp +37% snapback into October 2025 — the first sign the worst was priced, and a stock-specific recovery in a quiet, near-trendless tape (SPY +8.6%, growth−value +3.3%, VIX 20→16, balanced cyclicals +6.8% vs defensives +5.0%). Bombed-out valuations, early evidence that 2026 repricing (insurers raising premiums and tightening benefits to restore margin) would fix the spread, and a sense that the capitulation had overshot drove an oversold rally in the most beaten-down group in Healthcare — fundamentals, not regime, did the work.
2025-08-01.body_zh: 急速回升+37%至2025年10月——最坏情形已被定价的第一个迹象，是在平静、近乎无趋势的行情中（SPY +8.6%、成长−价值 +3.3%、VIX 20→16、周期股 +6.8% 与防御股 +5.0% 均衡）的个股驱动复苏。被打入谷底的估值、2026年重定价（保险公司提高保费、收紧福利以恢复利润）将修复价差的早期证据、以及投降已超调的感觉，共同驱动了医疗板块跌得最惨组别的超卖反弹——是基本面、而非环境，在发挥作用。
drivers: Stock-specific recovery in a quiet, near-trendless tape (VIX 20→16, balanced)
First sign the worst was priced; bombed-out valuations
Early evidence 2026 repricing would restore the spread
Oversold rally in Healthcare's most beaten-down group — fundamentals, not regime

2025-10-08.title: Choppy bottoming dip in the risk-off retest (−18%)
2025-10-08.title_zh: 避险回踩中的震荡筑底回调（−18%）
2025-10-08.body: A −18% pullback into November 2025 — a normal retest as the recovery digested, with the broad tape softening into a mild flight-to-safety (SPY −3.1%, VIX 16→26, defensives +0.3% vs cyclicals −4.7%). Notably the defensive group actually outperformed in the dip (Health a leader at +4.8%), consistent with its safe-haven character. The 2026 setup wasn't fully confirmed yet (rates, MCR trajectory, guidance all still in question), so the bounce gave back ground before the durable turn. Part of the bottoming process, not a new down-leg.
2025-10-08.body_zh: 回调−18%至2025年11月——复苏消化期间的正常回踩，大盘转软进入温和的避险（SPY −3.1%、VIX 16→26、防御股 +0.3% 对周期股 −4.7%）。值得注意，防御组别在回调中反而跑赢（医疗以+4.8%领涨），与其避险属性一致。2026年的格局尚未完全确认（费率、MCR 轨迹、指引均存疑），故反弹在持久转折前回吐了部分涨幅。这是筑底过程的一部分，而非新的下跌段。
drivers: Mild flight-to-safety retest (SPY −3.1%, VIX 16→26, defensives > cyclicals)
Part of bottoming, not a new down-leg

2025-11-20.title: Confirmation rally — defensive leadership returns (+25%)
2025-11-20.title_zh: 确认反弹——防御领导回归（+25%）
2025-11-20.body: A +25% leg into January 2026 as the 2026-recovery thesis firmed up, in a broadening reflation/growth-up tape (SPY +6.4%, VIX 26→16, RSP beat SPY +3.6%) that supported a turn off the lows. Signs the medical-cost trend was peaking and that insurers' repricing would stick gave the market conviction the trough earnings were in. The group started reclaiming its defensive-leadership mantle as the broader market braced for the building 2026 oil-shock/inflation backdrop.
2025-11-20.body_zh: 随2026年复苏论点夯实，出现+25%上涨至2026年1月，处于广度转宽的再通胀/增长向上行情（SPY +6.4%、VIX 26→16、RSP 跑赢 SPY +3.6%），支撑自低点的转折。医疗成本趋势见顶、保险公司重定价将站稳的迹象，给了市场盈利低点已现的信心。在大盘为正在累积的2026年油价冲击/通胀背景做准备之际，该组别开始重拾防御领导地位。

2026-recovery thesis firmed; medical-cost trend peaking + repricing would stick
Reclaiming defensive leadership amid building oil-shock backdrop

2026-01-15.title: Oil-shock-window dip — even defensives caught in the stagflation flush (−26%)
2026-01-15.title_zh: 油价冲击窗口回调——滞胀冲洗中连防御股也被卷入（−26%）
2026-01-15.body: A −26% drawdown into March 2026, overlapping the worst of the 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock — a stagflation-ish flush where oil exploded +73.8%, VIX 16→31, and the whole market fell (SPY −8.5%, Financials −10.6%, Tech −12.2%). Even a defensive group gets caught in a broad risk-off when inflation spikes and the Fed turns hawkish, and after a big recovery run managed care was a profit-taking target — though it held up better than the cyclical leaders (defensives −0.7% vs cyclicals −1.7%). This proved to be the launchpad for the final, biggest leg up.
2026-01-15.body_zh: 回撤−26%至2026年3月，与2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击最严重时期重叠——一个偏滞胀的冲洗，油价暴涨+73.8%、VIX 16→31，全市场下跌（SPY −8.5%、金融板块 −10.6%、科技 −12.2%）。即便防御组别，在通胀飙升、美联储转鹰的整体避险中也难以幸免，且在一轮大幅复苏之后，管理式医疗成为获利了结的目标——尽管它比周期领涨者更抗跌（防御股 −0.7% 对周期股 −1.7%）。这后来证明是最后、也是最大一段上行的发射台。
drivers: Even defensives caught in inflation-spike risk-off (but held better, −0.7% vs cyclicals −1.7%)
Profit-taking after big recovery run; 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock (CPI 4.2%)
Launchpad for the final, biggest leg up

2026-03-30.title: The +73% recovery blow-off — leading from the defensive side
2026-03-30.body: The capstone: +73% from the March 2026 low into mid-2026, the stock-specific leg that pinned the basket at the top of its range (pos 99.7, RS #4) and saw a low-beta defensive LEAD even as the broad tape went reflation/growth-up with Tech (+42.0%) and high-beta (high-beta minus low-vol +30.7%) out front. The 2026 economics were now confirmed in the print — Q1 2026 MCR improving to ~83.9%, UNH raising 2026 EPS guidance, and CMS finalizing favorable 2027 MA rates (~2.48%) with the Street modeling a sharp MA-EBIT rebound off the pricing resets. The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire (oil −32.7%) removed the macro tail and let the recovery run clean. The honest caveat: Topping at pos 99.7 means the easy repricing is done — respect the move, but utilization and policy risk never fully leave this group, and this is exactly where you watch for exhaustion rather than chase.
2026-03-30.body_zh: 收官之作：自2026年3月低点起+73%至2026年中，正是这段个股驱动的行情把篮子钉在区间顶部（pos 99.7、RS 第4位），且让一个低贝塔防御品领跑，即便大盘转入由科技（+42.0%）与高贝塔（高贝塔减低波 +30.7%）领跑的再通胀/增长向上。2026年的经济性如今已在财报中确认——一季度 MCR 改善至约83.9%、UNH 上调2026年 EPS 指引、CMS 敲定有利的2027年 MA 费率（约2.48%），华尔街据定价重置建模出 MA-EBIT 的急剧反弹。6月中旬霍尔木兹停火（油价 −32.7%）消除了宏观尾部，让复苏得以干净地推进。诚实的提醒：pos 99.7 处见顶意味着容易的重估已经完成——尊重涨势，但利用率与政策风险从未真正离开这一组别，这恰恰是该警惕衰竭、而非追涨的位置。
