housing.now: The housing chain (XHB-proxied builders DHI/LEN, Home Depot and building-products names) sits mid-pack (pos 40, RS rank 17) and is grinding higher again. Its whole story is one variable — mortgage rates — so the basket lives or dies on the rate regime, not the equity beta. The current reflation/growth-up tape (cyclicals +11.2% vs defensives +6.9%, broad RSP-beat-SPY +2.9%) is friendly, but a stronger dollar (DXY +3.4%) and the earlier 2026 oil-shock CPI run to 4.2% had pushed long yields and the 30-year mortgage up, sinking builders ~25% into May. The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire let rates ease at the margin and the group bounced ~22% off the low. This is a rate-relief rally, not a demand boom — housing remains hostage to the next CPI print and the Fed's reaction.
housing.now_zh: 住房产业链（以XHB为代理，包括房屋建筑商DHI/LEN、家得宝及建筑产品公司）处于中游（位置40，RS排名17），正再度震荡走高。它的全部故事系于一个变量——抵押贷款利率，因此该篮子的命运取决于利率/收益率环境，而非股票贝塔。当前再通胀/增长向上的市场环境（周期股+11.2% vs 防御股+6.9%，等权RSP跑赢SPY+2.9%、市场广度健康）是友好的，但更强的美元（DXY+3.4%）以及2026年初油价冲击将CPI推高至4.2%，曾把长端收益率与30年期抵押贷款利率推高，到5月把建筑商打下约25%。6月中旬霍尔木兹停火让利率边际回落，该板块从低点反弹约22%。这是利率减压反弹而非需求爆发——住房依然受制于下一个CPI数据及美联储反应。

2021-12-31.title: Rate-hike bear: mortgage shock cracks builders
2021-12-31.body: Builders fell ~38% in H1 2022 — far worse than the broad -22.6% SPY — as the Fed's most aggressive hiking cycle in decades sent the 30-year mortgage doubling toward 6%. This was a textbook rate-regime crush: TLT fell -24.0% and the dollar surged (DXY +8.3%), and the most rate-sensitive group on the board led Discretionary's -34% rout. With copper/gold rolling over into a stagflation-ish quad, demand froze and the whole chain from DHI/LEN to Home Depot de-rated on collapsing affordability.
drivers: Fed launches its most aggressive hiking cycle
Builders -38% vs SPY -22.6% on affordability shock
2021-12-31.title_zh: 加息熊市：抵押贷款冲击击垮建筑商
2021-12-31.body_zh: 建筑商在2022年上半年下跌约38%——远逊于大盘SPY的-22.6%——因美联储几十年来最激进的加息周期将30年期抵押贷款利率推高近一倍至6%。这是教科书式的利率/收益率压制：TLT下跌-24.0%、美元飙升（DXY+8.3%），这一全场最利率敏感的板块领跌、可选消费暴跌-34%。在铜金比走弱、类滞胀象限下，需求冻结，从DHI/LEN到家得宝的整个链条都因购房负担崩塌而估值下调。
drivers_zh: 利率/收益率压制：TLT-24.0%、收益率飙升
美联储启动最激进加息周期
30年期抵押贷款利率翻倍冲向6%
建筑商-38% vs SPY-22.6%，负担能力冲击

2022-06-16.title: Summer bear-market bounce on a pivot that never came
2022-06-16.body: A ~26% relief rally from the June 2022 low into mid-August, riding the broad goldilocks/disinflation bounce (SPY +17.7%, SMH +19.5%, VIX 33->20, growth>value +8.8) as bond yields paused and the market priced a Fed pivot. As the most rate-sensitive group, housing amplified the move and led Discretionary's snap-back — until the Jackson Hole hawkish reset killed it.
drivers: Market prices a premature Fed pivot
Oversold reflex ended by Jackson Hole
2022-06-16.title_zh: 夏季熊市反弹：押注从未兑现的转向
2022-06-16.body_zh: 从2022年6月低点到8月中旬约26%的减压反弹，搭乘大盘金发姑娘/去通胀反弹（SPY+17.7%、SMH+19.5%、VIX 33->20、成长跑赢价值+8.8），债券收益率暂停、市场押注美联储转向。作为最利率敏感的板块，住房放大了这一动作、领涨可选消费的反弹——直到杰克逊霍尔的鹰派重置终结它。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好去通胀反弹：VIX 33->20、成长跑赢价值
市场押注美联储提前转向
利率敏感的住房放大反弹
超卖反射被杰克逊霍尔终结

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole reset: second leg down
2022-08-16.body: A ~20% selloff into late October as Powell's hawkish Jackson Hole speech erased pivot hopes and another rate-regime leg hit: TLT -17.8%, DXY +6.0%, VIX 20->30, with mortgage rates pushing past 7%. Housing led the laggards alongside Real Estate -23.7% and printed its cycle low with the broad equity bottom.
drivers: Housing prints its cycle low with the market
2022-08-16.title_zh: 杰克逊霍尔重置：第二段下跌
2022-08-16.body_zh: 到10月下旬约20%的抛售，鲍威尔的鹰派杰克逊霍尔讲话抹去转向预期，又一轮利率/收益率冲击来袭：TLT-17.8%、美元DXY+6.0%、VIX 20->30，抵押贷款利率突破7%。住房与房地产-23.7%一同领跌，并随大盘底部打出周期低点。
drivers_zh: 鲍威尔鹰派杰克逊霍尔讲话
住房随大盘打出周期低点

2022-10-20.title: Peak-rates rally: builders front-run the cut
2022-10-20.body: A powerful ~78% surge from the October 2022 low through August 2023, riding a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +75.1%, SPY +24.8%, VIX 30->16, growth>value +14.2) and a falling dollar (DXY -9.6%). Because builders trade on the second derivative of rates, they front-ran the eventual easing even before mortgage rates fell — and as a high-beta cyclical, the group amplified the goldilocks tape (cyclicals +23.5% vs defensives +9.3%), helped by a frozen resale market funneling demand to new builds.
drivers: Fed nears the end of its hiking cycle
Builders trade on rate direction, not level
Frozen resale market funnels demand to new builds
2022-10-20.title_zh: 利率见顶反弹：建筑商抢跑降息
2022-10-20.body_zh: 从2022年10月低点到2023年8月约78%的强劲飙升，搭乘科技/半导体引领的风险偏好融涨（SMH+75.1%、SPY+24.8%、VIX 30->16、成长跑赢价值+14.2）与走弱的美元（DXY-9.6%）。由于建筑商交易的是利率的二阶导数，它们在抵押贷款利率下行之前就抢跑了最终的宽松——作为高贝塔周期股，该板块放大了金发姑娘环境（周期+23.5% vs 防御+9.3%），并受益于二手房市场冻结将需求导向新建房。
drivers_zh: 美联储接近加息周期尾声
建筑商交易利率方向而非水平
二手房冻结将需求导向新建房

2023-08-07.title: Yield spike scare: 10Y toward 5%
2023-08-07.body: A ~20% pullback into late October 2023 as the 10-year ran toward 5% and the 30-year mortgage touched ~8%, the worst in two decades. This was a clean rate-regime hit — TLT -12.2%, DXY +4.4% — inside a narrow, mega-cap-led tape (RSP lagged SPY -3.8%). As the most rate-sensitive group, housing led the laggards (Real Estate -13.6%, Discretionary -13.1%) before the year-end pivot rally.
2023-08-07.title_zh: 收益率飙升恐慌：10年期逼近5%
2023-08-07.body_zh: 到2023年10月下旬约20%的回调，10年期收益率逼近5%、30年期抵押贷款利率触及约8%，为二十年来最差。这是一次干净的利率/收益率冲击——TLT-12.2%、DXY+4.4%——发生在狭窄的大盘股主导环境中（等权RSP跑输SPY-3.8%）。作为最利率敏感的板块，住房领跌（房地产-13.6%、可选消费-13.1%），随后才迎来年末转向反弹。
drivers_zh: 10年期逼近5%、抵押贷款约8%（二十年最差）
狭窄大盘股主导（RSP-3.8% vs SPY）

2023-10-25.title: Pivot rally to all-time highs
2023-10-25.body: A ~90% rip from the October 2023 low through October 2024 on the rare combination of a dovish Fed and a melt-up tape: TLT +17.0% (yields FELL), SMH +82.5%, VIX calm at ~18, growth>value +11.6. The Fed's December 2023 pivot and the actual September 2024 cut sent builders to records, with Financials/Industrials/Real Estate leading the cyclical surge and chronic existing-home under-supply keeping new-build order books full.
drivers: Dec-2023 pivot + actual Sept-2024 rate cut
Chronic existing-home undersupply props new builds
2023-10-25.body_zh: 从2023年10月低点到2024年10月约90%的飙升，源于鸽派美联储与融涨环境的罕见组合：TLT+17.0%（收益率下行）、SMH+82.5%、VIX平静约18、成长跑赢价值+11.6。美联储2023年12月转向与2024年9月实际降息把建筑商推至纪录高位，金融/工业/房地产领涨周期股，二手房长期供给不足让新建房订单饱满。
drivers_zh: 利率/收益率顺风：TLT+17.0%、收益率下行
二手房长期供给不足支撑新建房

2024-10-18.title: Higher-for-longer plus tariff-shock flush
2024-10-18.body: A ~34% slide from the October 2024 peak into the April 8, 2025 low. Sticky inflation revived 'higher-for-longer' and pushed mortgage rates back toward 7%, then the April 2025 reciprocal-tariff crash triggered a risk-off flush (VIX 18->52, SMH -28.1%, SPHB-SPLV -19.7) into a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. As a high-beta cyclical with a direct input-cost hit from tariffs, builders amplified the drawdown — falling far more than the -14.5% SPY.
2024-10-18.title_zh: 更高更久叠加关税冲击下泄
2024-10-18.body_zh: 从2024年10月高点到2025年4月8日低点约34%的下滑。粘性通胀重燃“更高更久”、把抵押贷款利率推回7%附近，随后2025年4月对等关税崩盘引发避险下泄（VIX 18->52、SMH-28.1%、SPHB-SPLV-19.7），进入放缓/通缩恐慌象限。作为高贝塔周期股、且直接承受关税带来的投入成本冲击，建筑商放大了回撤——跌幅远超SPY的-14.5%。
drivers_zh: 粘性通胀重燃更高更久利率
2025年4月对等关税崩盘+投入成本冲击
高贝塔建筑商放大-34%回撤

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff recovery on a risk-on melt-up
2025-04-08.body: A ~37% rebound off the April 2025 tariff low into September as worst-case tariffs were dialed back and rate-cut hopes revived, lifting the group with a tech/semis-led melt-up (SMH +64.8%, SPY +31.1%, VIX 52->15, growth>value +19.8, DXY -5.4%). The tape was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -7.4%) so builders rode the cyclical recovery (cyclicals +28.8% vs defensives +8.1%) rather than leading it; affordability stayed the persistent ceiling.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税后复苏，搭乘风险偏好融涨
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从2025年4月关税低点到9月约37%的反弹，最坏关税情形被回调、降息预期重燃，搭乘科技/半导体引领的融涨（SMH+64.8%、SPY+31.1%、VIX 52->15、成长跑赢价值+19.8、DXY-5.4%）。市场广度狭窄（等权RSP跑输SPY-7.4%），故建筑商是随周期复苏（周期+28.8% vs 防御+8.1%）而非引领；负担能力仍是持续上限。
drivers_zh: 关税降级缓解投入成本担忧
负担能力仍是持续上限

2025-09-08.title: Autumn fade as rate optimism stalls
2025-09-08.body: A ~20% pullback into late November 2025 as the rate-cut path stalled and the tape rotated risk-off (VIX 15->26, defensives +4.6% vs cyclicals -2.3%, DXY +2.8%) into a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. Long bonds went nowhere (TLT +0.1%), so this fade was driven by the risk-off rotation and a firmer dollar rather than a yield back-up; with money fleeing to safety, the most rate-sensitive group gave back its summer gains ahead of the 2026 inflation scare.
drivers: RISK-OFF rotation: VIX 15->26, defensives lead, DXY +2.8%
Rate-cut hopes fade, long yields flat (TLT +0.1%)
2025-09-08.title_zh: 秋季回落：利率乐观停滞
2025-09-08.body_zh: 到2025年11月下旬约20%的回调，降息路径停滞，市场转向避险（VIX 15->26、防御+4.6% vs 周期-2.3%、DXY+2.8%），进入放缓/通缩恐慌象限。长债基本持平（TLT+0.1%），故此次回落由避险轮动与更坚挺的美元驱动，而非收益率回升；资金奔向安全，这一最利率敏感的板块在2026年通胀恐慌前吐回夏季涨幅。
drivers_zh: 降息预期消退、长端收益率持平（TLT+0.1%）

2025-11-20.title: Year-end seasonal bounce on a broadening tape
2025-11-20.body: A ~25% rally into February 2026 on a calmer rate backdrop and a broadening, reflationary tape (RSP beat SPY +5.8%, DXY -3.3%, cyclicals +14.4% vs defensives +7.1%, SMH +28.0%). Brief rate-cut optimism and the typical late-year recovery lifted the group — before the Iran/Hormuz oil shock reset the inflation picture and undid it.
drivers: BROADENING reflation: RSP +5.8% vs SPY, DXY -3.3%
Rally cut short by the 2026 oil shock
2025-11-20.title_zh: 年末季节性反弹，市场广度扩散
2025-11-20.body_zh: 到2026年2月约25%的反弹，利率背景趋于平静、市场广度扩散并再通胀（等权RSP跑赢SPY+5.8%、DXY-3.3%、周期+14.4% vs 防御+7.1%、SMH+28.0%）。短暂的降息乐观与典型的年末复苏提振该板块——随后伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击重置通胀图景并终结它。
drivers_zh: 广度扩散再通胀：RSP+5.8% vs SPY、DXY-3.3%
季节性年末反弹+降息乐观
反弹被2026年油价冲击终结

2026-02-11.title: Oil-shock inflation scare backs up mortgages
2026-02-11.body: A ~25% selloff into mid-May 2026 as the Iran/Hormuz oil shock sent crude +66.7% and CPI to 4.2%, pushing the Fed back into hiking and TLT down -4.7%. Even though the broad tape stayed firm (SPY +6.1%, SMH +31.1%) on a narrow mega-cap rally (RSP lagged SPY -6.5%), the 30-year mortgage backed up and housing — the front-line rate-sensitive group — sold off hard while the index held.
drivers: Fed shifts back into hiking mode
2026-02-11.title_zh: 油价冲击通胀恐慌推高抵押利率
2026-02-11.body_zh: 到2026年5月中旬约25%的抛售，伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击令原油+66.7%、CPI升至4.2%，迫使美联储重回加息、TLT下跌-4.7%。尽管大盘在狭窄的大盘股领涨下保持坚挺（SPY+6.1%、SMH+31.1%，等权RSP跑输SPY-6.5%），30年期抵押贷款利率回升，住房——一线利率敏感板块——在指数企稳之际大幅下跌。
drivers_zh: 狭窄大盘股主导（RSP-6.5% vs SPY）
一线利率敏感性驱动抛售

2026-05-19.title: Ceasefire rate-relief bounce
2026-05-19.body: A ~23% rebound off the May 2026 low. The mid-June Hormuz ceasefire and easing pump prices (oil -35.8%) took the tail risk out of inflation, letting yields and mortgage rates ease (TLT +5.6%) and giving the most beaten-down rate-sensitive group a sharp reflex on a broadening tape (RSP beat SPY +4.7%, even as SPY was flat). This is rate relief, not a demand boom — housing remains hostage to the next CPI print.
drivers: RATE-RELIEF + broadening: TLT +5.6%, RSP +4.7% vs SPY
Mortgage rates ease at the margin
Sharp reflex off a deeply oversold low
2026-05-19.title_zh: 停火带来利率减压反弹
2026-05-19.body_zh: 从2026年5月低点约23%的反弹。6月中旬霍尔木兹停火与油价回落（油-35.8%）抽走了通胀的尾部风险，让收益率与抵押贷款利率回落（TLT+5.6%），在市场广度扩散下（即便SPY持平，等权RSP跑赢SPY+4.7%）给予这一最受打击的利率敏感板块一次急促反射。这是利率减压而非需求爆发——住房仍受制于下一个CPI数据。
drivers_zh: 利率减压+广度扩散：TLT+5.6%、RSP+4.7% vs SPY
抵押贷款利率边际回落
深度超卖低点的急促反射

retail.now: Retail (XLY-proxied big-box and off-price — Walmart, Costco, Target, plus discretionary) is the weakest theme on the board (pos 16, RS rank 30) and is trying to base. Its story is the health of the US consumer, and the regime is mixed: the tape is reflation/growth-up (cyclicals +11.2% vs defensives +6.9%, RSP beat SPY +2.9%), which should help, but the 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock pushed gasoline and CPI to 4.2% and the dollar firmed (DXY +3.4%), squeezing real wages exactly where this basket lives. Import-heavy discount retail also wears the tariff cost from the April 2025 reciprocal tariffs, echoing the 2022 inventory/margin shock. Defensive staples like Walmart and Costco hold up better than discretionary; the basket is bottoming, not breaking out.
retail.now_zh: 零售（以XLY为代理的大卖场与折扣零售——沃尔玛、Costco、塔吉特及可选消费）是全场最弱主题（位置16，RS排名30），正尝试筑底。其故事是美国消费者的健康状况，环境喜忧参半：市场是再通胀/增长向上（周期+11.2% vs 防御+6.9%、等权RSP跑赢SPY+2.9%），本应有助，但2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击把油价与CPI推至4.2%、美元走强（DXY+3.4%），恰好挤压了该篮子所处的实际工资。进口密集的折扣零售还承担2025年4月对等关税的成本，呼应2022年的库存/利润率冲击。防御性必需品如沃尔玛、Costco比可选消费更抗跌；该篮子在筑底而非突破。

2021-11-18.title: Early rate-hike de-rate
2021-11-18.body: Retail fell ~18% from the late-2021 peak as the Fed signaled the end of easy money. The tape was already rolling risk-off into a stagflation-ish quad (VIX 18->31, SMH -16.4%, growth>value -13.4) with money fleeing to safety, and Discretionary led the laggards at -19.6%. Multiples compressed as the market braced for higher rates and slowing discretionary spend.
drivers: Fed signals end of easy money
2021-11-18.body_zh: 零售从2021年末高点下跌约18%，美联储释放结束宽松信号。市场已转向避险、进入类滞胀象限（VIX 18->31、SMH-16.4%、成长跑赢价值-13.4），资金奔向安全，可选消费领跌-19.6%。在市场为更高利率与可选消费放缓做准备时，估值压缩。
drivers_zh: 避险下调：VIX 18->31、成长跑赢价值-13.4
美联储释放结束宽松信号
更高利率担忧下估值压缩

2022-02-23.title: Reopening-demand bounce
2022-02-23.body: A ~19% rally into April 2022 as still-strong consumer demand and reopening spending temporarily outweighed rate fears. The quad stayed stagflation-ish with energy leading (+20.4%) and a rate-regime move underneath (TLT -10.7%, DXY +4.4%) — defensives actually led cyclicals (+12.7% vs +7.9%), so this was a defensive-tilted relief, not a risk-on melt-up, before the margin shock arrived.
2022-02-23.body_zh: 到2022年4月约19%的反弹，仍然强劲的消费者需求与重启支出暂时盖过利率担忧。象限维持类滞胀、能源领涨（+20.4%），底层是利率/收益率上行（TLT-10.7%、DXY+4.4%）——防御实际跑赢周期（+12.7% vs +7.9%），故这是偏防御的减压而非风险偏好融涨，随后便迎来利润率冲击。
drivers_zh: 偏防御的减压（防御>周期）

2022-04-20.title: The 2022 margin shock
2022-04-20.body: A brutal ~24% plunge in a month as Walmart and Target both missed badly — bloated post-COVID inventory, surging freight and labor costs and weakening discretionary demand crushed margins. The macro amplified it: a stagflation-ish risk-off tape (VIX 20->29, SPY -12.4%) sent Discretionary down -22.7%, the worst sector. It was the defining retail event of the cycle.
drivers: Walmart and Target miss earnings badly
2022-04-20.body_zh: 一个月内约24%的暴跌，沃尔玛与塔吉特双双大幅不及预期——疫情后膨胀的库存、飙升的运费与人工成本、走弱的可选需求压垮利润率。宏观放大了它：类滞胀的避险环境（VIX 20->29、SPY-12.4%）令可选消费下跌-22.7%、为最差板块。这是本轮周期标志性的零售事件。
drivers_zh: 沃尔玛与塔吉特大幅不及预期
疫情后库存膨胀+运费/人工成本

2022-05-20.title: Long grind off the margin low
2022-05-20.body: A ~42% recovery from the May 2022 low through April 2023 as a goldilocks/disinflation backdrop took hold (VIX 29->17, oil -30.4%, DXY -1.7%). After clearing excess inventory, retailers normalized margins and the consumer proved more resilient than feared; off-price and discount names led. The tape was mega-cap-narrow (RSP lagged SPY -2.9%), so this was a stock-specific grind more than a broad rip.
2022-05-20.title_zh: 利润率低点后的长期爬升
2022-05-20.body_zh: 从2022年5月低点到2023年4月约42%的复苏，金发姑娘/去通胀背景确立（VIX 29->17、油-30.4%、DXY-1.7%）。在清理过剩库存后，零售商利润率回归正常、消费者比担忧的更有韧性；折扣与平价品牌领涨。市场由大盘股主导、广度狭窄（等权RSP跑输SPY-2.9%），故这更像个股驱动的爬升而非全面飙升。
drivers_zh: 清理过剩库存、利润率回归
消费者比担忧更有韧性

2023-04-24.title: Mid-cycle consumer wobble on a yield spike
2023-04-24.body: A ~15% pullback into late October 2023 as a sharp rate-regime move (TLT -18.6%, DXY +5.1%) plus restarting student-loan payments and 'higher-for-longer' fears hit consumer-spending sentiment. The tape was narrow and growth-led (RSP lagged SPY -7.4%, growth>value +11.9), so defensives and rate-sensitive retail were left behind even as Tech held up.
2023-04-24.title_zh: 周期中段消费者动摇，收益率飙升
2023-04-24.body_zh: 到2023年10月下旬约15%的回调，剧烈的利率/收益率上行（TLT-18.6%、DXY+5.1%）叠加学生贷款还款重启与“更高更久”担忧，打击消费支出情绪。市场狭窄且由成长引领（等权RSP跑输SPY-7.4%、成长跑赢价值+11.9），故防御与利率敏感的零售被落下，即便科技坚挺。
drivers_zh: 狭窄成长主导（RSP-7.4% vs SPY）

2023-10-27.title: Soft-landing rally
2023-10-27.body: A ~42% advance from the October 2023 low into December 2024 on a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +78.8%, VIX 21->14, growth>value +25.2) with yields falling (TLT +14.4%). The Fed pivot and the September 2024 cut powered a broad consumer rally — Discretionary surged +59.4% — though the tape was very narrow (RSP lagged SPY -10.4%); Walmart and Costco led on share gains and steady traffic.
drivers: Fed pivot and September 2024 rate cut
2023-10-27.body_zh: 从2023年10月低点到2024年12月约42%的上涨，搭乘科技/半导体引领的风险偏好融涨（SMH+78.8%、VIX 21->14、成长跑赢价值+25.2），收益率下行（TLT+14.4%）。美联储转向与2024年9月降息推动广泛的消费反弹——可选消费飙升+59.4%——尽管市场广度极窄（等权RSP跑输SPY-10.4%）；沃尔玛与Costco凭份额提升与稳定客流领涨。
drivers_zh: 美联储转向与2024年9月降息
狭窄大盘股主导（RSP-10.4% vs SPY）

2024-12-11.title: Tariff-shock selloff
2024-12-11.body: A ~16% slide into the April 8, 2025 low as a risk-off flush hit (VIX 14->52, SMH -26.5%, SPHB-SPLV -23.4) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. Import-heavy discount retail sat squarely in the tariff crosshairs — the April 2025 reciprocal tariffs threatened landed costs on foreign-sourced goods, hitting margins and sentiment together. Defensives cushioned (-5.2%) while cyclicals/Discretionary led the laggards (-25.1%).
2024-12-11.body_zh: 到2025年4月8日低点约16%的下滑，避险下泄来袭（VIX 14->52、SMH-26.5%、SPHB-SPLV-23.4），处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。进口密集的折扣零售正处关税靶心——2025年4月对等关税威胁海外采购商品的到岸成本，同时打击利润率与情绪。防御缓冲（-5.2%），而周期/可选消费领跌（-25.1%）。
drivers_zh: 进口密集零售承受到岸成本冲击
防御缓冲 vs 可选消费-25.1%

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff relief recovery
2025-04-08.body: A ~48% rebound off the April 2025 tariff low into February 2026 as tariff fears eased and the consumer held up better than feared, riding a reflation/growth-up tape (cyclicals +41.7% vs defensives +23.3%, SMH +127.3%, DXY -5.9%) — though the rally was narrow (RSP lagged SPY -4.2%). Walmart and Costco led on defensive resilience; the run then ran into the 2026 oil-shock inflation squeeze.
drivers: REFLATION tape: SMH +127.3%, DXY -5.9%, cyclicals lead
Consumer holds up better than feared
Rally caps into the 2026 oil shock
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税后减压复苏
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从2025年4月关税低点到2026年2月约48%的反弹，关税担忧缓解、消费者比预期更坚挺，搭乘再通胀/增长向上的环境（周期+41.7% vs 防御+23.3%、SMH+127.3%、DXY-5.9%）——尽管反弹广度狭窄（等权RSP跑输SPY-4.2%）。沃尔玛与Costco凭防御韧性领涨；随后撞上2026年油价冲击的通胀挤压。
drivers_zh: 关税降级缓解利润率担忧

travel.now: Travel & experiences (JETS-proxied airlines, cruises, lodging and gaming) is topping (pos 78, RS rank 11) after a long post-COVID run. From the April 2025 low it has rallied ~78% on resilient experiential spending — but it is now extended and consumer-cyclical, exactly the wrong profile if the 2026 oil-shock squeeze (oil +19.2% on the leg, CPI 4.2%, DXY +3.4%) erodes discretionary budgets and jet-fuel costs bite airline margins. The reflation/growth-up tape (cyclicals +11.2% vs defensives +6.9%) is still constructive, but as a high-beta cyclical the group amplifies both directions: the mid-June Hormuz ceasefire helps on fuel, yet the risk/reward has shifted from 'catch-up' to 'late-cycle.'
travel.now_zh: 旅游与体验（以JETS为代理的航空、邮轮、住宿与博彩）在漫长的疫情后行情后进入顶部区（位置78，RS排名11）。自2025年4月低点已反弹约78%，得益于韧性十足的体验式消费——但它现已超买且属消费周期股，恰是2026年油价冲击挤压（本段油价+19.2%、CPI4.2%、DXY+3.4%）侵蚀可选预算、燃油成本压缩航司利润率时最不利的画像。再通胀/增长向上的环境（周期+11.2% vs 防御+6.9%）仍偏建设性，但作为高贝塔周期股，该板块双向放大：6月中旬霍尔木兹停火在燃油端有助，然而风险回报已从“补涨”转向“晚周期”。

2020-06-26.title: Reopening super-rally on a reflationary risk-on tape
2020-06-26.body: A ~116% surge from mid-2020 through March 2021 as vaccine news detonated the most COVID-crushed group. The regime was a textbook reflation melt-up that amplified high-beta cyclicals: SPHB-SPLV +72.0, copper/gold +57.6, oil +69.9%, DXY -5.8% and broadening breadth (RSP beat SPY +13.0%). Airlines, cruises and hotels led the 'return to normal' trade as the rate-regime turned (TLT -16.4%, yields surged on reflation).
drivers: Most COVID-crushed group amplifies the rip
2020-06-26.title_zh: 重启超级反弹，搭乘再通胀风险偏好环境
2020-06-26.body_zh: 从2020年中到2021年3月约116%的飙升，疫苗消息引爆这一最受疫情打击的板块。环境是教科书式再通胀融涨、放大高贝塔周期股：SPHB-SPLV+72.0、铜金比+57.6、油+69.9%、DXY-5.8%、广度扩散（等权RSP跑赢SPY+13.0%）。航空、邮轮、酒店领涨“回归常态”交易，利率/收益率转向（TLT-16.4%、收益率因再通胀飙升）。
drivers_zh: 疫苗突破点燃重启预期
最受疫情打击的板块放大涨幅

2021-03-15.title: Delta-variant pause into a deflation scare
2021-03-15.body: A ~22% pullback into July 2021 as the Delta variant raised reopening doubts and the tape rotated to a slowdown/deflation scare — yields FELL (TLT +11.3%), defensives led cyclicals (+7.9% vs +2.3%) and high-beta de-rated (SPHB-SPLV -15.8) on a narrow tape (RSP lagged SPY -4.5%). The most cyclical group gave back its easy first-leg gains as flight-to-safety took over.
2021-03-15.title_zh: Delta变种暂停，转入通缩恐慌
2021-03-15.body_zh: 到2021年7月约22%的回调，Delta变种引发重启疑虑，市场转向放缓/通缩恐慌——收益率下行（TLT+11.3%）、防御跑赢周期（+7.9% vs +2.3%）、高贝塔估值下调（SPHB-SPLV-15.8），且广度狭窄（等权RSP跑输SPY-4.5%）。在避险接管之际，这一最周期的板块吐回了第一段轻松涨幅。
drivers_zh: 通缩恐慌轮动：TLT+11.3%、防御领涨

2021-07-19.title: Reopening trade resumes on a risk-on tape
2021-07-19.body: A ~23% recovery into November 2021 as Delta fears faded and risk-on returned: a tech/semis-led tape (SMH +20.2%, growth>value +3.9, calm VIX 22->16) inside a reflation/growth-up quad (cyclicals +15.2% vs defensives +4.1%, oil +22.4%). As a high-beta cyclical, travel amplified the move with Discretionary +20.2% as bookings rebounded toward year-end.
drivers: High-beta travel amplifies the cyclical leg
2021-07-19.title_zh: 重启交易恢复，搭乘风险偏好环境
2021-07-19.body_zh: 到2021年11月约23%的复苏，Delta担忧消退、风险偏好回归：科技/半导体引领（SMH+20.2%、成长跑赢价值+3.9、VIX平静22->16），处于再通胀/增长向上象限（周期+15.2% vs 防御+4.1%、油+22.4%）。作为高贝塔周期股，旅游放大了动作，可选消费+20.2%，预订量在年末前回升。
drivers_zh: 高贝塔旅游放大周期段

2021-11-05.title: Omicron scare risk-off flush
2021-11-05.body: A sharp ~22% drop into early December 2021 as the Omicron variant emerged and travel bans returned. The tape flipped risk-off into a slowdown/deflation scare (VIX 16->31, oil -19.3%, RSP lagged SPY -2.1%); as the highest-beta consumer-cyclical, travel was hit far harder than the -3.8% SPY as bookings stalled.
drivers: Omicron variant emerges, travel bans return
High-beta travel sells off worse than SPY -3.8%
2021-11-05.body_zh: 到2021年12月初约22%的急跌，Omicron变种出现、旅行禁令重返。市场转向避险、进入放缓/通缩恐慌（VIX 16->31、油-19.3%、等权RSP跑输SPY-2.1%）；作为最高贝塔的消费周期股，旅游受创远超SPY的-3.8%，预订停滞。
drivers_zh: Omicron变种出现、旅行禁令重返

2021-12-01.title: Omicron-mild relief bounce
2021-12-01.body: A ~23% rebound into mid-February 2022 as Omicron proved milder than feared. The tape was reflationary (oil +42.8%, broadening RSP beat SPY +4.3%, cyclicals +4.9% vs defensives +3.7%) even as a rate-regime move bit underneath (TLT -10.6%) — reopening confidence and pricing power let the cyclical group rebound while broad indices went sideways (SPY -0.5%).
drivers: REFLATION + broadening: oil +42.8%, RSP +4.3% vs SPY
2021-12-01.body_zh: 到2022年2月中旬约23%的反弹，Omicron被证实比担忧温和。市场偏再通胀（油+42.8%、广度扩散等权RSP跑赢SPY+4.3%、周期+4.9% vs 防御+3.7%），尽管底层利率/收益率上行（TLT-10.6%）——重启信心与定价能力让周期板块反弹，而大盘横盘（SPY-0.5%）。
drivers_zh: 再通胀+广度扩散：油+42.8%、RSP+4.3% vs SPY

2022-02-16.title: Ukraine and oil-spike risk-off
2022-02-16.body: A ~25% selloff into early March 2022 as Russia's invasion of Ukraine spiked oil (+27.5%) into a stagflation-ish quad, threatening jet-fuel costs. The tape went risk-off (VIX 24->36, DXY +3.8) with flight-to-safety — defensives led cyclicals (+2.3% vs -5.1%) — and high-beta travel amplified the drop with Discretionary -12.3%, the worst sector.
drivers: Russia invades Ukraine, jet-fuel costs threatened
2022-02-16.title_zh: 乌克兰与油价飙升避险
2022-02-16.body_zh: 到2022年3月初约25%的抛售，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰令油价飙升（+27.5%）、进入类滞胀象限，威胁燃油成本。市场转向避险（VIX 24->36、DXY+3.8）、出现避险流——防御跑赢周期（+2.3% vs -5.1%）——高贝塔旅游放大跌幅，可选消费-12.3%为最差板块。
drivers_zh: 俄罗斯入侵乌克兰、燃油成本受威胁

2022-03-07.title: Oil-pullback bounce on a disinflation tape
2022-03-07.body: A ~24% rally into late March 2022 as oil pulled back (-12.7%) and the tape turned briefly goldilocks/disinflation (SMH +16.9%, growth>value +7.2, VIX 36->19). Pent-up spring/summer travel demand reasserted itself and the high-beta cyclical amplified the bounce (Discretionary +17.5%), even as a rate-regime move ran underneath (TLT -6.1%).
drivers: Oil pulls back -12.7% from the spike
2022-03-07.title_zh: 油价回落反弹，搭乘去通胀环境
2022-03-07.body_zh: 到2022年3月下旬约24%的反弹，油价回落（-12.7%），市场短暂转向金发姑娘/去通胀（SMH+16.9%、成长跑赢价值+7.2、VIX 36->19）。被压抑的春夏旅游需求重现，高贝塔周期股放大了反弹（可选消费+17.5%），尽管底层利率/收益率上行（TLT-6.1%）。
drivers_zh: 高贝塔旅游放大（可选消费+17.5%）

2022-03-29.title: Rate-hike bear catches travel
2022-03-29.body: A ~35% slide into the June 2022 bear low as aggressive Fed hikes (TLT -14.1%, DXY +5.3%) and recession fears hit the consumer-cyclical group inside a stagflation-ish quad. The tape was a flight-to-safety risk-off (VIX 19->33, defensives -11.2% vs cyclicals -18.2%); high-beta travel amplified it with Discretionary -29.7%, deep underperforming the -20.6% SPY.
2022-03-29.body_zh: 到2022年6月熊市低点约35%的下滑，激进的美联储加息（TLT-14.1%、DXY+5.3%）与衰退担忧在类滞胀象限打击消费周期板块。市场是避险流（VIX 19->33、防御-11.2% vs 周期-18.2%）；高贝塔旅游放大跌幅，可选消费-29.7%，深度跑输SPY的-20.6%。

2022-06-16.title: Revenge-travel boom on a disinflation melt-up
2022-06-16.body: A ~68% surge from the June 2022 low through July 2023. 'Revenge travel' ran full throttle even as the Fed kept hiking — but the macro tailwind was real: a tech/semis-led goldilocks melt-up (SMH +58.9%, VIX 33->13, growth>value +21.4, oil -35.6%, DXY -3.6%). As a high-beta cyclical, travel amplified the cyclical leg (cyclicals +25.6% vs defensives +9.0%); pricing power and full planes overwhelmed cost fears.
2022-06-16.title_zh: 报复性旅游繁荣，搭乘去通胀融涨
2022-06-16.body_zh: 从2022年6月低点到2023年7月约68%的飙升。即便美联储仍在加息，“报复性旅游”全速运行——但宏观顺风是真实的：科技/半导体引领的金发姑娘融涨（SMH+58.9%、VIX 33->13、成长跑赢价值+21.4、油-35.6%、DXY-3.6%）。作为高贝塔周期股，旅游放大了周期段（周期+25.6% vs 防御+9.0%）；定价能力与满舱压倒成本担忧。

2023-07-18.title: Yield-spike consumer scare
2023-07-18.body: A ~26% pullback into late October 2023 as the 10-year ran toward 5% in a sharp rate-regime move (TLT -16.4%, DXY +6.6%) inside a stagflation-ish quad. Fears grew that travel demand had peaked; the narrow tape (RSP lagged SPY -3.2%) and high-beta profile sent the cyclical group down with Discretionary -15.0% leading the laggards.
2023-07-18.title_zh: 收益率飙升消费者恐慌
2023-07-18.body_zh: 到2023年10月下旬约26%的回调，10年期收益率逼近5%，构成剧烈的利率/收益率上行（TLT-16.4%、DXY+6.6%），处于类滞胀象限。市场担忧旅游需求见顶；狭窄市场（等权RSP跑输SPY-3.2%）与高贝塔画像令周期板块下跌，可选消费-15.0%领跌。

2023-10-27.title: Soft-landing reopening run
2023-10-27.body: A ~81% advance from the October 2023 low into February 2025 on a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +88.0%, VIX 21->15, growth>value +22.9) with yields falling (TLT +10.3%). The Fed pivot and 2024 cut sustained the travel boom to new highs; Financials/Comm/Discretionary led the cyclical surge even as the tape was very narrow (RSP lagged SPY -12.3%).
2023-10-27.body_zh: 从2023年10月低点到2025年2月约81%的上涨，搭乘科技/半导体引领的风险偏好融涨（SMH+88.0%、VIX 21->15、成长跑赢价值+22.9），收益率下行（TLT+10.3%）。美联储转向与2024年降息把旅游繁荣推至新高；金融/通信/可选消费领涨周期股，尽管市场广度极窄（等权RSP跑输SPY-12.3%）。
drivers_zh: 狭窄大盘股主导（RSP-12.3% vs SPY）

2025-02-19.title: Tariff-shock plunge
2025-02-19.body: A ~34% selloff into the April 8, 2025 low as the reciprocal-tariff crash triggered a risk-off flush (VIX 15->52, SMH -30.1%, SPHB-SPLV -22.8) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad. Travel is the first budget line cut when households brace for a downturn — and as the highest-beta consumer-cyclical, it amplified the move, with Discretionary -21.8% well below the -18.8% SPY.
drivers: Travel is the first discretionary cut
2025-02-19.body_zh: 到2025年4月8日低点约34%的抛售，对等关税崩盘引发避险下泄（VIX 15->52、SMH-30.1%、SPHB-SPLV-22.8），处于放缓/通缩恐慌象限。当家庭为衰退做准备时，旅游是第一个被砍的预算项——作为最高贝塔的消费周期股，它放大了动作，可选消费-21.8%远低于SPY的-18.8%。
drivers_zh: 2025年4月对等关税崩盘、衰退担忧
旅游是第一个被砍的可选项

2025-04-08.title: Reopening rally matures into a top
2025-04-08.body: A ~78% rebound off the April 2025 low into June 2026 as tariff fears eased and experiential demand stayed strong, riding a reflation/growth-up tape (cyclicals +50.3% vs defensives +22.3%, SMH +240.9%, oil +16.2%) — though narrow (RSP lagged SPY -8.7%). The basket is now extended and late-cycle: the 2026 oil shock lifted jet-fuel costs and pinched the consumer, and the mid-June ceasefire only partially offsets that. As a high-beta cyclical, its risk/reward has flipped from catch-up to caution.
drivers: Tariff fears ease, demand stays strong
2025-04-08.title_zh: 重启行情成熟见顶
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从2025年4月低点到2026年6月约78%的反弹，关税担忧缓解、体验需求保持强劲，搭乘再通胀/增长向上的环境（周期+50.3% vs 防御+22.3%、SMH+240.9%、油+16.2%）——尽管广度狭窄（等权RSP跑输SPY-8.7%）。该篮子现已超买且晚周期：2026年油价冲击抬升燃油成本、挤压消费者，6月中旬停火仅部分抵消。作为高贝塔周期股，其风险回报已从补涨翻转为审慎。
drivers_zh: 关税担忧缓解、需求保持强劲
篮子进入顶部/超买状态
晚周期消费者挤压封顶上行

defensives.now: Defensives (XLP/XLU-proxied staples, utilities and low-vol cash-flows) sit mid-pack (pos 38, RS rank 24) in a slow uptrend. By design this is the low-beta safe-haven blend — it lags in risk-on melt-ups and shines when fear spikes, so it inversely tracks the regime. The 2026 backdrop is a tug-of-war: the Iran/Hormuz oil shock, hot 4.2% CPI and a hawkish Fed are the kind of stress that usually bids defensives, but the current reflation/growth-up tape (cyclicals +11.2% vs defensives +6.9%, SMH +67.9%, SPHB-SPLV +20.7) keeps money chasing growth, and a firm dollar plus rising yields hurt the rate-sensitive utility leg. The result is a steady-but-unexciting grind — this basket is the portfolio's shock absorber, not its engine, and its relative strength improves precisely when the rest of the board cracks.
defensives.now_zh: 防御股（以XLP/XLU为代理的必需品、公用事业与低波动现金流）处于中游（位置38，RS排名24），处于缓慢上行趋势。按设计这是低贝塔的避险组合——在风险偏好融涨中落后、在恐慌飙升时发光，故与市场环境呈反向。2026年背景是一场拉锯：伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击、4.2%的高CPI与鹰派美联储是通常会买入防御股的那种压力，但当前再通胀/增长向上的环境（周期+11.2% vs 防御+6.9%、SMH+67.9%、SPHB-SPLV+20.7）让资金追逐成长，加上坚挺美元与上行收益率伤及利率敏感的公用事业一腿。结果是稳健却乏味的爬升——这个篮子是组合的减震器而非引擎，其相对强度恰在全场其余裂开时改善。

2022-04-21.title: Even defensives can't escape the 2022 bear
2022-04-21.body: A ~15% drawdown into October 2022 — defensives held up far better than growth, but the rate-hike bear hit everything inside a slowdown/deflation-scare quad with a violent rate-regime move (TLT -15.4%, a crushing DXY +12.1%, VIX 23->31). Rising yields particularly pressured the bond-proxy utility leg (-14.3%) even as staples cushioned; the low-beta blend lost less than the -16.5% SPY but couldn't avoid an absolute drawdown.
drivers: Rising yields hit the utility leg (-14.3%)
2022-04-21.title_zh: 连防御股也逃不过2022年熊市
2022-04-21.body_zh: 到2022年10月约15%的回撤——防御股远比成长股抗跌，但加息熊市在放缓/通缩恐慌象限里波及一切，伴随剧烈的利率/收益率冲击（TLT-15.4%、压迫性的DXY+12.1%、VIX 23->31）。上行收益率尤其压制债券代理的公用事业一腿（-14.3%），即便必需品起到缓冲；低贝塔组合跌幅小于SPY的-16.5%，但仍难免绝对回撤。
drivers_zh: 加息熊市压制所有资产
上行收益率打击公用事业一腿（-14.3%）

2022-10-07.title: Safe-haven bid into the bottom
2022-10-07.body: A ~21% rally from October 2022 into May 2023. As the bear ended and SVB's March 2023 collapse triggered a flight to safety, defensives caught a steady haven bid and a falling dollar (DXY -9.4%) with steadier yields (TLT +3.9%) helped utilities. The broad tape was goldilocks/disinflation (SMH +33.6%, VIX 31->16) and narrow (RSP lagged SPY -3.1%), so this was a low-drama recovery rather than a high-beta rip — exactly the defensive profile.
2022-10-07.body_zh: 从2022年10月到2023年5月约21%的反弹。随着熊市结束、2023年3月硅谷银行（SVB）倒闭触发避险，防御股获得稳定的避险买盘，走弱的美元（DXY-9.4%）与趋稳的收益率（TLT+3.9%）助力公用事业。大盘是金发姑娘/去通胀（SMH+33.6%、VIX 31->16）且狭窄（等权RSP跑输SPY-3.1%），故这是低戏剧性的复苏而非高贝塔飙升——正是防御画像。
drivers_zh: 收益率下行助公用事业（TLT+3.9%）
低戏剧性复苏 vs 狭窄市场

2023-05-01.title: Defensives lag the AI risk-on
2023-05-01.body: A ~15% drawdown into October 2023 — the textbook defensive curse. A tech/semis-led growth rally (SMH +22.2%, growth>value +13.6, VIX flat near its lows at 16->17) pulled money into growth and left low-vol staples and utilities behind, with defensives -10.0% while cyclicals were +5.3% in a reflation/growth-up quad. The autumn yield spike (TLT -15.3%, DXY +4.3%) compounded the pain on the bond-proxy leg (utilities -13.8%); the narrow tape (RSP lagged SPY -7.3%) added to the underperformance.
drivers: AI rally pulls money into growth
2023-05-01.title_zh: 防御股落后于AI风险偏好
2023-05-01.body_zh: 到2023年10月约15%的回撤——教科书式的防御诅咒。科技/半导体引领的成长行情（SMH+22.2%、成长跑赢价值+13.6、VIX在低位附近持平16->17）把资金拉向成长、把低波动必需品与公用事业落下，再通胀/增长向上象限里防御-10.0%而周期+5.3%。秋季收益率飙升（TLT-15.3%、DXY+4.3%）加重了债券代理一腿的痛苦（公用事业-13.8%）；狭窄市场（等权RSP跑输SPY-7.3%）加剧了跑输。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好拖累：SMH+22.2%、成长跑赢价值+13.6
秋季收益率飙升打击公用事业（TLT-15.3%）

2023-10-12.title: Long, steady defensive grind
2023-10-12.body: A ~43% advance from October 2023 into February 2026 — the basket's defining steady-compounder leg, even as the broad tape was a tech/semis-led melt-up (SMH +170.7%, growth>value +8.8, very narrow RSP lagged SPY -11.5%) that defensives structurally lag. Falling yields (TLT +16.3%) and a weaker dollar (DXY -8.4%) helped utilities, which also picked up an AI-power-demand tailwind. This low-drama uptrend through the soft landing and various risk scares ran right up to the 2026 oil-shock stress.
drivers: RISK-ON backdrop defensives lag: SMH +170.7%, RSP -11.5% vs SPY
Falling yields + weak dollar aid utilities (TLT +16.3%)
Low-drama uptrend into the 2026 oil shock
2023-10-12.body_zh: 从2023年10月到2026年2月约43%的上涨——这是该篮子标志性的稳健复利段，尽管大盘是科技/半导体引领的融涨（SMH+170.7%、成长跑赢价值+8.8、极窄的等权RSP跑输SPY-11.5%）而防御股结构性落后。下行收益率（TLT+16.3%）与走弱美元（DXY-8.4%）助力公用事业，后者还获得AI电力需求的顺风。这条穿越软着陆与各种风险恐慌的低戏剧性上行趋势，一直延伸到2026年油价冲击的压力。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好背景下防御落后：SMH+170.7%、RSP-11.5% vs SPY
下行收益率+弱美元助公用事业（TLT+16.3%）
AI电力需求为公用事业提供顺风
低戏剧性上行延伸至2026年油价冲击

crypto.now: Crypto & digital assets (IBIT-proxied exchanges, miners and bitcoin-treasury names — COIN, MSTR and miners) is trending (pos 35, RS rank 10) and remains the highest-beta theme on the board — the purest risk-appetite barometer here, leading on the way up and on the way down. Everything is a leveraged bet on Bitcoin: COIN's volumes, MSTR's stack and miner economics all swing on the coin. After the late-2025 pullback the basket put in a ~86% rally into June 2026. The 2026 oil-shock/hawkish-Fed backdrop is a headwind — high-beta crypto hates rising real rates and a firmer dollar (DXY +3.4%) — but the current reflation/growth-up tape (SPHB-SPLV +20.7, SMH +67.9%) plus structural tailwinds (post-halving supply, the maturing spot-ETF complex, corporate treasury adoption) keep the floor higher than in past cycles.
crypto.now_zh: 加密与数字资产（以IBIT为代理的交易所、矿企与比特币储备公司——COIN、MSTR及矿企）处于趋势中（位置35，RS排名10），仍是全场最高贝塔的主题——这里最纯粹的风险偏好晴雨表，上涨领先、下跌也领先。一切都是对比特币的杠杆押注：COIN的成交量、MSTR的持币与矿企经济全随币价波动。在2025年末回调后，该篮子到2026年6月录得约86%的反弹。2026年油价冲击/鹰派美联储是逆风——高贝塔加密厌恶上行的实际利率与更坚挺的美元（DXY+3.4%）——但当前再通胀/增长向上的环境（SPHB-SPLV+20.7、SMH+67.9%）加上结构性顺风（减半后供给、成熟的现货ETF体系、企业储备采用）让其底部高于以往周期。

2021-02-19.title: First 2021 correction: high-beta unwind
2021-02-19.body: A ~53% drawdown into May 2021 as the first half of the 2021 bull cycle topped — China's mining crackdown and an overheated, over-leveraged market triggered a violent high-beta unwind. The macro tape was actually benign (SPY +6.7%, broadening RSP beat SPY +3.9%, reflation/growth-up), which underscores that this was a crypto-specific blow-off: the most leveraged basket on the board fell while the broad market rose.
2021-02-19.body_zh: 到2021年5月约53%的回撤，2021年牛市上半场见顶——中国矿业打击与过热、过度杠杆的市场触发剧烈的高贝塔去杠杆。宏观环境其实温和（SPY+6.7%、广度扩散等权RSP跑赢SPY+3.9%、再通胀/增长向上），这凸显这是加密自身的吹顶：全场最高杠杆的篮子下跌、而大盘上涨。
drivers_zh: 加密自身 vs 温和大盘（SPY+6.7%）

2021-05-21.title: Run to the November 2021 cycle top
2021-05-21.body: A ~119% surge into November 2021 as the bull cycle made its final blow-off high. The tape was risk-on (SMH +26.8%, growth>value +15.9, calm VIX 20->17, falling yields TLT +9.1) and as the highest-beta basket, crypto amplified it hard — ETF optimism, retail mania and peak risk appetite drove COIN and miners to records before the long winter. The narrow tape (RSP lagged SPY -4.9%) flagged the late-cycle character.
2021-05-21.body_zh: 到2021年11月约119%的飙升，牛市作出最后的吹顶高点。环境偏风险偏好（SMH+26.8%、成长跑赢价值+15.9、VIX平静20->17、收益率下行TLT+9.1），作为最高贝塔篮子，加密强力放大它——ETF乐观、散户狂热与峰值风险偏好把COIN与矿企推至纪录高位，随后进入漫长寒冬。狭窄市场（等权RSP跑输SPY-4.9%）已预示晚周期特征。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好融涨：SMH+26.8%、成长跑赢价值+15.9
最高贝塔篮子放大涨幅
狭窄晚周期市场（RSP-4.9% vs SPY）

2021-11-08.title: Crypto winter begins on the Fed's hawkish pivot
2021-11-08.body: A ~66% plunge into January 2022 as the Fed's hawkish pivot and the start of the rate-hike cycle drained liquidity. The tape rotated risk-off into a stagflation-ish quad (VIX 17->30, SPHB-SPLV -13.8, growth>value -10.1) with flight-to-safety (defensives +0.7% vs cyclicals -5.1%); the highest-beta asset sold off first and far worse than the -7.7% SPY, kicking off the 2022 crypto winter.
2021-11-08.title_zh: 加密寒冬开启于美联储鹰派转向
2021-11-08.body_zh: 到2022年1月约66%的暴跌，美联储鹰派转向与加息周期启动抽走流动性。市场转向避险、进入类滞胀象限（VIX 17->30、SPHB-SPLV-13.8、成长跑赢价值-10.1），伴随避险流（防御+0.7% vs 周期-5.1%）；最高贝塔资产最先且远更剧烈地抛售，跌幅超SPY的-7.7%，拉开2022年加密寒冬序幕。
drivers_zh: 美联储鹰派转向抽走流动性
最高贝塔资产最先抛售

2022-01-27.title: Bear-market relief bounce
2022-01-27.body: A ~57% rebound into late March 2022 — a sharp but doomed counter-trend rally typical of a high-beta bear. The tape gave a brief reflationary reprieve (SPY +7.4%, VIX 30->19, oil +20.4%) even as yields rose (TLT -8.4%), enough to spark an oversold high-beta bounce before the deeper leg down.
drivers: Doomed before the deeper leg down
2022-01-27.body_zh: 到2022年3月下旬约57%的反弹——典型高贝塔熊市中急促却注定夭折的反趋势行情。市场给出短暂的再通胀喘息（SPY+7.4%、VIX 30->19、油+20.4%），即便收益率上行（TLT-8.4%），也足以点燃超卖的高贝塔反弹，随后是更深一段下跌。
drivers_zh: 更深下跌前的夭折反弹

2022-03-29.title: Luna/Terra cascade amid a risk-off flush
2022-03-29.body: A ~74% collapse into June 2022 as the Terra/Luna implosion and the 3AC/Celsius leverage cascade vaporized crypto credit. The macro amplified the carnage: a flight-to-safety risk-off (VIX 19->29, SPHB-SPLV -18.1, DXY +6.4) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad sent the highest-beta basket down ~4x the -17.9% SPY — the worst stretch of the winter.
2022-03-29.title_zh: Luna/Terra连环崩塌叠加避险下泄
2022-03-29.body_zh: 到2022年6月约74%的崩溃，Terra/Luna内爆与3AC/Celsius杠杆连环爆破令加密信用蒸发。宏观放大了惨况：放缓/通缩恐慌象限里的避险下泄（VIX 19->29、SPHB-SPLV-18.1、DXY+6.4）把最高贝塔篮子打下约为SPY-17.9%的4倍——本轮寒冬最惨阶段。

2022-06-30.title: Post-Luna dead-cat bounce
2022-06-30.body: A ~112% rebound into mid-August 2022 — a violent oversold bounce after the Luna cascade, amplified by a brief tech/semis-led risk-on (SMH +20.4%, growth>value +6.5, VIX 29->20) in a goldilocks/disinflation quad. The highest-beta basket ripped on the summer risk appetite before the FTX collapse delivered the final blow.
2022-06-30.body_zh: 到2022年8月中旬约112%的反弹——Luna连环崩塌后的剧烈超卖反弹，被一段短暂的科技/半导体引领的风险偏好放大（SMH+20.4%、成长跑赢价值+6.5、VIX 29->20），处于金发姑娘/去通胀象限。最高贝塔篮子借夏季风险偏好飙升，随后FTX崩盘给出致命一击。
drivers_zh: 最高贝塔篮子放大夏季风险偏好

2022-08-12.title: FTX collapse: the winter low
2022-08-12.body: A ~68% plunge into late December 2022 as the November 2022 FTX collapse — the largest crypto fraud and exchange failure on record — destroyed confidence. The macro was a risk-off rate-regime move (TLT -12.8%, VIX 20->22, growth>value -12.1) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad; the highest-beta basket marked the cycle's washout low.
2022-08-12.body_zh: 到2022年12月下旬约68%的暴跌，2022年11月FTX崩盘——史上最大加密欺诈与交易所倒闭——摧毁了信心。宏观是放缓/通缩恐慌象限里的避险型利率/收益率冲击（TLT-12.8%、VIX 20->22、成长跑赢价值-12.1）；最高贝塔篮子打出本轮周期的洗盘低点。
drivers_zh: 避险利率冲击：TLT-12.8%、成长跑赢价值-12.1

2022-12-28.title: ETF super-cycle: 12x off the bottom
2022-12-28.body: A staggering ~1220% surge from the December 2022 FTX low through December 2024 on a tech/semis-led risk-on melt-up (SMH +153.5%, growth>value +63.1, VIX 22->13). The spot-Bitcoin-ETF approval (January 2024), the April 2024 halving and Trump's pro-crypto November 2024 win drove the highest-beta basket to a generational run; the extremely narrow, mega-cap-led tape (RSP lagged SPY -28.5%) was the perfect fuel for the most leveraged theme on the board.
2022-12-28.body_zh: 从2022年12月FTX低点到2024年12月约1220%的惊人飙升，搭乘科技/半导体引领的风险偏好融涨（SMH+153.5%、成长跑赢价值+63.1、VIX 22->13）。现货比特币ETF获批（2024年1月）、2024年4月减半与特朗普2024年11月亲加密的胜选把最高贝塔篮子推向一代人级别的行情；极窄、大盘股主导的市场（等权RSP跑输SPY-28.5%）正是全场最高杠杆主题的完美燃料。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好融涨：SMH+153.5%、成长跑赢价值+63.1
特朗普2024年11月亲加密胜选
狭窄大盘股市场为高贝塔提供燃料（RSP-28.5%）

2024-12-06.title: Tariff-shock unwind
2024-12-06.body: A ~53% drawdown into the April 8, 2025 low as post-election euphoria faded, the DeepSeek AI scare hit sentiment, and the April 2025 reciprocal-tariff crash drained risk appetite. The tape was a brutal risk-off flush (VIX 13->52, SMH -27.3%, SPHB-SPLV -22.7) in a slowdown/deflation-scare quad; the highest-beta basket fell hardest, ~3x the -17.8% SPY.
2024-12-06.body_zh: 到2025年4月8日低点约53%的回撤，大选后欣快消退、DeepSeek的AI恐慌打击情绪、2025年4月对等关税崩盘抽走风险偏好。市场是放缓/通缩恐慌象限里的残酷避险下泄（VIX 13->52、SMH-27.3%、SPHB-SPLV-22.7）；最高贝塔篮子跌得最惨，约为SPY-17.8%的3倍。

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff crypto surge
2025-04-08.body: A ~246% rally off the April 2025 tariff low into October 2025 as risk appetite roared back. The tape was a goldilocks melt-up (SMH +89.9%, growth>value +22.7, VIX 52->21, DXY -4.1%) and as the highest-beta basket, crypto amplified the cyclical leg (cyclicals +30.3% vs defensives +14.1%). ETF inflows resumed and corporate Bitcoin-treasury adoption (MSTR-style) accelerated, sending COIN and miners sharply higher on a narrow tape (RSP lagged SPY -10.2%).
drivers: Risk appetite roars back, ETF inflows resume
2025-04-08.title_zh: 关税后加密飙升
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从2025年4月关税低点到2025年10月约246%的反弹，风险偏好强势回归。市场是金发姑娘融涨（SMH+89.9%、成长跑赢价值+22.7、VIX 52->21、DXY-4.1%），作为最高贝塔篮子，加密放大了周期段（周期+30.3% vs 防御+14.1%）。ETF资金流入恢复、企业比特币储备采用（MSTR式）加速，在狭窄市场（等权RSP跑输SPY-10.2%）中把COIN与矿企大幅推高。
drivers_zh: 风险偏好强势回归、ETF流入恢复
最高贝塔篮子放大周期（+30.3%）
企业比特币储备采用加速

2025-10-15.title: Late-2025 correction
2025-10-15.body: A ~51% drawdown into February 2026 as the parabolic rally cooled and the building 2026 macro stress — rising rates and early oil-shock fears — hit the highest-beta basket first. Notably the broad tape barely moved (SPY +2.2%, VIX 21->22, broadening RSP beat SPY +3.4% on a reflation rotation into Energy/Materials), so this was a high-beta-specific unwind: crypto fell ~51% while the index held, the mirror image of its leveraged-on-the-way-up character.
drivers: Parabolic rally cools, rising rates pressure high-beta
2025-10-15.body_zh: 到2026年2月约51%的回撤，抛物线行情降温、2026年累积的宏观压力——上行利率与早期油价冲击担忧——最先打击最高贝塔篮子。值得注意的是大盘几乎未动（SPY+2.2%、VIX 21->22、广度扩散等权RSP跑赢SPY+3.4%，资金再通胀轮动进能源/材料），故这是高贝塔自身的去杠杆：加密下跌约51%而指数企稳，正是其“上涨时加杠杆”特征的镜像。
drivers_zh: 高贝塔去杠杆 vs 平盘大盘（SPY+2.2%）
抛物线行情降温、上行利率压制高贝塔
再通胀轮动进能源/材料
最高贝塔篮子最先受击

2026-02-05.title: Structural-floor rebound
2026-02-05.body: A strong ~86% rebound off the February 2026 low into June. The tape turned risk-on again (SMH +59.5%, growth>value +7.9, VIX 22->16) and as the highest-beta basket, crypto snapped back hard off oversold levels — even against the hawkish oil-shock backdrop and a firmer dollar (DXY +1.4%). The maturing spot-ETF complex, post-halving supply scarcity and corporate-treasury demand provided a higher floor than past cycles, though the narrow tape (RSP lagged SPY -6.6%) kept it a mega-cap-led, high-beta move.
drivers: Maturing spot-ETF complex provides a floor
Highest-beta basket amplifies off oversold lows
2026-02-05.body_zh: 从2026年2月低点到6月约86%的强劲反弹。市场再度转向风险偏好（SMH+59.5%、成长跑赢价值+7.9、VIX 22->16），作为最高贝塔篮子，加密自超卖水平强力反弹——即便面对鹰派油价冲击背景与更坚挺的美元（DXY+1.4%）。成熟的现货ETF体系、减半后供给稀缺与企业储备需求提供了高于以往周期的底部，尽管狭窄市场（等权RSP跑输SPY-6.6%）使其仍是大盘股主导的高贝塔行情。
drivers_zh: 成熟现货ETF体系提供底部
减半后供给+企业储备需求
最高贝塔篮子自超卖低点放大
